Since I was little, my mom and my older brother were very close. But I never really envied them. My mom had always raised me to "do whatever your brother tells you to do," so I couldn't disobey his orders. I cooked meals for him, I masturbated for him, and I had sex with him too...

216016.description:
Ha-Jun lived alone with his grandmother after losing his parents. After learning the truth about their deaths, he became a police officer, but life as a local police station officer is nothing but grueling, far different from the life as a detective he had dreamed of.

“I wish legendary detectives would appear before me and at least give me some clues about the cases.”

Frustrated, he visits the greenhouse where he lived with his parents as a child. There, he discovers one of his father’s books. When he opens the book, what appears before Ha-jun’s eyes are legendary serial killers?

Wait, why the hell are YOU guys here?!

Haine struggles to express her love for Yakumo, but holds onto their promise to marry on her 20th birthday. However, one day, Yakumo suddenly says, "I want to reconsider our marriage." Overwhelmed by emotions, Haine lashes out, but Yakumo finally reveals his true feelings…

216018.description:
“Then let’s work together. Don’t hold back.”

One summer, when the cicadas were chirping at their loudest, Yeo-Eun’s daily life is completely turned upside down. Her 7-year-old younger brother, left behind by a mother who had only ever saddled her with debt, and a mysterious man named Ki Seung-Do, who appeared along with the news of her mother’s car accident. The more she becomes entangled with him, who exudes a cold, monochromatic aura, the deeper Yeo-Eun falls into a dangerous yet sweet trap...

Eventually, she takes Seung-Do’s hand and begins to cross a line she should never have crossed.

(Source: Naver, translated)

216019.description:

Tokugawa Masamune is the next in line of the Tokugawa school of swordsmanship. But for the clan's misfortune, he's ungifted in about every way imaginable, except he is somehow smart enough to make a life like a robot girl who has a leaking problem in her pants; she also lays eggs. And so it happens that those very eggs become rather important for Masamune in the near future.

216024.description:
Long ago, the gods, having triumphed over the demons, entrusted the earth to humankind. Meanwhile, the defeated demons unleashed magical beasts upon the earth in an attempt to reclaim the “Land of Demons.”

The “Land of Demons”—known to the people as Teikokushi (Imperial Territory) Lutrant—was suddenly invaded by a gigantic magical beast known as the Chigei or Bahmat. Having suffered immense damage from a catastrophe that occurred over a decade ago, humanity spent its days fighting against the threat of these magical beasts—.

As the title suggests, the protagonists of this story are a duo consisting of a scholar and a hunter. Lizell, the scholar, studies the ecology of the monsters to determine how best to deal with the threat they pose. On the other hand, Vizal, the hunter, has only one goal: to eliminate the monsters that stand before him. This mismatched duo, whose thoughts and actions are polar opposites, appears to operate independently, without belonging to any organization.

(Source: Aokishi, translated)

216027.description:
I was oppressed by my family, but now I'm the bride of an ayakashi!

Mitsuki, a college student, lost her parents in an accident. Her family home was sold to pay off their debt and she was taken in by her aunt. However, she was given an old shed in the garden to use as her room. She was treated like a servant and forced to eat scraps for dinner every day. She decided to drop out of university, get a job, and leave that house. On the night of her twentieth birthday, she was attacked by a dog-like monster shrouded in a black mist. "I came for you, Mitsuki," a beautiful man says as he appears to save her. His name is Reiji Makami and he claims to be an "ayakashi" with the blood of a wolf. After healing Mitsuki's wounds with a kiss, he explains that Mitsuki herself is the greatest source of energy for ayakashi. Reiji is kind, doting on her and showering her with affection, but is his goal her body...?

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

“Sex makes you sleepy” —the night I took the plunge, believing those words, was a secret, sweet remedy just for me.

Subaru, a high school teacher suffering from insomnia, turns to a lesbian sex service in desperation to get some sleep. There, she meets Tsuki, an escort who provides her with the ultimate comfort, but later, she shows up at her school as an administrative staff member—!? A secret yuri romantic comedy about an insomniac female teacher and a lesbian prostitute who heal each other’s lonely nights!

She refuses, saying she has no intention of ever marrying, but there's a secret behind her decision. Siena's family has prospered thanks to magic, and the sorcerer who cast that spell has died! If things continue like this, her family may fall into ruin. Prioritizing her family over marriage, she tries to do something about it by apprenticing at a renowned magic academy... but the sorcerer there looks just like the Duke of Highlander...!?

Kanami Shinonome, a reigning top idol, decides to enter the fray as a hardcore dungeon crawler to save her career. Her sponsor procures a coach, Fuyuki Amano, as ""the best in the business"". He seems unreliable. And if that weren't enough, an unexpected incident strikes during their very first raid!

216044.description:
Set against the backdrop of a mountain village far from the city, this is a terrifying—and ultimately tragic—tale depicting the chaos of people tossed about by various supernatural phenomena and the whims of fate…

It has been exactly three and a half years since Kessei Ningen Niku (血清人間肉) was miraculously reprinted at the 2017 Daiman Festival. This marks the final stretch of the rental book era. Kenji Shimane’s "kaiki roman series," originally published by Wakagi Shobou—a publisher known for its shoujo manga—is finally being reprinted.

This volume pairs two stories from the series’ six-title collection: Osorenuma and Yonaki Kaiboku.

The author, Kenji Shimane, is also known as Kenji Sasaoka, the first chief assistant at Mizuki Productions. Although the "kaiki roman series" was created before Shimane joined the production company—an event that “broke” the great Mizuki—his artistic style already closely resembled that of Mizuki’s later works. In fact, there was a time when rumors circulated that Shimane’s entire body of work was actually the work of Shigeru Mizuki.

Hell lies beyond a fulfilled wish. A fantasy of cause and effect. The series title speaks for itself. Please enjoy the one-of-a-kind Shimane World, where the macabre and romance fuse together.

(Source: Mandarake, translated)

216045.description:
On his first night after moving in, Jung Seon-Ho witnesses the lewd behavior of the man living next door. Shocked by a live sex show for the first time in his life, he tries his best not to let it bother him. Just as he is losing his mind due to the neighbor who switches men every day, he sees the man being strangled and calls the police, but it turns out it was just a game...?! Having suddenly played a pivotal role in breaking down the front gate of his neighbor, Shin Won-Je, Seon-Ho is threatened by Won-Je, who tells him to do as he says if he doesn't want to be sued...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

216047.description:
The year was 1961. At the United Nations World Disarmament Conference, the nations of the world decided to abolish all military forces. The use of nuclear and hydrogen bombs possessed by each country was also banned, and they were disposed of on the ocean floor. The newly established United Nations Forces assumed responsibility for maintaining world order, and thus, a peaceful world free of war between nations was realized.

However! That peace did not last long! Seven years after the Disarmament Conference, on the very day of the World Peace Commemoration Celebration held in Shanghai, China, the world was plunged into the chaos of war. President Barola, who opposed this fragile peace, led the Z Revolutionary Army and suddenly declared war on the nations of the world! Amidst national interests, conspiracies, racial conflicts, and the world’s myriad motives… The banner of the Z Revolution is now raised!

Set against the backdrop of the post-World War II era, with the Cold War looming large, this controversial work was released by Ryuuji Minami, who had already established a strong presence with numerous works of the macabre and science fiction published by Togetsu Shobou. Finally reprinted as volume 12 of the Mandarake Kidan Series!

(Source: Mandarake, translated)

216048.description:
"Someone tell me. Why just being cute isn’t enough?"

She’s not exactly obscure, but she’s not a major star either. She’s a “mid-tier” streamer. Her mother never accepted her way of life. Her younger sister is a “model student” who never stands up for herself. Day after day, she struggles alone in her room, battling an insatiable need for validation. What is the deep, deep hell these women, who make a living through donations, face, and what true hope lies beyond it?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

216049.description: A bittersweet romantic comedy that depicts the love lives of four female college students with very different personalities: Numako (addicted to dating apps), Manneri-chan (routine has taken over passion in the relationship with her boyfriend), Subculture-san (interested in niche hobbies) and Jirai-kei Princess ("landmine" girl).

216051.description:
At an orphanage, a child appears before Lee Seo-Hu, who had rejected everyone but himself, and clings to him persistently. Before he knows it, Seo-Hu has lost his heart to the child, names him "Yu-Il," and begins to obsess over him, binding him to his life. However, the world keeps trying to snatch Yu-Il away from Seo-Hu in various forms. Although Seo-Hu never let Yu-Il go despite numerous crises, they drift apart once again when Yu-Il manifests as an All-rounder Guide. Seo-Hu begins to take action once more to make Yu-Il his own...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

216053.description:
The moment she witnessed her boyfriend's secret rendezvous, she ended up getting caught by her boss!

Seo-Yun accidentally witnesses her office-romance boyfriend with a married female manager. She is caught by her superior, Executive Director Do Hyeon-Jun, and agrees to pretend he didn't see anything at her request. Seo-Yun tries to quietly end her relationship with her boyfriend, but when things don't go as planned, she considers resigning. Just then, Hyeon-Jun offers her a position on a task force team, as the Overseas Business Division needs an interpreter. Seo-Yun joins the team after hearing from Hyeon-Jun that the two people who recently enjoyed a secret rendezvous on the rooftop will be fired. Subsequently, Hyeon-Jun and Seo-Yun grow close rapidly and end up spending a night together…

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

And right on the mountain behind my house, no less. Seeing him, who resembles a wild beast, Se-Na vows never to climb the mountain again. Barely managing to return home and resume her daily life, Se-Na spots a familiar face. It is none other than that person from back then…

Wait, wasn't he a 'man of nature'? I get it, just stop pretending to know me. Please!

The beautiful man says, "I can't hold back on how much I want to make all of you mine," and her body trembles with happiness. 216066.description:
Ningen to Kaibutsu no Aida, a legendary masterpiece widely regarded as one of the most harrowing works in the history of rental manga, is finally here!

A brother and sister who lost their parents in a horrific plane crash. The only two remaining family members. Walking side by side, hand in hand. If only they could have found happiness even amidst their misfortune. But the younger brother no longer had arms or legs.

This is the tragic story of Yuuichi—the younger brother who miraculously survived the accident despite being burned over his entire body and losing all four limbs—and his older sister, who watches over him and lives by his side. Though she devotedly cared for Yuuichi, who could not survive on his own, the older sister grew weary of the never-ending burden. One day, she finally reached her limit and found herself consumed by an unthinkable desire she had thought she had sealed away deep within her heart.

“Can I never be happy for my brother’s sake?”

“If only Yuichi weren’t here…”

What is a human? What is a monster? A hopeless Friday begins.

The C/W work is Noroi no Chikashitsu, from the special supplement to Shogakukan’s Shougaku 4-nensei magazine, August 1968 issue.

Rieko is a girl raised healthily by her kind parents. One day, while playing with friends, she enters Inuzuka—a place her mother had strictly forbidden her to enter. In the basement of Inuzuka, Rieko encounters an eerie creature with the face of a human and the body of a dog, and, overcome with terror, she faints. Found in a grassy field, Rieko wakes up in her own room. When she tells her parents what had happened at Inuzuka, they're evasive and simply say they know nothing about it.

However, that night, Rieko learned a shocking truth from her parents’ conversation. It turned out that the monster with a human face and a dog’s body was none other than Takeshi—the severed half of Rieko’s twin, who had been born with two heads ten years earlier! Ten years ago, feeling sorry for Takeshi—who had lost his body to save Rieko’s life—her parents had transplanted his head onto a dog’s body in hopes of prolonging his life even slightly and spending as much of that limited time together as possible. With such a mismatched head and body, it was clear it wouldn’t last long, and everyone assumed Takeshi would soon live out his natural life… Cursed screams echo through the cursed basement. This is another must-see, controversial work on par with Ningen to Kaibutsu no Aida.

It’s also intriguing to note the apparent thematic similarities to Sugashima’s phantom work, Soutou no Shoujo—a story introduced as his next project in the publication guide at the end of Tokyo Mangasha’s Kion but never actually released.

(Source: Mandarake, translated)

title.native: 人間と怪物の間 のろいの地下室
title.romaji: Ningen to Kaibutsu no Aida/Noroi no Chikashitsu

Notes:
- Original serialization ran for 12 chapters. In the volume release, two chapters were combined respectively to make up six chapters.
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: マリンブルーの幕が開く
title.romaji: Marine Blue no Maku ga Aku

216068.description:
Kikeiji is about Hiroko, a young girl eagerly counting down the days until her first sibling arrives, and her mother, who watches over her with tenderness. As if to shatter that modest happiness, one day Hiroko’s limbs suddenly begin to shrink. This mysterious illness, which even doctors are at a loss to explain, gradually erodes Hiroko’s very spirit. Meanwhile, the limbs of her long-awaited younger sister... More than its shocking title or the drug-related scandal that briefly appears in the story, this thought-provoking work shakes the very foundations of our beliefs about love. What is family? What is a mother’s love? What is a sibling's love?

The coupled work is Hikigaeru Shoujo. An innocent girl who feeds and dotes on the toads in the pond, and her mother, who raises her single-handedly. A sudden tragedy strikes these two, who had been living quietly and cheerfully despite their poverty. The toads she once loved and raised lend a hand to the girl, whose heart is consumed by the grief of her mother’s murder. The souls of the girl and the toads eventually join forces, transforming the girl into a supernatural entity… A delicate girl, free from impurity and sin, and a mother who loves her just as innocently—the senseless misfortune that befalls them. Though they may seem to have nothing in common at first glance, this second work is a natural pairing. Don’t miss this bizarre tale of a mother and daughter, filled with love and redemption!

(Source: Mandarake, translated)

title.romaji: Fuji to Kai: Saikai to Aishuu

216070.description: Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunae Danpyeonseon (순애 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Pure Love Short Story Collection] Pairing Complete!

216071.description:
To my ex-boyfriend who dumped me: I'll find a better man and be happier than you! This encounter isn't a "one-night stand." It's the beginning of a happy future filled with mutual love.

"Thanks to you holding me, I can move forward." Mio was suddenly dumped by her boyfriend of two years with just one email. Her ex-boyfriend disappeared from her life, only to reappear at a party Mio attended for work as the fiancé of a client's daughter. Realizing she was nothing more than a plaything to him, Mio spends the night with a handsome man in a suit whom she doesn't even know the name of, whom she met at the venue . Thanks to the memory of that night when she was held tightly, body and soul, Mio decides to move forward again, but then that man comes to visit her as a lawyer...!?

(Source: HarperCollinsJapan, translated)

title.native: 溺婚~溺愛されるできちゃった婚~

216072.description:
Is it only a long and deep love that can be united?

I prefer you, smiling beside me, to some stranger. Two people who took the long way around find ultimate love! Five works from "Shosetsuka ni Narou" are now comic adaptations!

(Source: Bushiroad, translated)

title.native: 訳アリ令嬢ですが、どうやら運命の人はずっと昔からそばにいます！ アンソロジーコミック

title.romaji: Nagi-chan to Futari ni Shita Omae ga Warui yo

216074.description: The class president, who used to be bullied, falls in love with Kakeru, who was kind to her through their card games.
synonyms: The Plain Glasses-Wearing Class President Who Awakens Through a Card Game for the Sake of Love

title.native: 地味メガネ委員長が恋のためにカードゲームで覚醒する話
title.romaji: Jimi Megane Iinchou ga Koi no Tameni Card Game de Kakusei Suru Hanashi

216075.description:
The story of a mortal boy named Ruid who accidentally discovers a magic lamp in a cave. He then enters into a contract with the genie of the lamp, granting him three wishes.

One of his wishes is to become a great hero, and the genie fulfills it. However, after getting what he wished for, he discovers that everything was merely an illusion, and he has no choice but to start over and strive through his own efforts. The genie also takes human form and experiences the various joys and sorrows of life alongside him. Through these experiences and his personal growth, Ruid gradually comes to understand that dreams can only be achieved through one's own hard work and determination. Meanwhile, the genie comes to experience the courage and love found in the human world.

Note:
- Includes one extra chapter.
- Originally self-published on the author's Weibo. Published physically by Zhejiang Sheying Chubanshe.
- Winner of the bronze award at the CICF.

title.romaji: Deng Shen: Wei Chang Zhi Yuan

216076.description:
In a remote village where meat is rarely available, I'm striving to eat delicious meat every day!!! -- A bright and cheerful village life fantasy about a boy who was reincarnated as the other main character, who warmly watches over the chuunibyou (eighth-grade syndrome) of the boy who was reincarnated as the main character, while secretly working to improve the village's food situation and develop the village!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 転生勇者の三軒隣んちの俺
title.romaji: Tensei Yuusha no Sangen Tonarinchi no Ore

216077.description:
Baseball gave Ye-Seong everything, and then took it all away. Years after injuries ended his career, he suddenly finds himself back at age 18. This means another shot at becoming the pitcher he once dreamed of being, but starting over means more than just returning to the mound. Ye-Seong has already lived through one career filled with regret, but reconnecting with his estranged father, a legendary MLB pitcher, this opportunity may prove to be a second chance at more than just baseball.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.native: 桜の下には陽気な幽霊がいる
title.romaji: Sakura no Shita ni wa Youki na Yuurei ga Iru

title.native: 雇われ悪役令嬢は国外追放をご所望です！
title.romaji: Yatoware Akuyaku Reijou wa Kokugai Tsuihou wo Gosho Mou desu!

title.native: 猫かぶり姫と天上の音楽

216081.description:
Choi U-Seok, a doctor of agricultural science who had been left alone in the emptiness of life, opens his eyes to find himself back in his high school days in Napa Valley, California!

But what awaits him is a grape farm that has gone bankrupt due to droughts and pests. In this desperate situation, U-Seok takes a huge gamble, using immigrant assistance programs and loans to acquire the farm…

Can he really transform this devastated vineyard?

(Source: Naver translated)
synonyms: Regressing and Becoming a Farming Tycoon in America

216082.description:
After everyone he loved was taken from him, Yeo Woon-hwi lost his sanity and lived as the "Blood Demon" until he met his inevitable end. Just as he thought the curtain had finally fallen on his tragic life, a familiar voice echoed: "Dad!"

Granted a second chance, time rewinds to the moment before he lost everything. Now, he vows to dedicate his body and soul to protecting his family. But this time, he won't be the "Blood Demon"... he will become the "Martial God"!
synonyms: My Father Is the Number One Under Heaven
Dad Is the Strongest Man in the World

title.native: 彼女を寝取られた情けない男の話を聞いて下さい～同棲カップルすれ違いNTR～
title.romaji: Kanojo wo Netorareta Nasakenai Otoko no Hanashi wo Kiite Kudasai: Dousei Couple Surechigai NTR

216084.description:
“I wanna break up."

Ito is dumped by the boyfriend she's been with since her school days. The reason? She “awakened" him so completely that he can't enjoy ordinary sex anymore. Now Ito herself can't get off from anything normal either. If she starts seeing someone new and ends up breaking them the same way… will she just get dumped again? While wrestling with that thought, she remembers a young man she once met online―someone who said he was “into that kind of thing." Thinking, “If it's just a bit of kinky fun…" she agrees to meet him. But after some intense, kinky sex that unleashes his desires, the roles suddenly reverse―and now she's the one being pushed past her limits, over and over again…!?

(Source: Renta)

全都是你的錯！～年下男子想被開發～
전부 당신 때문이니까요! ~연하 남자는 개발당하고 싶어~

title.english: This is all your fault!: The Younger Guy Who Wants to Be Awakened
title.native: ぜんぶあなたのせいですから!〜年下男子は開発されたい〜

216085.description:
Shion gets a call from his drunk girlfriend, Ito. When he arrives at her place, he finds a strap-on that looks newly bought. When he asks why she got it, she gives him a puzzled look and says, "To use it, of course. Why else?" Shion wants to do whatever the woman he loves wants. She has already trained many parts of his body, but the only thing he has used before is a prostate massager. Still, refusing her isn't an option. In the end, Shion climbs into bed, ready to be embraced by Ito...

(Source: Coolmic)

title.romaji: Yuusha no Mama wa Hamerarete Shimatta!

216089.description:
A month after a car accident, U-Gyeom wakes up to discover that he has lost his memory and has manifested as an Omega. Amid all this, he feels uneasy around Han-Yeong, who has come to see him, claiming to be his former lover...

He knows he shouldn’t trust Han-Yeong, but what is this wonderful scent...?

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

216091.description:
“Si, Si-U…? What’s that…? Something strange keeps brushing against me…”

Min Tae-Ha, who had unwittingly become friends with Lee Si-U, the man next door who wraps himself up tightly in a gloomy manner and jumps at the sight of anyone, and showed him some human kindness. Tae-Ha, who usually maintains a certain distance, finds himself unable to do so with Si-U, even though there’s an eight-year age gap between them. Perhaps it’s because he saw Si-U as a child who was only big in stature but otherwise incredibly fragile. His uninhibited affection for Si-U ended up coming back to haunt him.

On what should have been a happy day, the day his girlfriend proposed to him, Tae-Ha is grabbed by Si-U and “kidnapped” to his house…

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Bulgongjeong Danpyeonseon (불공정 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [불공정 단편선] 옆집 남자에게 잘해 주지 마세요
[Bulgongjeong Danpyeonseon] Yeopjim Namjaege Jalhae Juji Maseyo
[Power Imbalance Anthology] Don't Be Nice to the Man Next Door

216092.description:
Soft and endearing, you are the reason I can live another day. The first short story collection by the exceptionally talented Momokichi Shirai.

A girl harboring suicidal thoughts and a sentient washing machine share a summer memory in "Summer and the Washing Machine."

A mysterious friend, Usana, who is both like a rabbit and like a childhood friend, shares an irreplaceable everyday life in "Usana's Friend."

Two beautiful stories of interactions that bring color to a black and white world are included. A striking debut short story collection by the exceptionally talented Momokichi Shirai.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)
synonyms: You Are the Most Beautiful Animal of All.: Momokichi Shirai Short Story Collection

title.native: 君は誰よりうつくしい動物 -白井もも吉短編集-
title.romaji: Kimi wa Dare Yori Utsukushii Doubutsu: Shirai Momokichi Tanpenshuu

216093.description:
In the Ten-Gen era, Yun Zhongxuan the Seventh Prince, who possesses great power and is also the Crown Prince of the Kingdom of Rei, had closed himself off emotionally due to repeated assassination attempts and betrayals. One day, Zhongxuan meets his new servant, Youli. Although he tries to take jabs at Youli, who seems a bit scatterbrained from the very first day, Zhongxuan begins to take an interest in the young man’s unyielding spirit. After Youli saves him from being poisoned, Zhongxuan opens his heart to him.

“Swear to serve me until the day you die. Do you understand, Youli?”

And three years later, the day when Zhongxuan will come of age, the first step toward fulfilling his dream, is just one day away.

(Source: BeLTOON, translated)
synonyms: The Moon That Opens the Night

title.native: 玄雲蒼天～呪いの地に咲く花～
title.romaji: Genun Souten: Noroi no Chi ni Saku Hana

216094.description: Note: Part of Metatoon's Yuhong Danpyeonseon (유혹 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: If You Step on the CEO's Tail
Catching the CEO by the Tail

216095.description: After breaking up with her trashy, good-for-nothing ex-boyfriend, Song A-Yun gets a recommendation for a dating app from a friend. She starts chatting with a user called "Smiling Man" and even ends up having phone sex with him! However, something feels off—the Smiling Man's voice sounds strangely similar to her friend's older brother, Ju Sang-Hyeon. A-Yun checks the app and sends a message, just in case... and then Sang-Hyeon's phone rings! A-Yun initially believes she is safe because she assumes he has no interest in her, but as she watches Sang-Hyeon pursue her with relentless, forward momentum, she realizes too late: This man is not safe at all!

216097.description:
1. Oshie to Tabi Suru Otoko (押絵と旅する男)
2. Youtou no Bishounen (妖刀の美少年)
3. Kamen no Bishounen (仮面の美少年)
4. Game no Bishounen (ゲームの美少年)

title.native: 江戸川乱歩の押絵と旅する男
title.romaji: Edogawa Ranpo no Oshie to Tabi Suru Otoko

216098.description: Note: contains the one-shots Jankyou Senki (雀狂戦記), and Tokubetsu Hidou Sousa-tai (特別非道捜査隊).

216099.description:
Haruhi Nomaguchi is 34 years old. She has been dating her boyfriend Naotaka for six years. Their relationship is nice and peaceful, but the butterflies are basically gone. Haruhi bottles up her fears and worries, chalking up to this is just how love is. But then she catches Naotaka with a young woman, giving her a smile that Haruhi used to see in the past. With her ordinary life falling apart, an ideal man named Mamiya suddenly comes in the picture. What is it that Haruhi truly wants? Peace of mind? A thrill? Or maybe something else...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: わたしが選ぶ理想の結婚
title.romaji: Watashi ga Erabu Risou no Kekkon

216100.description:
She was his first love. She only saw him as a boy. Now that he’s grown, can those buried feelings turn into something more?

(Source: Toomics)

216101.description:
A world where pigs exist as a subspecies of humans.

One day, Gu-Dam comes face to face with his mother, who has turned into a pig, and continues his daily life alongside her. What is a pig, and how is it defined? Where does it begin and where does it end? How are humans defined? Gu-Dam struggles endlessly with these questions as he fights to carry on his life with her mother.

(Source: Naver, translated)

216102.description:
Hyeon-Sung, having suffered a severe injury and lost even the spirits that had always been by his side, is left with nothing but low-level spirits incapable of combat. Forced to retire due to the aftereffects of his injury, Hyeon-Sung returns to farming at the urging of a childhood friend.

Wild-grown food, contaminated by the miasma emitted by monsters, has become completely inedible, so the price of food is now determined by its taste. No matter how high-grade the food is, it’s so tasteless compared to what he used to eat that it’s not even worth comparing…

“Why are the crops I’ve grown so delicious?!”

When the crops grown in Hyeon-Sung’s field began to reveal the “true flavor” that had been lost, his quiet rural life was turned upside down. From the nation’s top hunter to a high-ranking Special Operations officer, and even the top stars of the three major entertainment agencies! National-level heavyweights who’ve never known fear begin flocking to this remote corner of the countryside!!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: I Retired to the Countryside, and National-Level Big Shots Won't Leave Me Alone
National-Level VIP Juniors Flocked to My Farm After I Moved to the Countryside
After Returning to Farming, National-Level Tycoons Flock In
National-Level Big Shots Flock to My Farm
Even Though You Cry Every Time

title.native: 抱かれるたびに泣くくせに
title.romaji: Dakareru Tabi ni Naku Kuse ni

216104.description:
Five years ago, pregnant with Adam’s child, Charlotte was wrongfully convicted of Emily’s murder and sent to prison by Adam himself. Now, just as she’s finally starting a new life with her five-year-old son, Adam comes crashing back into her world, dragging her straight back into despair. Then the truth finally comes out. Adam wants to make things right—but his apology comes five years too late.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: 분명 이혼했는데, 전 남편이 집착하고 있습니다
離婚したはずが、元夫に執着されています
You Are My Thousands of Stars

title.english: All My Stars Lead to You
title.romaji: Ni Shi Wo de Wanqian Xingchen

216105.description: The main character awakens the useless class "Necromancer" — but gains a skeleton clone in the underworld. Using this skeleton clone to kill monsters and level up in the underworld, he feeds the power back to his main body, continuously growing stronger. This is not limited to satisfying the feeling of pleasant growth for a character who depends on cultivation, but also takes advantage of information asymmetry to repeatedly create opportunities for "playing the fool to crush the strong." From a single skeleton, he embarks on the road to godhood.
synonyms: Necromancer: Starting as a Skeleton Doppelgänger to Become a God
Absolute Necromancer: Ascension Through Skeleton Clone
Necromancer: Becoming a God Starting with Skeleton Clone

title.native: 亡灵法师：从骷髅分身开始成神
title.romaji: Wangling Fashi: Cong Kulou Fenshen Kaishi Cheng Shen

216106.description:
A threatening letter arrives at the home of a graduate of the Keiei University Drama Club: "If you want to know the truth about who killed Kimura eight years ago, come to Gokuraku Inn in Hinazuki Onsen at 2 PM on January 9th, 2024." Four people are gathered: Niwata, Sakimoto, Hatori, and Iba. On the night Kimura died, these four were in their fourth year of the drama club, and each of them had a secret they were keeping.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

216107.description:
Kento and Akari have been married for two years. They get along fine, but for the past six months Akari has been turning Kento down in the bedroom. Kento, wanting to be a good husband and fix their relationship, has been doing even more to try and make Akari happy, from proactively helping with chores to planning surprises for her. But it's all to no avail, and she continues to turn him down. On top of it all, a random man's name suddenly shows up on her phone one day... And after seeing how flustered she seems, Kento begins to suspect her of cheating, even with no concrete proof. Even while suspecting her, he racks his brain trying to think of ways to fix their marriage. But it turns out, this is just the beginning of his taste of hell...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 歴戦の悪役令嬢は推しの声に抗えない～私を殺す王子な従者に溺愛されてます～
title.romaji: Rekisen no Akuyaku Reijou wa Oshi no Koe ni Aragaenai: Watashi wo Korosu Ouji na Juusha ni Dekiai Saretemasu

216110.description:
The game planner Conway summoned the famous generals of the Three Kingdoms, used the emperor to order the princes to take charge of Dongying, captured the Yakuza, killed drug lords, eliminated paganism, and used his own way to rewrite the future of the world.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Summon the Famous Generals of the Three Kingdoms, I Will Be the Prime Minister of Dongying

title.native: 召唤三国名将，我当东樱首相
title.romaji: Zhaohuan Sanguo Mingjiang, Wo Dang Dong Ying Shouxiang

216111.description:
After living an utterly ordinary life for over a decade, one night Ji Minghuan suddenly awakened a strange superpower—the ability to create game characters in the real world. Each character came with their own main storyline and a unique skill tree system. From that moment on, he was unstoppable. He kept creating new characters, developing their skill trees, and nurturing their systems… As long as a character’s popularity increased, their powers would grow stronger. So he started stirring up trouble like crazy, doing whatever it took to grab attention. He acted like a total sh*t-stirrer, bouncing back and forth between superheroes and supervillains alike. By the time he snapped out of it, Ji Minghuan was already sitting on the moon, staring down at the battered, bruised blue planet. A bunch of maxed-out characters stood silently behind him. With an innocent look on his face, he couldn’t help but mutter, “I swear I didn’t mean to destroy the world!”

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: My Avatar Is Becoming the Final Boss
My Avatar Is Becoming the Ultimate BOSS

title.native: 我的化身正在成为最终BOSS
title.romaji: Wo de Huashen Zhengzai Chengwei Zuizhong BOSS

216112.description:
"This is what happens to us when we drink human blood." He gently kisses the bite mark he left behind, and that simple touch is enough to make her tingle with pleasure...

Ema is a hardworking farm girl who spends her days struggling to support her sickly mother and many siblings. Her only escape from poverty is the annual festival, where young women hope to be chosen as servants to a powerful vampire family.

Despite her best efforts, Ema is passed over. But after returning home in disappointment, she receives a shocking surprise: she has been chosen to be the "rose" for a vampire named Norte. Whenever he bites her, a wave of pleasure spreads through her body. His gentle touch sets her soul on fire... This is an enchanting Cinderella story with a dark twist, revolving around a mysterious family of vampires!

(Source: CLLENN)

title.english: The Fallen Rose is Favored by a Vampire Noble
title.native: 落ちこぼれローゼは吸血貴族の寵愛に染まる
title.romaji: Ochikobore Rose wa Kyuuketsu Kizoku no Chouai ni Somaru

216114.description:
1. Chikyuu Metsubou Mae Boku-tachi wa (地球滅亡前 僕たちは)
2. Mensetsuchuu wa Oshizuka ni! (面接中はお静かに！)
3. Tonda Osekkai (とんだおせっかい)
4. Kasa (傘)

title.native: ジャングルジムの眺め 横山陸渡漫画作品集
title.romaji: Jungle Gym no Nagame: Yokoyama Rikuto Manga Sakuhinshuu

216115.description:
The tumultuous intertwining of human relationships in the world of paper cutting; the aftermath of two people separated due to their strong personalities; memories of a winter spent with something that brings winter and erases the footprints of those who venture into the snowy mountains, causing them to get lost; and the records of the Nue, mythical creatures that venture out on stormy nights while concealing their true identities— In a slightly longer moment, they part and meet again and again. From Kon Kumakura, whose "Blank Space" has garnered attention, comes this long-awaited new collection of short stories depicting wonders that exist alongside everyday life!

(Source: Tokyo Sogensha, translated)

216116.description:
"Can you feel me inside you?" Even though she hasn't experienced her first love yet, her body and soul are swept up in his love!

"I think that much should be included if we're going to be married." Lucille, a baron's daughter whose engagement was previously called off due to unfortunate circumstances, attends the Spring Festival-a gathering of nobles-in a desperate bid to find a husband who will marry into her family and save her household from ruin. There, she meets Theodore, the king's younger brother, who is rumored to be a "philanthropist who favors only women." He offers his financial support in exchange for a contract marriage. Although it was meant to be a marriage in name only, Theodore-a seasoned expert in romance-touches her with such lewd sweetness that Lucille feels her body and heart melting. Then, one day, a woman claiming to be his ex-fiancée appears!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: Your Highness, I Thought We Had a Deal!
title.native: 殿下とは契約結婚のはずですがっ！～婚約破棄は熱愛の始まり～
title.romaji: Denka to wa Keiyaku Kekkon no Hazu desu Gatsu!: Konyaku Haki wa Netsuai no Hajimari

216118.description: The earth is about to be hit by a huge comet, and 98% of the population has left the planet for Mars. A college student soon leaving the planet goes with a woman on a journey to the locations on earth that has meant the most to her.

title.native: 地球滅亡前 僕たちは

216119.description:
Average high school student Momotaro Kibitsu is actually a secret agent entrusted to protect the nation! His mission is to surveil Ura, a beautiful classmate who happens to be the descendent of oni! He's trying not to let her charm him, but the more he gets to know her... From the creators of Super Psychic Policeman Chojo and Teenage Renaissance! David comes the ultimate rom-com school adventure!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

216120.description:
The long-awaited comic book version of a slapstick heart-throbbing love story between a gay hottie and an otaku girl is here! Uzuki Shinomura has a gay online friend, Maki, whom she can open up to about anything. Imagine Uzuki's disbelief when she discovers the wonderful friend she talks to every day is actually the hot manager at her office!

This is a love story that follows a hot guy and a girl who fears hot guys―but loves gay romance stories.

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Madly in Love with My Not-So-Gay Best Friend

216121.description:
You have to have sex with a strong man 94 times to end your bad luck!"

From a suspicious fortune teller: "If you want to get rid of the bad luck that was transferred to you by a bad man, you have to have sex with a good man!" "Why don't we fuck a hundred times?" Aoi, an ordinary, good-natured office lady, has been having a lot of bad luck lately. She finds out that her boyfriend has been cheating on her, and she is suddenly dumped and kicked out of her house. At that time, a mysterious fortune teller warns her, "All your luck has been sucked away by a bad man. Her bad luck gets even worse, and because of her ex-boyfriend, she ends up being sold to a high-class brothel called the "House of Pleasure"! The person who appeared in front of Aoi had a beautiful face like a statue, a strong aura, and was a yakuza member named Masaki who was referred to as the "young boss" by those around him. For some reason, Masaki liked Aoi, and when they had sex, their compatibility in bed was amazing... Could it be that he is the key to ending her bad luck?

216122.description:
Sono Tajima, who works for a foreign-owned video streaming company in Tokyo, hears reports of a romance between a member of a popular male idol group and Koharu Shiraishi, a local TV personality from Fukuoka. Koharu was a friend from her student days—someone known for being promiscuous and associated with many negative memories. When Sono returns home, she finds Koharu waiting for her. As she takes in Koharu—who has fled to her for help—a strange, indefinable sense of delight stirs within Sono....

(Source: Shinchosa, translated)

I didn't know either the sweetness of love or true pain...

Blanca, a rich, young noblewoman, had become the object of a scandal after her betrothed betrayed her. She was invited by the princess of Molders to become her head lady-in-waiting, which Blanca performed admirably. She had no interest in marriage anymore, but she was constantly getting harassed by men who wanted her money. At that moment, Dietfried, the handsome man who worked as the prince's head aide, stretched out his hand to her. He was a wealthy, single nobleman who had his own flashy rumors about him, and he suggested to Blanca that it would be practical for them to have a romantic relationship. "You're the model of a lady, so I can't resist the sight of you looking a mess." Blanca melted under his lewd, experienced touches. As she was bewildered by her first romance, she was also falling for his true self.

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

216124.description:
I have no friends. I don't even have the guts to leave this damn countryside. One day, while working at a convenience store, I was being harassed by some delinquents. That's when— "Can't you see the store clerk is in trouble?" The one who came to my rescue was Kumakura-san, a tough-guy type woman who happened to be staying in this countryside for work. I couldn't believe that a beautiful woman who would come to my rescue actually existed... The next day, we met again in the convenience store's smoking area, and naturally, the conversation flowed— "Are you free tonight?" She unexpectedly invited me out. We ended up drinking at my place, and before I knew it, we were kissing...!? From then on, I was having sex with Kumakura-san every day! I was living a dream life, but— Leave tough-guy types to me♪ GURIDA-sensei presents the first part of a fateful reversal of fortune sex with a highly sexual beauty in a rural town!!

No matter how wonderful heaven might be, if the one you love is not there, then it is more terrifying than hell. That's when you realize: if you can no longer go to see them, then you simply have to make them come and see you. So before the gates of heaven open, no matter what, you will bring the one you love over to this side.

Madoka marries Touma, the young CEO of Futafuji Trading Company, in order to save her father's company. The night after the party when they announced their engagement, Touma tells her that he plans on taking her to bed every night until she gets pregnant so that she can give birth to his heir. She tries to reject him, but he says, "Is that all your resolve is worth?" Agitated, Madoka makes up her mind.

Kururi Himekawa just landed a new job at the apparel company of her dreams. As a self-proclaimed undesirable woman, she finds herself working overtime as the tenured "hot girls" keep pushing their work onto her. On one such evening, Rui Tamasaka, a man Kururi has put on a god-like pedestal, offers some words of encouragement. However, within a matter of minutes, the same man she believed to be the embodiment of kindness flips out on Kururi for the way she's styled her outfit. Kururi soon finds herself subjected to a tirade of harsh criticism from Rui. And, while she's trying to focus on the advice she's receiving, she can't help but react to all the places Rui is touching...

She offers herself to Lord Leonard, a man shrouded in whispers and cold rumors. The gossip that the Lord is incapable of intimacy, however, as the candles flicker low on their wedding night, Leonard reveals a side the world has never seen. Suddenly, he sweeps her into his arms, shattering every expectation she held. Beneath his composed exterior lies a fervent passion and a strength that leaves Julia's heart racing, proving he is far more capable of love? and desire? than she ever dared to dream.

Takase Kouji is a single father and section manager at a major corporation, living an ordinary life despite being obliviously popular with female coworkers. ,br> What secret connects Himari to Takase?

Rinko Asakura may be beautiful, but she's as strict a math teacher as they come. She's expressionless, never smiles, and her students call her the "Ice Queen," but her new colleague, Mr. Kubota sees through her instantly. Mr. Kubota's also a tough guy to read, but he consoles Rinko when he notices that she's shocked upon seeing the man she secretly pines for getting intimate with another female teacher. They go out for a drink, she tells him that men are afraid of her expressionless face when they get physical, and he suggests giving him a try. The next thing Ms. Asakura knows, she's finding out that Mr. Kubota isn't the mild-mannered man she usually sees at school. Mr. Kubota, on the other hand, is unbelievably aroused when he sees her tears. What will happen to Ms. Asakura when she breaks the school rule forbidding romantic relationships between teachers...!?

Adlen, a maid whose greatest life goal is to live happily ever after with a husband prettier than a chubby toad and a child better than a disobedient frog. On the day her master, whom she had never met before, returned from the battlefield, he threw a baby at her instead of war spoils!!

"Raise him."
"What?"
"I will give you double your salary, a house, a carriage, livestocks, and even the wedding funds."
"No."
"I will find you a man to marry."

Listen, Master. A husband found by your boss... does that even make sense? Unable to resist her master's coercion, Adlen is captured and forced to serve as the nanny for the baby, who is the Crown Prince of an enemy nation. Will she be able to achieve her life's goal of a happy family?!!

One day during a break, Sayama caught Hinako's smartphone slipping from her hand and pulled her body into his arms! How did she come to attain the Golden Goddess――

This is a fragment of the history woven by the gods’ followers――.

Every day, Heith is pushed around by warriors who are far too strong and unbelievably self-centered. On this particular day, she should have been able to enjoy a rare day off, but――

“Wow! I’d love to see the Witch and the Saint perform together in a dream collaboration!”

“――Let’s go!!”

Thanks to a single remark from a young woman of the city, Heith unexpectedly ends up forming a party with a Saint!

As they pursue the wanted criminal known as the “Bloodstained Troll,” who holds the key to everything, even the formidable warriors led by Ottar begin to make their move!

“Someday, into true gold.”

This fifth installment of the Chronicle Series also includes the golden days of the past, a story of repeated setbacks and rebirth, as well as the Fertility Operation, a scheme to breed the White Rabbit.

216146.description:
"I won't let you live again."

Facing the monumental task of unifying the martial arts world, the head of the Namgung family, 'Namgung Hyun-ho,' watches in horror as his beloved 'dog' annihilates his entire clan. In the moment he feels his neck being severed, he suddenly finds himself back seven years to when he first met that 'dog.' But things are unfolding differently this time around…

On top of that, the 'dog,' 'Baek-gyeon,' returns completely wrecked, making his vow of revenge seem meaningless. Was it really you who killed me back then? Truths gradually cast shadows on everything that has been concealed. The past shifts little by little. A bizarre intertwining of the slain Hyun-ho and the slayer Baek-gyeon unfolds in a thrilling tale of revenge and action.

216149.description:
Yu-Han and Su-A, along with their brothers Ji-Han and Sin-U, have been inseparable since childhood. But their bonds go far beyond ordinary friendship. Su-A only has eyes for Yu-Han, while Shin-U has always kept a tight grip on Ji-Han’s relationships. When outsiders threaten their bonds, their possessiveness begins to spiral. Under the guise of love and friendship, a dangerous game of obsession and gaslighting unfolds. Will these obsessive siblings be able to keep their childhood friends by their side?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

216150.description: For the sake of world peace, an explorer ventures into dungeons. A dungeon master thwarts him at every turn. The two battle repeatedly, and time passes. The explorer's adventures continue, and he has grown into a young man. The dungeon master, too, has grown remarkably. Her ample bosom, peeking out from beneath her clothes, is now undeniably prominent.

216152.description:
As a child, Seo-Ri is nearly sold into a courtesan house by her mother, but is saved by the benevolent Queen Yeon-Hwa. So she later helps the queen's son, Prince Seon-Gyeom, avoid an attempt on his life and run away from the kingdom. Six years later, Seo-Ri is living in disguise as a "male" slave at the palace for her safety. But then, Seon-Gyeom unexpectedly returns as a powerful prince and is drawn to Seo-Ri despite failing to recognize her. Can Seo-Ri keep her identity a secret with the prince's heated obsession growing by the day?

(Source: Tappytoon)

216154.description:
Hae-Jo is a hybrid of a poisonous bird, the Jimsae. Due to an unfortunate accident caused by his poisonous feathers, he was banished to the human world and is only allowed to return to the divine realm during his mating season. However, because he is a hybrid of a poisonous bird, no one will mate with him, leaving him a lifelong bachelor and a virgin. Hearing that hybrids have lifespans as short as humans', Hae-Jo gives up on mating and attempts to steal an egg. However, failing to steal even that properly, he is about to give up when he discovers something that looks like an egg…! But it was not an egg; it was the sealed power of the Wolf King. The King's power belongs to the King. To reclaim the power Hae-Jo has swallowed, some radical wolves insist that he must be killed immediately. However, Hae-Jo makes a bold declaration that he will return the King's power through 'sleeping together'…!

I can see the color of that person’s sorrow, the color of joy, pain, and love. Cyril Vedito, a pharmacist, can see things that other humans cannot. Colors appear above a person’s head that represents their emotions and future. With her white hair and red eyes, she is often treated as a rumored “fortune teller” in town. Hector Alderde, the “Flower Knight”, is the most handsome bachelor in town. The man with many loves, is actually not in love with any of his followers. In fact, he even seems to be a misogynist. By chance, Cyril sees an ominous color above Hector’s head and unintentionally saves him. Hector, who is supposed to hate women, has taken an interest in her, and he comes to visit Cyril’s shop incognito. Behind his handsome face, Cyril finds out that Hector actually has a big secret. One day, she finds the color of “love” above Hector’s head. And that is… A clumsy “first love” fantasy of a fortune teller and a beautiful knight!

My newlywed life with my serious husband is surprisingly sweet and lewd!

Charlotte, the daughter of a viscount, is married to Eugene, known as the Icy Snowy Noble, who is the heir to a marquisdom and an aide to the prime minister. They got married because Charlotte has magic that she imbues into pastries that cure exhaustion. Her husband is very serious about his work, and while their marriage may be passionless, their newlywed life is peaceful. Or so it was supposed to be, but suddenly he's beginning to act strange! Kanan, a successful career woman enjoying her single life, is strongly attracted to the smooth-mannered, handsome Keito she meets at a bar one day. Their first casual encounter leads to a passionate night unlike anything she's ever experienced. However, the following week, Keito, whom she thought was just a one-night stand, reappears as her new boss! Plus, he's the next CEO of Kanan's company! Dietrich, nicknamed the "Cold-Disaster Prince" because he seems incapable of warmth, became king at 17 under his ambitious mother's influence. But life turns tragically cruel: his younger brother Oscar seizes the throne, then he is publicly executed. Miraculously, at the very moment of his beheading, Dietrich's consciousness returns to four years earlier, when he was 13. With that memory, he resolves to right his mistakes: this time he will cherish his fiancée, Marguerite. In his previous life, he pushed her away with coldness, even though she stayed loyal and kind until the end, praying for him. Now, knowing what he lost, he vows to do everything differently. Thus begins his revenge, his path to being called the "Wise King."

216202.description:
"They" are real... One month has passed since the Great Shizuoka Earthquake. Marine research organization JANSTEC has been conducting observations of submarine faults in order to uncover the cause of the massive quake. Yadorigi, a blind young man working as a sonarman, assists in navigating the manned deep-sea submersible when they make a discovery...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

216203.description:
Izumi Santa, 15 years old. Lives a life where he leaves everything up to everyone else with zero will of his own... But is that about to come to an end?! Santa was planning to get through high school innocuously, without any fuss, without ruffling anyone's feathers, or being laughed at. One day, while visiting the Kyudo club during club observation period, something just clicks, and a whole new feeling takes off inside him. Every day's full of screw-ups and embarrassment, but Santa's pure, earnest, and oddly endearing presence brings color to the youth of everyone around him!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

216204.description:
Feel free to come. You can't run away. All he wants is her breasts, but she still melts under his touch.

"I'm sorry, but I ripped your dress." Melissa had fainted at a ball, and had woken up to the surprise that her large chest had been bared. She had been the subject of the insulting rumor that her chest was big because she'd been with so many men, and now the known woman-hater Marquis Grey, known as the Demon of Cheltem, had seen her chest. A few days later, despite his supposed hatred of woman, Melissa receives a proposal from him. His strategy forces her into marriage. While she had been prepared for their wedding night, he simply gives her a sweet kiss and touches her as though she's precious, making her feel a hot ache she's never felt before. He's a demon and a pervert, so why does he make her feel so good?

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

216207.description:
Child actors Mii-chan (Mizuki Horie) and Kei-kun (Kei Torii) were 12 years old when they skyrocketed to fame after co-starring in the TV drama Our Next Door Neighbors! Ten years have passed since then. Our Next-Door Neighbors has become a regular series, and in the latest installment, Our Next-Door Neighbors 4, the two main leads — now adults — finally get together. And believe it or not, they are dating in real-life too! But in their private lives, they’re a hopeless clumsy couple…!!!? They may be adult actors now, but they are still kids at heart — a wholesome mirror-image romantic comedy.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

216208.description:
Yukana is always conscious of how she appears in front of boys. In contrast, Takahara-kun, a boy in her class, comes to school dressed in women’s clothing without caring what others think…

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

216209.description:
Yui, a high school senior, has a younger classmate who comes over to her house every weekend. Mari is a girl who — after a minor incident — became strangely attached to Yui and is always right by her side. Mari is funny, clever, and adored by Yui's whole family. But one day… Mari suddenly stops showing up. With college entrance exams looming, Yui tries to suppress her growing feelings and convince herself that it’s all for the best — but… A bittersweet story between a free-spirited kouhai and a studious senpai.

(Source: Compass Comics, translated)

Note: Locked for deletion because it was self-published under Compass and the mangaka does not yet have any commercial work.

216210.description:
The teacher Ms. Jiang became an eyewitness in a sexual assault case at school. But in this campus full of secrets, she must face a confession of love from the assailant, and an overwhelming storm of controversy.

We're just rats in a cage, eating the same slop, living in the same cage…

Tai Yang, the lead-singer of a washed-up indie rock band, is forced to make a living playing on variety shows, being the butt of everyone's joke. One day, walking by the park, he hears a pure voice that touched his soul. The promise of rock 'n roll, so near, yet so far away.

216227.description:
Yagami Ryoya, an ordinary high school boy with no particular redeeming qualities, saved the lives of the school's idol twin sisters from a violent thug. That was the beginning of their sweet yet abnormal "repayment"─.

Reona and Riona close the distance, affirming his every move and spoiling him to the absolute limit. However, their love is a "yandere" obsession that goes way beyond just being "super heavy"...!? Dragging in his family, his environment, and everything else around him, the twin sisters completely seal off Ryoya's escape routes. They are undeniably cute, but there is nowhere to run. What will become of Ryoya's fate now that he is locked onto by a 100% pure desire for monopoly!? Packed with lovey-dovey moments! An unpredictable romantic comedy where the protagonist gets completely tossed around, officially begins!

She can't escape the prince's siege?

"You like to be touched by me, don't you? Feel it even more." Her body and mind are captivated by the intense caresses of his wicked fingers and lips. Evelina, the daughter of a count, calls off her engagement with her fiancé, who happens to be her childhood friend, after he cheats on her. In her despair, she witnesses a tryst between the second prince, Wilhelm, and a woman he shouldn't be with at a party she attends. The next day, the prince comes to visit her and suddenly steals a kiss from her, then she is imprisoned in the royal palace! Even though she is supposed to be under guard, Wilhelm touches her gently as if she were his lover. Evelina is confused, but she is drawn to Wilhelm. But he has someone he loves...!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

216230.description:
In a world ruined by the overwhelming power of the Demon King without the appearance of a hero, a beautiful man appeared before Lady Elfrote, who was in the depths of despair. He said, "Time will soon rewind, just as it has in the past. You will be the hero," he said, and gave Elfrote power. When Elfrote wakes up, she finds herself in the world of...... five years ago! Though she thinks everything may have all been a dream, Elfrote stands up to prevent the tragedy from repeating itself!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

Fujimino City is a place where long-lived beings such as elves and local deities coexist with humans. Mako Ienaka, the manager of Phoenix Heights, where three long-lived beings live, is once again collecting overdue rent from Tsukine, a fox god who refuses to work. A chaotic apartment life comedy unfolds in this fantasy setting, filled with a cast of hopeless characters!

216252.description:
In a world covered by the gray forest , teeming with ferocious creatures called Mad Demons, a one-eyed young man, Shuou, sets out on a journey to see the world with his own eyes. Arriving in the royal capital of Murakumo, Shuou is introduced by his innkeeper to join the "Royal Army's squires," but quickly finds himself embroiled in trouble… This is where the boundless rags-to-riches fantasy begins.

(Source: Bungeishunjuu, translated)

216253.description:
An older man's deep caress opens up an innocent maiden...

"I'll never let you go again. You're mine. My cute cherry." Chelsea, who grew up in an orphanage, receives an offer from Marquess Bernard, 20 years her senior, to marry her. She melts when the marquess kisses her as soon as they meet. Chelsea gradually grows attracted to Bernard, who is always kind to her and gives her sweet, melting caresses at night. Her feelings for Bernard, who loves her, overflow. But his mother is against the marriage, and Chelsea begins to worry whether he really loves her...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.native: おじさま侯爵の甘いチェリー

216254.description:
The story of an emperor feared by his vassals and people and a young woman who is overly beloved, but their love is a true romance...

Raveena, a young noblewoman, has a problem: Theodore, an emperor feared by his vassals and citizens, dotes on her as if she were a kitten. She's reaching the age where it's appropriate for her to get married, but she wants him to stop treating her like a child even if they are childhood friends. Theodore responds, "You're right. You're not a child." And then he passionately embraces her. His strokes are different from before and set her body on fire. Raveena is delighted to be treated like an adult woman who's wanted sweetly by her beloved, but for some reason, Theodore won't bring up marriage to her. Their uncertain relationship makes Raveena begin to feel uneasy!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

216255.description:
France, 1745. Deon de Beaumont, who hails from a poor noble family, dreams of a glorious future and trains day and night. One day, his friend Theragoli suggests that the only way for poor nobles like them to rise in status is to take on a diplomatic role with the rising nation of Russia and achieve results. To do this, they need to win the favor of King Louis XV, who will soon be visiting. As Deon steadily prepares, his sworn enemy, his classmate L'Hôpital, exposes "something" about him... An epic romance of unwavering determination, using everything at his disposal to defy fate!

(Source: Famh Entertainment, translated)

title.native: デオン・ド・ボーモン、あるいはうるわしき不屈

216256.description:
A comprehensive look at 100 years' worth of "too-famous bizarre incidents" that shocked the world! Akishima & Kodaira, the editors familiar from "A Guide to Showa-era Bizarre Incidents," along with newcomer Shinkaichi, delve into the truth behind the bizarre, unusual, and unsolved cases that colored the turbulent 20th century.

From the "clairvoyant" woman who sparked a clairvoyance boom in late Meiji-era Japan, to the "approach of Halley's Comet" feared to suffocate humanity, the "sinking of the Titanic" which claimed 1500 lives, the "Martian Invasion" radio drama uproar, "Nessie," "Emperor Kumazawa," "Tokyo subway sarin attack," and "Nostradamus's Great Prophecy" of July 1999—they get close to the truth behind the strange figures, monsters, panics, and unusual phenomena that enlivened the last 100 years of the millennium.

(Source: Bungeishunjuu, translated)

title.native: 色情霊専門、白夜さんのひみつ

216260.description:
With the pride of each nation at stake, the battle now begins. They gather on a sacred battle stage where each fighter stakes their pride. In this beautiful yet fierce arena, they wield their swords without backing down, engaging in a magnificent battle.

The national battle that caused a sensation on social media is finally being released in book form, with new illustrations added!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

216261.description:
Heartbroken after a breakup, Yuki finds herself at a hotel with a stranger. But he's different from the men she's been with before. His gentle, affectionate way of loving her, like that of a long-time lover, melts Yuki's heart... A sexy fairy tale that begins on a street corner, in five parts.

1. Kasureta Love Letter (かすれたラブ・レター)
2. Instant Lovers (インスタント・ラヴァーズ)
3. BLACK SUN
4. Champagne Shower (シャンパン・シャワー)

216262.description:
Ren, who died from abuse at the age of 9, is reincarnated in another world with the mission of "making lots of friends." The first people Ren meets are a big dog and a jet-black cat...? A heartwarming fantasy set in another world full of happiness begins!!

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

216264.description:
I reincarnated into an otome game not as one of the capture targets, but as the character who gets in the way of them.

If I want to avoid my future where I'm condemned, what if I use my wealth to save the main heroine—the protagonist of the otome game—before the story even starts? Wouldn't that help me avoid being condemned?

Still… isn't the main heroine way too cute? I feel like both the mother and daughter are spoiling me way too much.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

216265.description:
Lady Fiona, who married Margrave Victor, is sweetly and lasciviously loved by her husband's large hands every night.

Traumatized by an attempted abduction by a large man, Lady Fiona freezes up when faced with men, earning her the nickname of "Ice Witch" amongst high society due to her icy beauty and seemingly cold demeanor. Her husband, Victor, is the imposing and rugged Margrave Claude. Despite being the type she should be most wary of, he bears an uncanny resemblance to her deceased dog of the same name. "I'm sorry, but I'm not trained yet," he says, though he never goes all the way in claiming her during their nightly encounters. One day, Fiona realizes that what he truly desires is the Ice Witch herself...!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

216267.description:
"You're a lot hornier than you look, huh." It's my first time, and yet he has me coming from just being fingered! I don't know what's going on anymore...! I just thought he was hot, but now my body feels like it's on fire!!

--Cafe barista Kanna's reason for living is to stare at a regular customer she has dubbed "Hot Guy." She doesn't know his real name, nor what he does for work, but she's head over heels for him just because his looks are 100% her type.

She was completely satisfied with just sneaking looks at him at work, but circumstances changed, and she ended up housing him for the night! "It's time to thank you for letting me stay," he says before pushing her down on the bed. Wait, does he want me!? It's embarrassing to say this, but the combination of him telling me I'm adorable and the sensation of his fingers slowly tickling me inside... has my body writhing in pleasure!!

(Source: CLLENN)

216275.description:
Call me "My Lord Husband."

Reflected in her beautiful golden and silver eyes is... A tender, forceful, passionate, and undeniably sweet newlywed life!

"I promise I'll teach you everything you need to know. And I do mean everything..." Frederica, hated and shunned as the devil's changeling because of her odd-colored eyes-one gold and one silver-was abandoned by her parents and raised quietly and modestly in an orphanage. Eventually, on the eve of her 18th birthday, it was decided that the beautiful Frederica would be welcomed as the wife of the duke of the prestigious Granholm family. For the first time in her life, she experienced a luxurious life in a magnificent manor. Under the guidance of the dignified 37-year-old duke, the innocent young bride became immersed in the joy of being loved and dreamlike pleasures. But one day, she learned that the duke's deceased fiancée had the same gold and silver eyes...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

216276.description:
Rowena, the beautiful princess beloved by all the people of Bennett, is falsely accused of murdering her sister by her half-brother, the First Prince Chetston, and imprisoned in a dungeon. Her happy days are turned upside down, and she endures five years of abuse in prison. When Rowena is finally released from the dungeon, she is then handed over as a hostage to Emperor Fein of the enemy nation of Osborne. Fein and Rowena were childhood friends, but after a falling out, he too has led a harsh life and has now risen to become a ruthless emperor. Does Fein still hate her...? Where will the princess, who has lost everything, end up—an ice cage, or something else?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

216278.description:
The villainess was trying to run away from home when the prince who was supposed to marry the heroine suddenly appeared! A sweet romance between a clingy prince and a solitary lady.

"I'm watching, so don't worry about anything and just come." She tried to resist, but his tongue feels so good... Ruby, a villainess with the power to heal others by transferring their injuries to herself, one day realizes that she had been reincarnated... as the villainess of the romance novels that she loved in her past life! She spends her days being used by her parents and having unhealed injuries, so she prepares to run away from her bad ending. The day she finally decides to leave the manor, her betrothed Prince Ignatz appears. He's supposed to marry the heroine of the novel, but he rains kisses all over Ruby's shocked body...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

216281.description:
I mustn't feel pleasure, but my body says otherwise...

"You're shamelessly gushing with nectar here." He's supposed to be my sworn enemy, but my body is going out of control because of his sweet advances... Shelvie disguised herself as a concubine and took on a false name to infiltrate the royal palace to approach King Fadhil and seek revenge for her family. However, she fails to carry out her plan and is captured. She expected the worst, but Fadhil surprised her by immediately unshackling her and offering her the position of an actual concubine. She keeps seeking the right opportunity to strike, but she discovers a different side to him and begins to develop forbidden feelings as they share sweet, intimate nights...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Monarch of a Hundred Flowers and the Honeybee Princess
title.romaji: Hyakka no Ou to Mitsubachi Hime

216282.description:
"I can see the 'filth' that others cannot see..."

The story takes place in late nineteenth-century England. Having lost her mother at a young age, Paula endured hardship in a workhouse, surviving thanks to her special eyes. They have a mysterious power that allows her to see germs, diseases, and the malicious hearts of people as "filth." Having lived a modest but peaceful life as a housemaid since the age of fourteen, she is one day ordered by her employer to work at another manor. Her destination is the dilapidated "Dirt Hall" rife with terrifying rumors. She is to serve a man rumored to be the Earl of Darkness, but who will she find there...?

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Cold-Hearted Earl and the Maid Who Sees Impurity
title.native: 冷徹伯爵は穢れを見るメイドを花嫁に望む ～生まれ変わるなら、あなたのそばに～
title.romaji: Reitetsu Hakushaku wa Kegare wo Miru Maid wo Hanayome ni Nozomu Umarekawaru nara, Anata no Soba ni

216283.description:
Healed by her soothing power, he seeks out her body time and time again! "Here's your first job. Wash my body."

Jacqueline Rose, an orphan, healed and saved a boy who had collapsed from an injury using the power she inherited from her mother. The boy then revealed his identity as a prince and begged her to heal and save the heart of his brother, Prince Lucian, with her power. Due to certain circumstances, Lucian had secluded himself in an old castle in the east, distancing himself from his family and refusing to appear in public... Unable to refuse the angelic boy's request, Jacqueline Rose offered to work as a maid for Prince Lucian. Then, Prince Lucian asked her to join him in the bath and wash his body thoroughly. Before she knew it, he was touching and licking her entire body, and they passionately rubbed against each other... Jacqueline Rose became addicted to the pleasure she had never known before!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Reclusive Prince Pleasures the Lonely Witch Night After Night
title.native: 孤独な魔女はひきこもり絶倫王子に毎晩イかされ溺愛されています
title.romaji: Kodoku na Majo wa Hikikomori Zetsurin Ouji ni Maiban Ika Sare Dekiai Sarete Imasu

216284.description:
Big Comic 45th anniversary commemorative project

First published in 1968, Big Comic celebrates its 45th anniversary in 2013. To commemorate this milestone, we have compiled a collection of carefully selected short stories—chosen from the adult-oriented works created in the late 1960s and early 1970s—by eight of the magazine’s “big-name” authors who contributed to its inaugural issues. In January 2013, two volumes—Osamu Tezuka and Shigeru Mizuki—were published simultaneously. The series will continue with one volume per month, featuring Fujiko F. Fujio, Sanpei Shirato, Fujiko Fujio A, Kazuo Umezu, Shotaro Ishinomori, and Takao Saito. Starting with entertainment for children and expanding its readership to include young adults and adults, the origins of manga’s appeal—now beloved worldwide—can be found right here! The sixth volume features none other than the genius himself: Kazuo Umezu. From horror manga to razor-sharp short stories that stare directly at the darker side of humanity, all the way to explosive comedy… this volume condenses the appeal of a body of work with a dazzling range.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

2. Me (目)
3. Dali no Otoko (ダリの男)
4. Zankoku no Ichiya (残酷の一夜)
5. Natsu no Owari (夏の終わり)
6. Kubi (首)
7. Mimi (耳)
8. Yubi (指)
9. Door no Mukou (ドアの向こう)
10. Okikuro no (お菊ろの)

From period dramas to the teeming nightlife of Ginza’s women, and even science fiction and fantasy… this collection of masterpieces, created with just a single pen, bursts with energy akin to that of a film studio.

216291.description:
At twenty, I thought my first summer would be a little special. I thought that once I moved to Seoul, I’d date a sweet guy from the city, but the reality was working a part-time job serving shaved ice, just me and my male friend from back home...! We’d been as close as siblings since childhood. Jang Je-Yeol, with his shameless swagger, was absolutely not someone I’d ever consider dating. But maybe it was the heat of summer getting to me? I ended up impulsively kissing Jang Je-Yeol.

“Why… does he look so handsome?”

Back and forth—the untold story of that summer.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

216292.description:
The continent lay in ruins at the hands of the Emperor. Even the allied forces, the last hope of all, had suffered a crushing defeat. It was a moment of utter despair.

“Ad. This is an order. Absorb my heart.”

"Predation," the ability to devour another person’s talents and powers whole. Adrian absorbs the heart of Ian, his dying hero and friend, and regresses fifteen years into the past, back to when he was nothing more than a good-for-nothing scoundrel.

“Ian… You want me to save the world? Sorry, but I can't care less about that..."

His brutal combat experience from his past life, a Player System seemingly inherited from Ian, and "Predation," an ability that allows him to grow stronger without limit, all come together... and Adrian begins to grow at an overwhelming pace.

“...But I will make you one promise. I’ll hunt those bastards down to the very end… and chew their hearts into pieces!!”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Lord Who Levels Up by Devouring

216293.description:
Heian-era Japan. Totsugawa Village.

While out hunting, the three brothers—Ichirota, Jirota, and Saburota—hear strange noises coming from the direction of Kuchihokora. When they head in that direction, a massive torrent of water gushes out from deep within the shrine, and a gigantic monster, Gamora, appears. After attacking the village, Gamora returns to the shrine, but…

The scene shifts to the present day. Sarutobi, a genius boy, was heading toward Gamora Village with his assistant, Shikishima…

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

Note: Originally planned as a ten-volume scifi epic, only three volumes were published in the end. In 1998, it was re-released with a brand-new chapter, which is included in this entry.

synonyms: The Younger Wolf Is After Me
The Younger Wolf Is Targeting Me

216295.description:
Life is about caring for others. Ji-Eon, who had always lived for the sake of her poor neighbors, mother, and aunt, meets Ui-Ju’s older brother, Ui-Tae, at the funeral of her only neighborhood friend, Ui-Ju, during the winter before her senior year of high school.

“You are Yang Ji-Eon, aren’t you?”

Although she is afraid of him, who can’t even use chopsticks properly and has an unclear occupation, he keeps catching her eye, so she ends up bringing him side dishes and even tutoring him. He is the most pitiful man she has ever met. Ji-Eon’s feelings, which began with pity, gradually start to expand into other emotions.

“I like you.”

“Ji-Eon, this is the first time I’ve heard someone say they like me.”

Life is simply about living. Ui-Tae, who had considered himself alone in the world, begins to harbor a desire for the first time after meeting Ji-Eon. That he can be with her for the rest of his life. That this very moment may last forever.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: Until I Became a Single Orchid

216303.description:
Now barely twenty years old, Yun Hui-Su, who had been abandoned by his parents as a child and had lived on his own ever since, had always lived with a constant sense of loneliness. One day, while working as a delivery driver to make ends meet, a single mistake led to her being kidnapped and held captive by Sin Gyo-Yeon, a man who calls him “baby.” He had always believed that every misfortune had a cause and that everything that happened to him was his own fault, but right now, he is simply terrified of this man who can imprison him with a single word. Will he be able to console himself by believing that he, too, was to blame for this latest stroke of bad luck?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Yuusuke Ojiyama, a perverted old man who's a DL erotic doujinshi artist, wakes up one morning to find himself transformed into a beautiful girl! It's a convenient disease called TS disease! Without going to the police or hospital, the old man quickly accepts the situation and enjoys his new girl body. He takes pictures of his body and masturbates... But since he's 37 years old, it's all legal!! Awesome! The old man's naughty and fun sex life begins!

(Source: DLSite, translated)

Mel-chan is a gal attending an elite academy for training wizards. However, one day, she protects a friend and gets teleported to an unknown land!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

216308.description:
Hayato is a college student who loves crafting games. One day, he's pulled into the game world and awakens to his "crafting skills," which allow him to store materials and build houses. He was planning to live a laid-back, slow life, but that all changes when he meets Leena, an elf girl. He learns that there are no men on the island they're on and that they're desperate for sperm. One after another, girls from different races come after Hayato, all vying for his sperm!! A harem romantic comedy about sperm is about to begin!!
