216309.description:
In the 33rd year of the Kangxi reign, Emperor Kangxi issued an edict titled “Edict on Recruiting Settlers to Populate Sichuan in the 33rd Year of Kangxi,” ordering a large-scale migration of people from Hunan, Hubei, Guangdong, and other regions to Sichuan. This became known as the famous “Huguang Settlement of Sichuan” event. Was the once-prosperous “Land of Abundance” truly laid waste by war? There is also a theory that a certain “object” once appeared in Sichuan…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

216310.description:
The very first relationship I had in my college years. I put up a picture of him as my lockscreen wallpaper on a whim, and got found out by him...

A one-shot love story about an age-gap romance, and the quiet moment that made me fall for him all over again.

216311.description:
Feel free to break off the engagement, if you like. But I will take my revenge.

Break off the engagement? True love? I'm sick of it, so do as you please. Just don't forget that there will be painful retaliation. An anthology comic in which young ladies who have been subjected to misfortune carry out magnificent revenge!

(Source: Bushiroad, translated)

An anthology of love stories between women set in another world! Featuring five precious one-shots with cute heroines!!

title.romaji: Watashi-tachi no Koi ga Hana Hirakutoki: Isekai Renai Yuri Anthology Comic

216314.description:
Detective Kiyoka Kinoshita, who was forced out of the prefectural police's investigative division after a suspect committed suicide while in custody, finds herself without a place in her own family. Her new assignment is the "National Police Agency's Special Investigation Regional Undercover Unit," a newly established department comprised of outcasts from the organization. Their first case involves a series of child disappearances in a village in Tochigi Prefecture. Sayaka and her team begin their undercover investigation into the village to uncover the truth behind the case!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

216315.description: Noël, a noblewoman with a unique ability to hear the inner thoughts of virgins (aka “pure-hearted” individuals), unintentionally becomes known in high society as the “Matchmaking Noblewoman.” Her unusual skill leads the queen to enlist her help in securing a bride for the charming but woman-averse Prince Luka. While facilitating his romantic prospects, Noël hears Luka’s thoughts and discovers his true feelings—leading to unexpected sparks between them. As she helps him navigate social expectations, her own feelings grow deeper… but must remain hidden.

title.native: 『縁結び令嬢』がモテ王子の婚活を手伝ったら、なぜか口説かれているのですが!?
title.romaji: “Enmusubi Reijou” ga Mote Ouji no Kon Katsu wo Tetsu dattara, Naze ka Kudokareteiru no desu ga!?

216316.description:
I was reincarnated as Letizia, the villainous daughter from my favorite otome game. I'm surrounded by many of my "most favored" characters, including my fiancée, Licht, and I'm about to start the best life of my life. In order to continue to love my precious guesses, I must avoid deportation! And I have one more development that I have to avoid: ....... It's a dream development where my guesses and I are united! In order to love the happiness of my guesses and enjoy the best of moe, I'm aiming to avoid ruin!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The villain girl wants to feel a lot of "moe"

title.native: 悪役令嬢は『萌え』を浴びるほど摂取したい!
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou wa "Moe" wo Abiru Hodo Sesshu shitai!

216317.description:
A reincarnation isekai fantasy where a ruined slave's soul burns with desire for the Dragon King.

Himiko Midou, the daughter of a CEO, had been abandoned by her fiance. Twice, in fact. "What's wrong with me?" One day, she tries hypnotherapy and discovers the karma of her past life. Himiko was once a slave kept by the dragon king in another world. She was bound to him, yet showered with gentle love each day. She wanted to believe that he was her soulmate as he passionately penetrated her. However, her life ended in tragedy when she was killed by the same master to whom she had dedicated her body and soul. Knowing that this is why her love life hasn't gone well, Himiko returns to her past life to change her future.

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Time-Traveler Carries the Dragon King's Love With Her in Every Lifetime
title.native: 時わたり令嬢は冷血龍王の寵愛をとわに刻む
title.romaji: Toki Watari Reijou wa Reiketsu Ryuuou no Chouai wo Towa ni Kizamu

216318.description:
I want to see your face as you writhe with embarrassment while I tease you with this quill pen...

"Show me your face. What do you look like after you've come?" A spoiled young master who demands lewd "rewards" after he receives perfect scores on his tests? Mylene is chosen as a governess to tutor Herbert, the heir to the prestigious Bloom Family. It seems like a well-paying job, and she'll even receive a bonus if he passes his university entrance exam. There couldn't be a better job to support her poor family... but Mylene's joy was short-lived. Herbert was intelligent but hated studying and demanded rewards every single time he got a perfect score on his tests! Having her breasts teased with a quill pen and receiving sensual kisses, her heart and body gradually melt from newfound pleasures, and before she knows it, she has fallen into a forbidden love...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Innocent Governess And Her Master's Doting Love
title.native: 無垢な家庭教師は貴公子に溺愛される
title.romaji: Muku na Kateikyoushi wa Kikoushi ni Dekiai sareru

216321.description:
You want me to make you feel good? The clingy prince plays with her...

"I'll believe you when you say that you don't love me if you don't feel anything when I touch you." Nina, a former princess, lied to her former fiancé, Prince Elliott, that she didn't love him anymore and in return, he's pushing sweet touches onto her... After losing her country, Nina hides her true identity and social status while working in town. One day, she is discovered by Elliott, the man she loves, and runs away because they no longer belong to the same world. However, Elliott corners her with his intense touches. "Kiss me." Elliott's teasing touches continue to escalate and Nina's body melts from the pleasure her beloved gives her...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Runaway Bride and Her Beloved Prince
title.native: 逃亡花嫁と愛執王子～きみのために鐘は鳴る～
title.romaji: Toubou Hanayome to Aishuu Ouji: Kimi no Tame ni Kane wa Naru

216322.description:
His favorite camboy is actually the classmate he can't stand!?

Gaku Kurono is the student council vice president at the prestigious Kokutei Academy. Everyone at school adores the student council president, Mikado Honjo, but as far as Kurono is concerned, all Honjo ever does is dump his work on him and belittle him. Fed up with his rich classmates and tired of being treated like Honjo's errand boy, Kurono blows off steam after school by jerking off to the hot camboy Mika. But when Honjo suddenly shows up at his house claiming to be his tutor and catches him in the act, the cat's out of the bag: Honjo is Mika! What's more, he demands that Kurono help him with his streams―or he'll expose Kurono's "hobby" to the entire school!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

216323.description:
The young King Lionel appears before Glenn, the leader of a group of thieves, held prisoner in his dungeon. Glenn is expecting to be executed, but Lionel tells him he is instead to become the queen, and carves a spell onto him allowing men to bear children. No matter how much Glenn wants to resist it... one touch of the seal suddenly drowns his body in overwhelming pleasure...

A dramatic spellbound love story is about to unfold between a strong-willed heroic outlaw and a headstrong king.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The Serpent King And The Spellbound Bride

216324.description:
Hajime, who usually only tops, embraces singledom after yet another boyfriend leaves him. One evening, he picks up a handsome man with animal ears off the street. Astonishingly, the young man, who calls himself "Kento," turns out to be the wolf he saved when he was a kid! And, according to Kento, he needs to make love to his "master" lest his urges drive him berserk and make him eat someone! Hajime reluctantly becomes Kento's master, but he's so rough in bed, it feels like being devoured by a beast! And yet, he can't get enough of it... What will Hajime do with this overly affectionate wolf man who insists on pampering him?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Master, please give me everything you!

title.native: ダメご主人はオオカミくんがぺろり
title.romaji: Dame Goshujin wa Ookami-kun ga Perori

216325.description:
The one-eighty-degree transformation of an uncool, unassuming guy!

Suzu grew up amidst hardships because of her mother being deceived by terrible men all the time, so she only wants one thing now: to marry into money! Using her job at a tax accounting office as a pretext, she checks out handsome, rich men and uses her prettiness to get close to her targets. But one day, the morning after one such man rejects her, she wakes up next to Jogasaki, her unassuming superior at work... and they're naked! "Did you like my taste?" Suzu, who is inexperienced in bed despite looking like a man-eater, unwittingly gave her virginity to Jogasaki, and now he's relentlessly pursuing her! She decides to keep him as an in-betweener until she finds a better man, but destiny has other plans...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Wolf in Sheep's Clothing Is Eating Me Up!
title.native: 肉食系女子はニセモノ草食獣においしく食べられる
title.romaji: Nikushokukei Joshi wa Nisemono Soushokujuu ni Oishiku Taberareru

216326.description:
"I want you to want me honestly." If you say you want me, I'll give you all of me.

Irene, the oldest daughter of the Schonheit family and a tomboy who wants to become a lady, has her fiance stolen away by her younger sister. As a result, she's forced into a political marriage with a foreign warrior king called "the crazy lion" and ordered to convince him to give her country a certain territory the two countries have fought over. In order to become a queen that the king is head over heels with, Irene has her lady-in-waiting help her by bringing lewd books to learn all about bedroom techniques. The king is beautiful like a mythical creature but known to be a brute, and neither her acting nor her flattery work on him. But they finally reach their wedding night and he says, "I'll make it so you never lie to me again." Every time his fingers touch her lips, a beautifully hot and sweet feeling wells up inside of her...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: A Lovely Political Marriage with the "Crazy Lion" King
title.native: 狂獅子陛下と猫かぶり姫の、なんてすてきな政略結婚
title.romaji: Kyou Shishi Heika to Nekokaburi Hime no, Nante Suteki na Seiryaku Kekkon

216327.description:
A newlywed life with a childhood friend from a noble family. Unspeakable love is taught through kisses and caresses...

"As your husband, I will teach you about how a man and woman join together." The intensely passionate newlywed life of a nobleman and a young lady has begun! Anastasia, the daughter of a marquis from the Resnia Empire, married Duke Sergei, her childhood friend nine years her senior. Anastasia worries whether she is worthy of being the wife of this nobleman whom everyone admires. "I'm the luckiest man in the world to have you as my wife." Throughout their marital intimacy, from their wedding night onward, Sergei showers her with sweet kisses and caresses. Anastasia's love for him grows, and she wants to be a good wife to Sergei. But then, suspicions of his infidelity arise...!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.native: 桃色新婚生活～旦那さまからは逃げられない～

216332.description:
Akane, who spends most of her time in her childhood friend Kouta's room, is secretly aware of her feelings for him but can't bring herself to tell him.
Having never even had her first sexual experience, she suddenly worries that Kouta might already be a virgin...?
Then, inspired by something Kouta says, she tries to seduce him by showing him her ample breasts!
To her surprise, Kouta eagerly grabs her breasts, and she ends up feeling incredibly good!!
His practiced touch makes her wonder if he's actually experienced, so this time she spreads her legs and tries to seduce him...!?

(Source : melonbooks; translated)

Note : Published in Comic Bavel 2026-08

216340.description:
Kaho, who was picky about marrying a handsome, elite man, kept missing opportunities. She tried group dates and dating apps, but no one met her high standards. However, one day she realized that the perfect person was close by. It was Futa Horai, the vice president of Horai Holdings, the company where Kaho works. As the president's son, Futa is spoiled at work and can't do his job without the support of Kaho, the head of the secretarial department, but his original abilities are impeccable. Kaho sets her sights on winning Futa over and devises all sorts of strategies. Eliminating the women who flock to him, setting up drinking parties to be taken home by him... Or so she thought, until he suddenly asks, "Hey? Am I going to be eaten?" Huh? The contrast with his usual sweet demeanor is unbelievable! A strategic office romance between a strong-willed beauty and a cunning man☆

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 秘書課の悪女は、あざと王子を堕としたい

216343.description:
Genius investor Ha Si-Heon amassed hundreds of billions of won in assets on Wall Street. But just as he is dying from a rare disease that even money cannot cure, he regresses to 10 years earlier, back to when he was a rookie on Wall Street. After realizing that developing the new drug needed to cure his illness will require an astronomical amount of money, Si-Heon begins once again to amass a massive fortune in order to survive…

(Source: Naver translated)
synonyms: The Investment Method of a Wall Street Genius on Borrowed Time
The Wall Street Genius’s Limited-Time Investment Strategy
The Wall Street Genius’s Final Investment Playbook

A record of the hottest newcomers born from the fingertips of two legendary masters. The 'Hell Camp' short story collection, produced by Lee Hyeon-Se and Lee Du-Ho, is finally unveiled. Witness the overwhelming first steps of 23 rookies who will change the landscape of the webtoon world in 2026!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: あおくんのお姉ちゃん

216349.description: Note: Originally self-published, was then licensed by Futabasha for digital release.

216350.description:
High school boy Nanako decides to help out at “Nakatsuji,” a coffee shop run by his classmate's Nakatsuji's grandmother, for the duration of summer break. Nanako had always found Nakatsuji — who seemed aloof and hard to approach — difficult to deal with, but as they spend more time together, he discovers a surprisingly caring and kind side to him, and he begins to have feelings for him.

I want to know more about him.
I want to be closer to him.

Before he knew it, Nakatsuji was all he could think about…?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: A Blend of Love and Summer

title.native: LittleGiant! ─ロリ巨乳・低身長巨乳合同─
title.romaji: Little Giant!: Loli Kyonyuu Teishinchou Kyonyuu Goudou

216352.description:
What awaits her after she proposes breaking off her engagement? Doting love—!?

This anthology includes all-new, brand-new stories! The heroine herself proposes breaking off her engagement for her own happiness and the happiness of others, and heads towards happiness. And what awaits her there is doting love—!?

An anthology comic by seven talented artists.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I offered to break off my engagement and got a doting love!?

title.native: 婚約破棄を申し出たら溺愛を手に入れました!? アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Konyaku Haki wo Moushidetara Dekiai wo Te ni Iremashita!?: Anthology Comic

216353.description:
I, a corporate slave who had given up on life, fell unconscious one day in an accident—and somehow my consciousness was transferred to Royce, the youngest son of a noble family in another world! According to Royce's memories that came back to me, he could only use plain, non-elemental magic and had despaired of life due to being neglected by his family... "This time, I'm going to start my life over!" With that resolve, I persuaded my father to let me inherit an uninhabited frontier territory and became its lord. And as I began to hone my non-elemental magic, I discovered its true, extraordinary power—!?

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: 無属性魔法って地味ですか？　「派手さがない」と見捨てられた少年は最果ての領地で自由に暮らす
title.romaji: Muzokusei Mahou tte Jimi desu ka?: "Hadesa ga Nai" to Misuterareta Shounen wa Saihate no Ryouchi de Jiyuu ni Kurasu

216354.description:
"That melted face is so tempting."

The virile monarch and the beloved heroine's secret naughty encounter. With a possessive courtship that makes her body and soul ache—includes 5 intense R-rated short stories!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 激モテ君主様からなぜか溺愛執着されています!?アンソロジー ～淫らで一途な寵愛事情～
title.romaji: Gekimote Kunshu-sama kara Naze ka Dekiai Shuuchaku Sarete Imasu!? Anthology: Midara de Ichizu na Chouai Jijou

216355.description:
Karino receives a confession from Kusaka, a junior member of his film club. Despite Karino repeatedly telling him, "I'm the last guy you should go for," Kusaka was the cutest junior—and he refused to give up on expressing his feelings. On the night their feelings finally align, it turns out Karino has a secret trait that manifests while they're having sex...?

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

title.native: 今夜、ベラ・ヴィータで

216357.description:
I'm the only one who knows his secret. What is the sweet personality he's hiding behind ugly glasses?

Tadashi transfers to the company where Kasumi works. He has thick glasses, long bangs, a hunched back, and he speaks quietly. He's a dull man who is not typical of someone in Sales. But for some reason, Kasumi is intrigued by him. One day, Tadashi saves Kasumi from her sexually harassing manager. His suddenly sharp, wolf-like gaze is so charming that he seems like a completely different person from his usual, unreliable self!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: A Fake Proposal: My Tame Coworker is Actually a Wolf in Sheep's Clothing!
title.native: 偽装婚約～冴えない彼の正体はオオカミ御曹司でした～
title.romaji: Gisou Konyaku: Saenai Kare no Shoutai wa Ookami Onzoushi deshita

216358.description:
I am unable to resist the elite pilot's skillful love tactics! The cool and composed pilot suddenly transforms into someone who is hopelessly in love! I had vowed never to fall for a pilot, but with his tender and at times intense displays of affection, I can't help but feel my heart flutter at his overwhelming advances.

Serina, a twenty-eight-year-old airport concierge, prioritizes her work and hasn't been in a relationship for a while. Amid her busy days, she has a fateful encounter at a cafe with Hajime, who is seven years older than her. He seems cool at first, but once they get closer, he flashes a sweet smile. Serina begins to feel a spark she hasn't experienced in a long time. However, she later meets Hajime again at her workplace, where he works as a co-pilot. But Serina has a reason why she absolutely cannot fall in love with a pilot!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.native: 一途な恋人はパイロット～エアポートラブ～
title.romaji: Ichizu na Koibito wa Pilot: Airport Love

216359.description:
Cover Illustration: Mageyuishi Inuno
1. Goei Kishi to Ore dake no Amai Jikan: Himitsu no Hanazono ni Michibikarete (護衛騎士と俺だけの甘い時間 ～秘密の花園に導かれて～, Sweet Moments With Just Me and My Guardian Knight ~Led to the Secret Garden~) [Mageyuishi Inuno]
2. Omae no Hitomi wo Misetekure!: Mekakushi Koushaku Reisoku no Himitsu (お前の瞳を見せてくれ！ ～目隠し侯爵令息の秘密～, Show Me Your Eyes! ~The Secret of the Blindfolded Marquis's Son~) [Shigure x Yuki Mizoochi]
3. Ore wa Koshiginchaku no Konyakusha (俺は腰巾着の婚約者, I'm a "Koshiginchaki" Fiance) [Hakamaru x Wai Wasabiyama]
4. Mado Tatazumu wa Kimi ga Tame (窓佇むは君がため, I Stand by the Window, Just for You) [Yoshi Tsukizuki]
5. Seijo ni natta Ore wa Katabutsu Seikishi ni Dakaretai (聖女になった俺は堅物聖騎士に抱かれたい, Now That I've Become a Saint, I Want to Have Sex with a Strict Paladin) [Iyo Umino]

title.native: 異世界の執着攻めが俺をとろとろに愛し尽くす アンソロジー
title.romaji: Isekai no Shuuchaku Seme ga Ore wo Torotoro ni Aishi Tsukusu: Anthology

216360.description:
An isekai anthology themed around "wedding nights"!

Who will your wedding night partner be in your new world...? This isekai anthology comic features four love stories themed around wedding nights and men with unexpected sides to their personalities.

A woman-hating wolf king, a cold-hearted knight, a flirty fiancé, an arrogant prince...or so they were supposed to be!? You're sure to find a man with unexpected sides to your liking!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: この初夜、予想外につき。: ~転生したらいきなり初夜なんて聞いてません~
title.romaji: Kono Shoya, Yosougai ni Tsuki.: Tensei Shitara Ikinari Shoya Nante Kiitemasen

216361.description:
The straitlaced general has a secret passion! The innocent maiden blooms even as she's shy in front of her beloved general!

I'm going to put a mark on you to show that you're mine. Franca was taken by General Wendell from the neighboring country as his bride as the spoils of war when she was young. Years later, she's grown up to be a beautiful woman. She continues to show Wendell her affection, but he continues to treat her as a child. However, that was simply Wendell's own way of pushing down his desire for her. Something happens that makes Wendell let loose, so he physically shows his love for her on every part of her body over and over again. After that, every time they take each other to bed, their love continues to deepen. Despite their age difference, they spend a lot of intimate time together, but the former princess of Franca's lost country is now casting a suspicious shadow over their lives!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The General is Troubled by His Ardor
title.native: 将軍閣下は溺愛苦悩中
だってこんなの恋じゃない！
title.romaji: Datte Konna no Koi ja Nai!

synonyms: The Person I Love Second Best.

title.native: 甘めな彼の束縛注意報

216370.description:
The whispers, kisses, and touches of the beautiful prince are all overwhelmingly sweet!

"You're my soulmate." The love of the crown prince was sweet, lewd, and far too deep. Milia, a noble's daughter who worked as the princess's lady's maid, suddenly found a flower-shaped bruise on her body. It was proof that she was to be the bride of the crown prince, Elliot, who had recently come of age. She was shocked to have been chosen even though she didn't believe she was suited to him, seeing as she was from a low-ranking noble family. Milia couldn't wrap her head around it, so she asked the princess for a short vacation so she could go home to her family. However, Elliot left before her and stopped her in the middle of her travels. "I love you. I don't want to return you to your family." Elliot's overly sweet kisses and caresses taught Milia just how deeply he loved her!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Crown Prince is Too Sweet on Me!
title.native: 王太子さまの甘すぎる偏愛～おあずけは初夜まで～
title.romaji: Outaishi-sama no Amasugiru Henai: Oazuke wa Shoya made

title.native: 飛べない僕らは空を見ていた
title.romaji: Tobenai Bokura wa Sora wo Miteita

216372.description:
Kirihito is a young charcoal maker living in the mountains. He is given a mission: to serve the “Witch of the Library,” who is said to reside deep within the royal palace. A boy raised in the mountains and a witch who cannot speak. Their encounter sets the kingdom—and the world—into a major upheaval. The long-awaited manga adaptation of the wildly popular, authentic fantasy series from Kodansha Bungei!!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

216373.description:
I want you to stay smiling by my side.

Kasumi was proposed to on the very first day of meeting him. Her suitor was none other than Ichiya, a regular customer at the cafe where Kasumi works, affectionately known as the count with a sweet tooth. Kasumi had secretly been curious about Ichiya, who exuded an air of nobility like that of a count. However, for some reason, even though they weren't in a relationship, he suddenly asked her to help him build a family. At twenty-seven years old, with no romantic experience, Kasumi misunderstood this as a job offer under the guise of marriage.

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Hotel King Desperately Wants Proof of Our Love
title.native: 冷徹社長と子づくり婚～ホテル王は愛の証が欲しくてたまらない～
title.romaji: Reitetsu Shachou to Kozukuri Kon: Hotel Ou wa Ai no Akashi ga Hoshikute Tamaranai

216374.description:
A naive female scientist is being played with by her forceful, hot CEO! "Starting today, you're my girlfriend." We first meet because of a misunderstanding... and then I end up having to play the role of his girlfriend!

Haruka Ono, a scientist with no experience in love, ended up trying to snare her company's CEO, Takashi Kanzaki, in a honey trap in an attempt to stop him from canceling her research project. She attended a party dressed unusually for her, in high heels and a low-cut dress, and somehow ended up meeting him quite easily... He escorted her sweetly, looking at her with a passionate gaze as if they were lovers, and she almost forgot her true mission! However, it seems like Takashi was under some sort of misunderstanding!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: My Honeypot Strategy on the Arrogant CEO
title.native: 俺様社長と誘惑トラップ作戦
title.romaji: Ore-sama Shachou to Yuuwaku Trap Sakusen

216375.description:
Having just gone through a breakup, high school girl Dia goes to the beach with her best friend Rinya, hoping to meet someone new. While waiting to be approached by strangers at the beach, the one who called out to her was— the class’s introverted guy, Iikawa!? She says that the “popular” boys in their class forcibly brought him along, and as a punishment game they ordered him to go and call out to the two of them. For the sake of blowing off stress, the two of them make Iikawa play the “If you get an erection, you lose” game… Will they end up getting thoroughly drained by the two-piece black-and-white gyaru team!!? Under the clear blue sky, perfect for sex, the thrilling 3P start♪♪

Note: Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2026-09.

216376.description:
I married him because he said we'd hunt bears, but he turns out to be the emperor's illegitimate child?! I had no idea!!

Despite being a marquis's daughter, Ralphine grew up on a rural estate for reasons unknown. With her exceptional athletic abilities and competitive spirit, she is known as the "Wild Lady," renowned both as a hunter and as the leader of the village children. At the age of 13, she reluctantly attended her debut ceremony at the imperial palace as a noble's duty, but her unruly behavior caught the eye of knight Selmiane, leading to her being married and sent to the imperial capital. However, this supposedly poor knight is actually the illegitimate son of the current emperor—!? A wild young lady and the strongest knight hiding his true identity embark on a doting, rags-to-riches adventure!

(Source: Shufu to Seikatsu Sha, translated)

title.native: 貧乏騎士に嫁入りしたはずが!? 野人令嬢は皇太子妃になっても竜を狩りたい
title.romaji: Binbou Kishi ni Yomeiri Shita Hazu ga!? Yajin Reijou wa Koutaishihi ni Natte mo Ryuu wo Karitai

216377.description:
Kouta returns home for the Obon festival. This year, he visits the home of his older sister, Sumika, who has looked after him since childhood, bringing a gift. As they reminisce, the atmosphere between them gradually becomes more intimate...♪ A sweet, intense, refreshing, yet slightly bittersweet coming-of-age story set against the backdrop of rural scenery, featuring a mischievous older sister type beauty!!!

Note: Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2026-09.

216378.description:
1. Saiinhata de Tsukamaete (催淫畑でつかまえて); Saipuni! 7-genme
2. Hokenshitsu no Himitsu (保健室のひみつ); Saipuni! 8-genme
3. Chicchai Mama ni Amaetai (ちっちゃいママに甘えたい); Saipuni! 9-genme
4. Tanoshii Oisha-san Gokko (たのしいお医者さんごっこ); Saipuni! 6-genme
5. Otokoyu no Mascot-chan (男湯のマスコットちゃん); Saipuni! 5-genme

216379.description:
One day, a young man picks up a pair of underwear that had fallen on the ground. It apparently belonged to Shiori, the neighbor’s laundry that the wind had blown over. Having been caught picking it up, and even having his photo taken, the young man is branded a “panty thief”… and to get Shiori to stay quiet, he becomes Shiori’s fleshlight. But Shiori’s demands know no end. He’s called out at convenient times for Shiori and endlessly drained, forced to do nothing but cunnilingus for two hours—his pervy and grueling days begin…! Can the young man, who’s kept being treated like a fleshlight, truly be able to understand and outsmart this extremely erotic married woman!?!?!?

Note: Published in COMIC Shitsurakuten 2026-10.
synonyms: How to get along with your neighbors

216380.description: I got possessed right before graduating from graduate school. Before finding a way back, I decided to enjoy some of the pleasures I had put off due to studying. Like dating, dating, and more dating. As luck would have it, the face of the man who moved in next door was just my type, so I made up my mind to date him. "C-Can I keep my robe on? I'm too shy to show my face..." Sure, he's a nerd who clings to his robe just like an engineering student clings to their plaid shirt. "...If I were that Master of the Magic Tower, would you abandon me?" It seems this nerdy guy is the exact same person as that notoriously psychopathic Master of the Magic Tower. Well, isn't that not really a big problem? Compared to the fact that the world of the novel I thought was a romance is actually a horror survival thriller targeting my life.
synonyms: The Nerd Next Door Turned Out To Be The Magic Tower Master

216383.description:
From the gifted creator behind "A Velvet Farewell" comes a story of the bond between a human and an android.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

216384.description:
South Korea, a country brought to ruin by a zombie apocalypse. “The Suitor”—his goal is simple: to find his true love! As he sets out on a journey to find the bride who awaits him somewhere, he encounters not only hordes of zombies but also survivors filled with distrust and selfishness! Will he be able to overcome all these hardships and find the woman of his destiny? Does true love even exist in this zombie-infested world?

(Source: Naver, translated)

216385.description:
Lee Young-Jin. Twenty-nine years old. Orphan. Convenience Store Master. He came to Seoul with just five million won and, after his business acumen was recognized at a convenience store in Seongbuk-dong, on the very night he was set to become the store’s owner…

He was struck by a damn delivery truck and met his untimely end… but he finds himself possessed by the body of the villainous prince from the crappy game he used to be obsessed with. I. Wolfram von Lohengrin. Prince. Ousted student council president. An intro-scene villain who gets his head chopped off… but I refuse to die again the moment I die! Love and adventure are the protagonists’ domain anyway. From now on, my dream is to be the owner of a convenience store in this other world. As a convenience store master wielding amazing skills worthy of a true “rotten scum” character, I’ll clean out the pockets of everyone at the academy!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Healing at the Academy Convenience Store

216386.description:
Beom-Gu, South Korea’s greatest shaman, is plunged into despair in an instant by the death of General Mu-Yeong, the deity he serves. There is only one way to revive the deity: “Oh shaman! Enter the trauma of a murder case and slay the evil spirit.” By saving the worst of the victims, will Shaman Beom-Gu be able to save himself?

(Source: Naver, translated)

216387.description:
The intertwined fates and love triangles of wolves, each bearing their own wounds and pursuing their own goals. Having resolved to fight rather than flee in the harsh wilderness, will they survive the brutal territorial war and form their own pack? A fierce and majestic epic of survival featuring a pack of wandering wolves!

(Source: Naver, translated)

216388.description:
“Just like my sisters, I’ll seduce men and wrap them around my little finger—one by one!”

Long ago, in an age of myths and mountains, a family of gumiho sisters thrived by charming travelers and stealing their essence. Life was sweet—until the youngest, Arang, suddenly declares she’s heading to the human world to seduce a man of her own. Mischievous, naïve, and fiercely determined, Arang is ready to unleash her foxy charm. But in the world of humans, love doesn’t always follow the rules of magic... and this little fox might just get caught in her own trap.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: จิ้งจอกสาวฝึกหัดรัก

216389.description:
Multiple top and bottom characters appear. Sergeant Han's life is completely shaken by the newly appointed Major Park. In the military, various villains are targeting him like hunters prey. Where will it all end...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

216391.description:
Demigod Yun Yeo-Myeong was on the verge of becoming a true transcendent being until an accident stripped him of his divine power and bound him in sleep. Generations later, an attack by a fanatic cult triggers that stolen divine energy inside a young man named Nam Si-On, finally waking Yeo-Myeong from his slumber. Yeo-Myeong descends to the human realm intent on killing Si-On to reclaim his divine core. However, staying by the guarded human's side quickly turns from a tedious task into a fascinating game. When the cult targets them both to sacrifice to their master, Yeo-Myeong and Si-On are forced into a deadly struggle where recovering lost divinity pales in comparison to protecting each other.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: けだものがたり─帝都の狐と醜い花嫁─
title.romaji: Kedamonogatari: Teito no Kitsune to Minikui Hanayome

title.native: 既成事実からはじまる婚約生活～毒舌公爵様は偽り悪女を溺愛する～
title.romaji: Kisei Jijitsu kara Hajimaru Konyaku Seikatsu: Dokuzetsu Koushaku-sama wa Itsuwari Akujo wo Dekiai Suru

title.native: クズ騎士様の愛は激重につき！
title.romaji: Kuzu Kishi-sama no Ai wa Geki Juu ni Tsuki!

title.native: ステルス令嬢の恋愛事情　ご主人様の秘密を知ってしまったら溺愛されまして!?
title.romaji: Stealth Reijou no Renai Jijou Goshujin-sama no Himitsu wo Shitte Shimattara Dekiai Saremashite!?

216398.description:
Can a tomato field really become the foundation of a nation?! An exiled priest builds a kingdom from the ground up!

Cello, a priest of light, shields the Hero from the Sixth Demon Lord's curse—only to be transformed into a demon himself. As his reward, he is cast out of the Hero's party and forcibly teleported far away. At his destination, Cello encounters Lucy, the Sixth Demon Lord's daughter, who recognizes in him the potential to become a Demon Lord. Together with the demons now serving under him, Cello sets out to develop his new territory. Then, one day, the Hero's party arrives to eliminate him. But when they venture into the tomato field outside Cello's castle, they discover monsters lurking among the crops—each one enhanced by Cello's abilities!

What was supposed to be a simple field of tomatoes may prove to be the most unconquerable dungeon of all!

(Source: Hanashi Media, edited)

title.native: 魔王スローライフを満喫する～勇者から「攻略無理」と言われたけど、そこはダンジョンじゃない。トマト畑だ～
title.romaji: Maou Slow Life wo Mankitsu Suru: Yusha kara "Kouryaku Mura" to Iwareta kedo, Soko wa Dungeon Janai. Tomato Hatake da

216399.description:
He who conquers the dungeon conquers the beauties! Summoned to another world, I choose to live as a "Dungeon Master," and this is a pleasure fantasy anthology in which I manipulate beautiful adventurers one after another with my wit and pleasure weapons = erotic traps. Female knights, sisters, mages, beast girls—even brave, pure, and proud heroines are powerless against the lewd traps set in the dungeon. Entangling tentacles, trembling restraints, mysterious mechanisms that keep spinning like waterwheels... Their pride is shattered to pieces, and they fall into a vortex of pleasure—a must-see! "Is it the prey that's caught in the trap, or me?" The catharsis of building and dominating the dungeon and cornering the heroines from an absolute position is filled with a decadent charm not found in other isekai stories. A gem of an anthology that pierces the "desires" of young readers head-on. As the master of the dungeon, all that remains is for you to conquer the beauties as the strongest ruler!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title.native: 異世界ダンジョンマスター無双アンソロジー ~俺のエロトラップでヒロイン絶対絶頂~
title.romaji: Isekai Dungeon Master Musou Anthology: Ore no Ero Trap de Heroine Zettai Zecchou

216400.description:
Do you like men with intense love? This anthology contains five stories of obsessive love romances spun by pure and innocent heroines and yandere princes. To love, to be loved, and to be obsessed over────a yandere anthology where you are trapped in sweet, deep, and persistent love!

(Source: Jitsugyou no Nihonsha, translated)

title.native: 執着ヤンデレに愛されすぎて　異世界恋愛アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Shuuchaku Yandere ni Aisare Sugite: Isekai Renai Anthology Comic

216401.description:
Mizuki Amamiya (28) is suddenly dumped by her younger boyfriend, who is pursuing his dream of becoming a comedian. "I even quit my temp job because we promised to move to Osaka together! You've got to be kidding me...!?" She works hard at her job search every day and finally lands an interview at the famous company BLEEZE Co., Ltd. She is lucky enough to be hired, but she ends up becoming the personal secretary to Masayoshi Mogami (38), who is known as a tyrannical boss within the company!! "Can I really handle being the secretary to someone so strict...──?" Mizuki is on the verge of giving up as she is constantly being scolded, but she finds herself drawn to Mogami's clumsy kindness and unexpected side...──.

(Source: Mecha Comic, translated)
synonyms: I have become the secretary to my tyrant boss.

title.native: このたび鬼上司の秘書になりまして
title.romaji: Kono Tabi Oni Joushi no Hisho ni narimashite

216402.description:
"Wow, being a villainess is actually pretty easy!" Sashna reincarnated as a villainous daughter in the world of a romance novels her grandchildren had once told her about in her previous life. Having lived her life to the fullest in her previous life, she is determined to protect the happy ending of her favorite novel's heroine and not change the story by playing the villainess to the fullest...or so she thought, but she can't get rid of her gentle personality from before reincarnation and has a hard time becoming the villain. Sashna is excited to attend her first evening party, but she almost changes the story right away... For some reason, she is treated like a loser by her fiancé's guardian knight, who is supposed to be her ally, but Sashna desperately tries to protect the story. -But what lies ahead is an unexpected truth...?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title.native: 破滅ルートを目指し、完璧な悪役令嬢になってみせますっ！～推しのため当て馬をやり遂げたいのに、無愛想な護衛騎士様がやたらと絡んできます～
title.romaji: Hametsu Route wo Mezashi, Kanpeki na Akuyaku Reijou ni Natte Misemasu!: Oshi no Tame Ateuma wo Yaritogetai no ni, Buaisou na Goei Kishi-sama ga Yatara to kara nde Kimasu

216403.description:
Amidst the sudden appearance of monsters, the magical girl Astra Nova appeared to save the people from danger. However, while the magical girl Erina was engaged in a fierce battle against the monsters, she let her guard down for just a moment and ends up being captured by the villain Nox. Erina begins to experience strange sensations little by little in response to Nox's secretive and suggestive demands...

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)
synonyms: 魔法少女☆快楽堕ちなんてしません！

216405.description:
"I have no intention of letting you go to anyone else." Who would have thought that deciding on divorce would lead to an unexpectedly sweet and indulgent life?

Chizuru thought she was loved by her husband, Hiromasa, but when she learned their marriage was a political arrangement, she was devastated and handed him divorce papers. However, Hiromasa responded with a possessive kiss, declaring, "I will never let you go." Although he had always been kind and caring toward Chizuru, from that day on, his affection became even more indulgently sweet. Now overwhelmed by his intense devotion and his tender whispers, Chizuru finds herself utterly confused!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: I'm Loved, But Let's Get Divorced
title.native: 愛されていますが離婚しましょう～許嫁夫婦の片恋婚～
title.romaji: Aisareteimasu ga Rikon Shimashou: Iinazuke Fuufu no Katakoi Kon

216406.description:
A pure love story that starts with a reunion with someone she admired...

New employee Hanao Arikawa has someone she admires. That person is former model and charismatic company president Ryoichi Ikeuchi. She's happy just to be able to work close to him... or so she thought, but soon after joining the company, they unexpectedly become close! Ryoichi is touched by Hanao's simple and earnest personality. He can't help but pay attention to her. Meanwhile, there's something Hanao really wants to tell Ryoichi... "Ryo, I've met you before."

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The High-Profile President Cherishes His Little Flower
title.native: 高嶺の社長は小花を愛でたい
title.romaji: Takane no Shachou wa Kobana wo Medetai

216407.description:
Kang Da-Hye, a long-term unemployed woman living an ordinary, failed life. On the day yet another chance for a permanent position slipped away, she regresses back to her second year of high school.

“I can’t believe I’m a high school student again!”

This time, she lives her life to the fullest. She gets all the answers right on the CSAT. She gets into Korea University and lands a job right on the spot during her final semester. She lives diligently with that mindset, but the boys around her keep bothering her.

“Kang Da-Hye. You’re the second most hated person in our class.”

Jung Eun-Sung, who was there when she regressed. The main vocalist of a male idol group that debuts a year later and becomes a massive hit.

“Da-Hye, did you happen to see where Ji-Suis?”

Seo Jae-Gyeom, whom she had a crush on back then. The illegitimate son of a chaebol family where her mom worked as a housekeeper. They are both incredibly handsome, but...

“There’s nothing you don’t know. Then you must know exactly how much I like you.”

“Can’t you like me again? I was wrong......”

Guys, I’m busy studying...!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: 偽物だと敵国に追放されましたが、どうやら本物の聖女は私のようです。

216409.description:
I'm happy as long as Umeno is happy.

Umeno, who lost her love and her job, reunites with her childhood friend Kyounosuke for the first time in six years. He was born into a gangster family but decided to live in the same world as Umeno. Now, he has left the family business and started his own company, working as a genius businessman. "Why don't you come to my company and give me a chance to woo you?" Umeno is invited by Kyounosuke to work at his company. But as soon as she arrives, Kyounosuke, who is said to be as cold and sharp as ice within the company, launches an extremely sweet and aggressive attack on her!"

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

216410.description:
After a lifetime of being treated like an outsider, former knight and princess Annette Hayworth is sent into a political marriage to Grand Duke Cardin Harzent, a man said to resemble a hideous monster. But when her carriage is attacked on her way to the empire, she finds herself turned into a child. Instead of fear and rejection, Annette is now surrounded by people who accept her as she is, including the grand duke, who seems to be completely obsessed with her. Why is everyone doting on her, and will she be able to get back to her adult self?

(Source: WEBTOON)

คุณคู่หมั้นคะ ฉันโตแล้วนะ
Mon fiancé me prend pour un bébé

title.english: My Fiancé Won't Stop Babying Me

216411.description:
Kasumi Kuromine has always been a girl who speaks her mind—and she butts heads with her classmates for it. But when the fierce yet openhearted middle schooler tumbles down a hillside while trying to save one on a school field trip, she wakes up in an impossible place: a mysterious inn where lost memories can be found. What she discovers there…promises to change everything she thought she knew about herself.

(Source: K MANGA)

216412.description:
Grace, the head of the House of Ellysia – known as both a saint and a demon for her mysterious ability to turn back time – had saved countless lives. Yet, she could never cure her own illness.

“I’m so tired… I just want to rest.”

Just as she finally found peace in death…

“Where am I?”

“Three hundred years have passed since I died?”

Suddenly, she finds herself in the body of Ceres – the eldest daughter of a completely ruined noble house! Well, 300 years or whatever – that’s all fine and dandy, but…

“Excuse me, have you happened to see my blue stone?”

“If you can’t pay with money, pay with your body.”

“Drop dead!”

"…Can’t I just live a quiet life for once?"

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: A Woman Who Turn Back Time Ceres

216413.description:
She fell into a sinkhole that suddenly appeared on her way home from work and became possessed by the character in her favorite horror game, The Devil's House. And to top it all off, she was the very first victim of a psychopathic serial killer!

“You’re quick-witted, aren’t you? I was planning to get rid of you right away if you made any noise.”

Silas said this with a bright smile on his handsome face. However, the meaning behind those words was so chilling that it sent shivers down her spine. How could she survive? She tried to think it over with her hair turned white, but having not yet seen the ending, she had no idea. Then...

“H-Honey! Don’t you remember me?”

To survive against the amnesiac psychopath, she decided to pretend to be his wife.
synonyms: Surviving as a Serial Killer's Wife

216414.description:
"I don't think I'll be able to hold back even if you want to stop." She can't refuse the vice-president's sweet advances!

"Does it feel good down here?" Hiroaki's fingers stroke across Yuzu's body... Yuzu, an office worker, works part-time even though her company doesn't allow it. The company's vice-president, Hiroaki, who is nicknamed the "Prissy Prince," finds out about this, but he actually suffers from insomnia. Seeing Yuzu's soft body, Hiroaki asks her to be his "body pillow" in exchange for overlooking her breaking the rules. Yuzu works hard to help him sleep well. Hiroaki opens up to her and hands her the key to his apartment, but one day, when he arrives late after entertaining a business client, she learns of his carnivorous side! Their hearts grow closer despite their differences, but there's a major challenge awaiting them!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

216415.description:
After the Demon Lord's defeat, the remaining demons fled to the Dark Realm. A thousand years later, on the verge of extinction, demonkind decides to invade the human world again in one final struggle for survival. However, the world they return to after years in the darkness isn't the same as it once was.

Humans have turned against their fellow man. Downtrodden and defeated, the poor find an unlikely ally: the same demons who terrorized humanity a thousand years ago. Together with the demons, they fight against the world's victors, the ones who hold all the power, to gain their freedom and create a world they can call home.

(Source: Steam)

After returning to Japan, she unexpectedly encounters Miyano again at her new job…

In my village, every summer, boys of the same age are gathered together for their first sexual experience...
The person I wanted to be with was Azusa, the older girl from the neighborhood who's always been so kind to me.
But my childhood friend and bully, Take, was also after Azusa.
I've never been able to beat Take in anything since we were kids. I was sure Azusa would choose Take...
That's what I thought, but Azusa chose me instead...!?

216458.description:
Mashiro and Shu are lovers. Lately, Shu has noticed that Mashiro, a member of the disciplinary committee, is dressed in strange, anachronistic clothes for morning assembly, and it seems that this is due to the influence of the erotic manga "The Student Council President Who Was Framed and Fell into NTR," which she has been secretly reading. Knowing this, Shu hatches a wicked plan. The next morning, Shu immediately goes to bother Mashiro during the morning assembly. "You must be working hard every day without getting bored," he says to the younger male student standing next to Mashiro, who admires her, "It must be tough having to put up with this every morning." It seems that these lines and the sequence of events are the same as in that erotic manga... What is Shu thinking...?! Getting carried away, Mashiro even touches his butt, and she ends up slapping Shu hard across the cheek with her bamboo sword. It hurts so much that Shu doubles over. A crowd gathers, and it seems like this is going to turn into a big deal. As Mashiro tries to somehow end the situation, Shu whispers something in her ear. "When lunchtime comes—" The erotic manga play will continue in the empty student council room in the early afternoon—!!

216460.description:
Yuzuki, the classmate in the same class, has a flashy look, but she’s also doing well academically—she’s bright and one of the most popular people in the class. She seems to have a habit of making weird misunderstandings because words fly wildly around in her head, which is a bit of a blemish, but lately, the classmate who’s so popular is somehow getting way too close. Thinking, “I should warn her,” I explained the situation to her—but it turns out she thinks she’s dating me!? How could something like this happen…? And on top of that, she’s full of service-mindedness toward me—the boyfriend she only thinks I am—so without me even saying anything out loud, her misunderstandings go off like crazy, and she eagerly does everything from abnormal play to sweet, tender play…. With these suddenly started, incredibly lucky days, will I be able to tell her the truth!?!?!?

(Source : Melonbooks, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2026-09.

216462.description:
I'll make my dream home a reality in another world!

Kinoshita Takeru, a high school student, is transported to another world through class transfer. While his classmates are recognized as heroes and sages, the job Takeru is given is...--[Construction Company]!? With zero combat ability, he is put in charge of the castle lord of the frontier land of Gaurea! However, Gaurea Fortress has a terrible sanitary environment that would be unthinkable in modern Japan... "I might be able to improve it if I use this power!!" Unable to bear it any longer, Takeru uses the power of his [Construction Company] to renovate the fortress in a modern style!? A production-oriented DIY slow-life other-world fantasy begins, making full use of the special job of [Construction Company]!

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

216463.description:
“Riding in with leeks like a duck… you came!!!!!!”

Sister Hakua nd her younger sister Juraku, miko sisters who are trying to make an erotic cosplay photo book to earn money for repairs to their shrine. They want to earn without doing anything too lewd… but they can’t earn unless they do something lewd… at least, like before, with customers coming in for purification…? “They came!?!?”

To make sure we don’t let the customers who went out of their way to come slip away, we’ll use a special miko outfit and secret essential oils for an erotic massage done by both of us… and if the impurities have built up and can’t be fully removed, then the Honban too… Let’s begin the cleansing ritual with all our heart ♪

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

Puu-chan, a married woman, is a girl with a secret social media account who posts slightly erotic selfies without telling her husband.
She's bored of being left alone at home every day because her overprotective husband keeps nagging her! So, she posted her real address on social media! She thought it would be okay since she deleted it right away... but when she woke up, a fan had shown up!? She doesn't really understand what's going on, but he's complimenting her sexy body, so I guess it's all good!

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

216466.description:
My boss at my part-time job is being way too pushy...!?
Ichinose-kun works part-time at a bookstore that also sells adult goods.
He's somehow overwhelmed by customers who confidently buy products catering to their unusual sexual preferences. He's always worried about his lack of self-confidence, but maybe it would be better if he could be this confident...
Ichinose-kun ends up drinking at the home of his female boss, who's always been friendly with him. As he confides his worries to her, the boss starts acting shy.
"I thought you might be interested in this product," the boss says, handing him the sex toy and adult video that the customer had just bought.
"No, that's not it! What's not it?" The boss continues to be pushy, and Ichinose-kun unexpectedly gets an erection. The boss then tries out the sex toy on him...!?
A late-night lesson begins... to give me the confidence to be a man!

216467.description:
Masaki, a literature student, is invited to the room of a female classmate, Amanoi, who asks him to critique a novel she's written.
However, the novel she's written is an erotic one... Masaki was called because his reputation as a womanizer is well-known throughout the department.
Honestly, Masaki wanted to sleep with Amanoi, but he wanted to avoid a woman who would make him read her own erotic novel... or so he thought. But he couldn't resist her large breasts...
And so, a series of casual, easygoing sexual encounters began...

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2026-09.

216468.description:
My childhood friend, Chiyo, started working as a maid in the mansion of a wealthy local family. She was supposed to be doing it to earn money for her sick mother's medical treatment... but Chiyo became increasingly engrossed in her work. She even started dozing off in class and said she was giving up her dream of becoming a nurse. Worried about Chiyo, I impulsively went to the mansion.
I was greeted by the master of the house and... Chiyo, her face flushed.
When I asked what she was doing in the mansion... Chiyo lifted her skirt as ordered by the master and began kissing him!
Another maid, Elena, held me down as I tried to intervene to save Chiyo. Forced to watch Chiyo and the master's lewd behavior unfold before my eyes...

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2026-09.

title.romaji: Shiki Oriori no Kimi to, 1-nenbun no Koi wo Suru

title.native: アキバこんぷれっくす！

synonyms: Mitsuki's Plan To Make Him Fall

title.native: 恋する美月くんの陥落計画

216483.description: After spending years in prison for a crime he was forced to take the blame for, a man returns to society with a new identity and a burning desire for revenge. As he becomes entangled with the powerful forces that ruined his life, he must survive a dangerous game of deception, violence, and betrayal.

216484.description:
Pulled into her diary, you come to understand her pain and her love all over again!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

216485.description:
Ichika, the eldest daughter of a large family, had been busy taking care of her younger siblings in addition to her hotel job since her mother's death. Because of this, she had no time for romance, and although she finally found an fiancé, unavoidable circumstances led to their breakup. Exhausted by everything, Ichika went to a hotel bar to soothe her broken heart. There, she met a handsome man, Takahisa, who comforted her kindly, and they spent the night together… A passionate night filled with lust and intoxication—it should have ended as a good memory, but when they met again, Takahisa approached her passionately…?! The long-awaited comic adaptation of the Cinderella story between Ichika, who can't bring herself to be positive about romance, and Takahisa, who acts like a gentleman but whispers sweet words of love!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: エリートホテルマンは最愛の人に一途に愛を捧ぐ
title.romaji: Elite Hotel Man wa Saiai no Hito ni Ichizu ni Ai wo Sasagu

216486.description:
If you take their hand, no words are needed. A laid-back ferryman and a heartbroken mermaid princess. A mercenary who will do anything for money and a lonely, timid girl. An eccentric grandfather and his grandson. Four other stories are also included. These are tales spun by the hands of people living quietly somewhere in the world.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: And Then They Held Their Hands

title.native: そしてふたりは手をとった
title.romaji: Soshite Futari wa Te wo Totta

216487.description: Note: Originally published as a one-shot, was then picked up for serialization.

title.native: ポッピン・ポッピン・ペナルティ

synonyms: With Your Name in My End Credits

title.native: エンドロールには君の名前を
title.romaji: Endroll ni wa Kimi no Namae wo

216490.description:
“Whoever gets in my way dies!”

One day, Dae Do-O appeared on the battleground between the Iron Flag Alliance and the Nine Dragon’s Cult. He is the captain of the Joker Squad, a sub-unit of the Iron Flag Alliance’s Black Flag Hall. Contrary to their name, the Joker Squad accumulated many accomplishments on the battlefield.

At the same time, unknown enemies are plotting against both the Iron Flag Alliance and the Nine Dragon’s Cult. What will happen next? What will Dae Do-O do?

The battle for survival begins now!
synonyms: 大刀傲～何がなんでも生き残る～

216491.description: A meteorite fell. Seven winged children were born, and one of these heroes will become the king of this country. And there was only one child whose wings were not plucked.

216492.description:
“Strength and power, that’s all there is in this world.”

As someone living a poverty-stricken life, Yunfei, an orphan of the Donghua Clan, is considered the weakest in the world simply because he lacks power. To escape this wretched fate, he chooses the path of a eunuch. Yunfei receives the seed of the ultimate martial arts technique, the Extreme Yin Art of Bai Yihong, and becomes part of the emperor’s special forces as part of the [Great Murim Extermination Plan].

In this era of great upheaval, amidst constant intrigues and fierce power struggles, the story follows the escapades of “Yunfei”, a master of deceit and cruelty, as he navigates the world of martial arts with his ice arts!

title.native: 人魚を助ける。クラスメイトを好きになる。
title.romaji: Ningyo wo Tasukeru. Classmate wo Suki ni Naru.

title.native: 初恋のアラサー負けヒロインがラブコメ後遺症を卒業してくれない
title.romaji: Hatsukoi no Arasaa Make Heroine ga Love Come Koishou wo Sotsugyoushite Kurenai

216496.description:
Moyu, the eldest daughter going through a rebellious phase; Kotori, the second daughter who is a bit shy; and Fumi, the energetic third daughter. Three sisters along with their older brother, the close-knit Rindo siblings were living their usual, heartwarming daily lives.
But one day, the sisters discover that their brother is moving into a university dormitory next year...?!
The final year for the older brother and the three sisters, the days of moratorium begin now.

title.native: あいまいモラトリウム

synonyms: The Marquis, the Collector of Beauties, Is an Exception

216498.description:
It has been one year since the war against the zombies that swept across the globe came to an end. A reporter begins interviewing survivors of the war.

(Source: Naver, translated)

synonyms: Erica - When a Friend Is Obsessed With Me

216500.description:
Tae-Ho and Ji-Ho, siblings who suddenly lost both their parents when their father murdered their mother. Faced with an overwhelming reality, Tae-Ho decides to become a master of home-cooked meals for his younger brother, Ji-Ho.

Social worker Kyu-Jin, known for being a picky eater, hears about their situation and decides he cannot simply leave them to fend for themselves. He visits their home to try to connect them with a shelter, only to find himself completely helpless against Tae-Ho’s home-cooked meal offensive.

Ji-Ho, who finds strength just by thinking about food no matter how hard things get, and Tae-Ho, who hones his cooking skills for Ji-Ho’s sake— Kyu-Jin finds that Tae-Ho’s food suits his taste exceptionally well. Before they knew it, the three of them began to resemble a “family,” for whom eating together no longer felt awkward. And they even made new friends through “Seum,” a child welfare organization established for the children of inmates. Mealtimes, which Tae-Ho and Ji-Ho used to spend alone, or sometimes in lonely solitude, have now become the most joyful part of their day.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

216501.description: Yodaka and his friends are assigned to create a creative dance for their physical education class. For Hibari, who has been struggling to get closer to Aoi, the girl she's supposed to protect, this presents a golden opportunity. Determined not to miss this chance, she immediately launches a fierce attack…!? The hugely popular loner ninja action series from Weekly Shonen Jump is finally getting its first novelization!!

title.native: しのびごと A Day in the Life【BIRDS】
title.romaji: Shinobigoto: A Day in the Life [BIRDS]

title.native: 岩元先輩ノ推薦 陸軍栖鳳中秘文書
title.romaji: Iwamoto-senpai no Suisen: Rikugun Seihou Chuu Hibunsho

ディープ・ブルー・アビス
キン肉マン 悪魔超人熱海旅行殺人事件

216509.description:
The Hero defeats the Demon King and saves the world! But finding an ordinary job turns out to be an even harder quest... Then, at his final job interview, he discovers that the company chairwoman is none other than the Demon King herself?!

(Source: Toomics)

title.native: ラーメン赤猫 毎日が千客万来!
title.romaji: Ramen Aka Neko: Mainichi ga Senkyaku Banrai

title.native: ラーメン赤猫 本日も接客一番!
title.romaji: Ramen Aka Neko: Honjitsu mo Sekkyaku Ichiban!

title.native: つよくてかわいい暴君さま
ジャックジャンヌ 七つ風

216514.description:
Note:
- Originally published as a one-shot in LiQulle pathos Vol.1, was later picked up for serialization.
- Includes one extra chapter.

216516.description:
In the blood-and-gunpowder-filled world of the mafia, Nico was raised as a top-class hitman. However, the shock of his best friend Noah's murder led him to flee the organization, and he now lives a peaceful life as a junk shop and handyman in town.

He meets a new partner, Ateka, and tries to overcome his past trauma through his daily life... but his former mafia boss hasn't forgotten Nico's exceptional skills as a hitman. A chilling plan is underway to force him to pledge allegiance to the organization once again and bring him back to his side...

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

synonyms: If You Win, I'll Do Anything You Want

title.native: 勝ったら何でもシてアゲる

216518.description:
Culture club boy x Sports club girl. A cross-cultural exchange rom-com where if you retort, you lose!

"Machino-san of the swimming club always stops by the domino club—where I'm the only member—before her own practice begins. She relentlessly sets up jokes in skit-style conversations, and I can't help but retort. The back-and-forth of our banter. Love, and idle chatter. The clubroom during summer vacation, where every day was a moment, yet felt like an eternity. But when this summer ends, their dominoes will all start to fall at once—"

"What's gotten into you, Machino-san, suddenly narrating a synopsis that sounds like it's from a light novel?"

"There's no such thing as a gyaru who's kind to an otaku! But a sports club girl who'll get along with a culture club boy... there might be a chance for that—!? The cross-cultural exchange rom-com begins now!"

"And you've even mastered the use of that mysterious '—!?' unique to light novel synopses—!?"

title.native: ツッコミ待ちの町野さん
今夜、エーテルで待ちあわせ

216520.description:
Despite being a countess's daughter, Olivia is completely devoted to her work. As the assistant to Arthur, a workaholic feared as the "Ice Prime Minister," she handles an extraordinary workload day and night. Although she harbors feelings for Arthur, she suppresses them, believing their love is unworthy. But then, he suddenly proposes to her! And, for the sake of her work (?), she accepts without hesitation...!?

(Source: Overlap, translated)
synonyms: The countess who likes work misjudges the love of the ice prime minister

title.native: 仕事人間な伯爵令嬢は氷の宰相様の愛を見誤っている
title.romaji: Shigoto Ningen na Hakushaku Reijou wa Koori no Saishou-sama no Ai wo mi Ayamatteiru

216523.description:
"Today, let's try a rom-com where people can see through clothes!"

At the Secondary Literature Research Club, club president and aspiring editor Aira Takiuchi proposes outrageous rom-com settings for the club to experiment with. But to the aspiring novelist Sakka Sasai, those settings suddenly become reality, starting with Aira-senpai's clothes actually becoming see-through.
As they use a mysterious power that turns fictional settings into reality, the aspiring writer and aspiring editor work together to create one rom-com plot after another.
synonyms: Aira-senpai, the Editor Who Keeps Giving Me Gimmicky Character Settings

title.native: 出オチみたいな設定を付与してくる編集のアイラ先輩
title.romaji: Deochi Mitai na Settei wo Fuyo Shite Kuru Henshuu no Aira-senpai

216524.description:
Ryuuzaki-san, known as the most beautiful girl in our grade, is strangely cold toward me. Whenever our eyes meet, she glares at me like I'm a piece of trash. Then one day, I end up seeing something unbelievable about her. Ryuuzaki-san isn't human at all. She's a Dragonkin.

"P-Please don't stare at me that much!"

The school's top beauty shows only me her true face, and it turns out she's unexpectedly dere, leaving me completely flustered.
synonyms: The Reasons Why Ryuuzaki-san Only Shows Her Sweet Side to Me

title.native: 竜崎さんが俺の前だけでデレるリユウ
title.romaji: Ryuuzaki-san ga Ore no Mae dake de Dereru Riyuu

title.native: 育成失敗と言われた元国民的美少女に手を貸したら、俺にだけ甘えてくるようになった
title.romaji: Ikusei Shippai to Iwareta Moto Kokuminteki Bishoujo ni Te wo Kashitara, Ore ni Dake Amaete Kuru You ni Natta

216526.description:
Kuroko Yuki, the second daughter of the Kuroko family, is a chuunibyou otaku who is often teased at school and at home.

However, all of her siblings are geniuses, making them the ultimate sister-obsessed family!

The eldest daughter is the strongest woman in the world, the second son is a man with an IQ of 300, and the youngest is a musical genius.

Surrounded by their deep love, Yuki sometimes accidentally sends messages meant for her family to the class group chat, or spectacularly bombs when trying to be funny at karaoke.

Yuki-chan will surely turn your own embarrassing past into laughter.

A high-energy comedy filled with lovable failures in everyday life begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 夫婦侵犯 ～秘密の孕ませ国境線～
title.romaji: Fuufu Shinpan: Himitsu no Haramase Kokkyousen

216528.description:
Even clumsy loves end with a happy ending!! Indifferent attitude and unresponsive gaze. I thought I was hated!? Five stories from "Shosetsuka ni Narou" where love is discovered despite misunderstandings and misinterpretations are brought to life in comic form!

(Source: Bushiroad Works, translated)
synonyms: I wasn't told I would be doted on like this!

title.native: 私が溺愛されるなんて聞いてません! 好きなら好きとおっしゃって!? アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Watashi ga Dekiai Sareru nante Kiitemasen! Sukinara suki to Ossha tte!? Anthology Comic

216529.description:
From Shiori Amase, author of Welcome to Ethics Class, comes her latest and most bizarre work!!!!!! Unprecedented! A lyrical anthology revolving around "severed heads"!!!!!!

Can a soul reside in a "severed head"?

The dead and those left behind. Transcending time and borders, people still contemplate "severed heads" --

A passionate depiction by the genius Shiori Amase. An unparalleled anthology celebrating "five souls."

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

216530.description:
Lara Rose, a useless, impoverished baroness with a "hungry" skill, gets kicked out of her job after slapping a perverted marquis. But then, she accidentally pulls out... not a kitchen knife, but a holy sword?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: はらぺこ令嬢、れべるあっぷ食堂はじめました〜うっかり抜いた包丁が聖剣でした⁉︎〜
title.romaji: Harapeko Reijou, Level Up Shokudou Hajimemashita: Ukkari Nuita Houchou ga Seiken Deshita!?

216531.description:
Size doesn't matter when it comes to love!

The wonderful romantic comedy that became a hit on social media is now available in book form!

A Borzoi girl who, for reasons unknown, cannot leave her mansion. A small Pomeranian gentleman visits her every day just to see her. The two of them cook together, paint together, and have tea together. Their sizes may be different, but their story warms the heart.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ポメ紳士とボルゾイのお嬢さん
title.romaji: Pome Shinshi to Borzoi no Ojou-san

216532.description:
"I really, really like it."

Cover Illustration: Hinota
1. My Mr. Osaka (マイ・ミスター・オーサカ) [Gotou]
2. Baka ni Tsukeru Uta (莫迦につける唄) [Uzuroro]
3. Happy Town (ハッピータウン) [Anji Seina]
4. Kimi wa Tokubetsu (君はとくべつ) [Toube]
5. Eden yori Higashi 2004 (エデンより東 2004) [Yuma Comotomi]
6. Midori wa Koto na Mono Aji na Mon (緑は異なもの味なモン) [Pii]
7. Boro ga Deru made Matte Yaru (ボロが出るまで待ってやる) [Tsuna Azumi]
8. Mirai wa Okonomi de (未来はおこのみで) [Hanao]
9. Ai no Yume (あいのゆめ) [Mitsuko]
10. Oi to Oji to (甥と叔父と) [Suoshiko]
11. Kimi wa Shiranai (君は知らない) [Moriyo]
synonyms: Midori wa Koto na Mono Aji na Mon
Boro ga Deru made Matte Yaru

216533.description:
In other words, in four days... my twisted life, Kurose Ryouya's life, will come to an end by my own will.

Kurose Ryouya, a young man who has returned from China, despairs of his own existence and desires death. He decides that August 16th, the anniversary of his mother's death, will be the day he ends his life, and on his way, he visits Ureshino Onsen. However, all the inns are full, and while searching for accommodation, he becomes dizzy. It is a local high school student, Kanae, who comes to Kurose's aid. By chance, Kurose ends up staying for a short time at Hisago Ryokan, Kanae's family inn. However, his actions attract the attention of a local yakuza, Setokuma, and the situation begins to take an unexpected turn, leading Kurose to investigate the mystery of a murder that occurred in this area four years ago—!?

216534.description:
"When I'm knitting, the sounds just get further and further away."

Ryouko, a 32-year-old woman who works in food store management, takes on too much work by herself one day and reaches her limit, "skipping" work. In her despair, she wanders into a yarn shop called Ami. There, she meets the gruff shop owner, Hina, who offers to give her knitting lessons—but what will happen? Yarn can also connect people.

A story of girl power in full force, connected by knitting!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

216536.description:
The villainess will break all her ruin flags with all her might!!! A gem of a comic anthology that repels all condemnation and misfortune and leads to a satisfying "revenge" development!

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title.native: 悪役令嬢として破滅フラグは全てへし折ってあげますわ！～いろんな手段であらゆる不幸に「ざまぁ」します～　アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou to Shite Hametsu Flag wa Subete Heshiotte Agemasu wa!: Ironna Shudan de Arayuru Fukou ni "Zamaa" Shimasu Anthology Comic

title.native: 齢200年の呪われた精霊は恋の万能薬を欲する
title.romaji: Yowai 200-nen no Norowareta Seirei wa Koi no Mannouyaku wo Hossuru

216538.description:
It's been half a century since communication with the daemon realm was established and Tokyo transformed into a daemon city. Tasked with dealing with any complications that may arrive from this merging of cultures is the translator of linguae daemonica. But just what does this job entail? A chaotic magic fantasy now begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: グレイキースの魔界誤訳録

216540.description:
To break free from her stifling school life, Yanagisawa starts a Ghost Club! Three members join, but they struggle to hit it off... Hoping to give the club some activities to show for itself, they head to a haunted spot, but...?! A short, 11-page one-shot!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

216541.description:
In a world where magic has been developed, Hirumiya is the mood-maker of his white magic class. But then a student from the black magic department transfers in...?! A romantic comedy of magic and scrambled seats!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

216542.description:
Run up there with those legs! A story of an epic sprint!

Ayumu, the protagonist, is always being chased by someone, whether in kindergarten or elementary school. Then there's Koga Igari of Ougawa Academy, who won the 100m race at the national track and field championships with overwhelming power. "Prey" and "King." The two meet one day. Ayumu, who has always been bullied and running away, decides to hunt down the king waiting at the top of the ecosystem of the "100m race" with just his own legs!!! This is where his story of a dramatic reversal and growth begins.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

216543.description:
“Today, all demons in the world will vanish.”

The Continental Magic Barrier, humanity’s final trump card to end the century-long war against the demons. Pat, a hero, and Noah, an imperial mage, were dispatched to carry out this mission. Together with Loro, a young shepherd boy they met at their final destination, they finally find themselves on the verge of completing this grand plan. And on that day, everything changed.

(Source: Naver, translated)

216544.description:
Some people in this world are takers. They live off of good looks and the fact that others will always be there to provide for them. Misaki is one of those takers. She loves being able to exploit the simps following her on social media to get whatever she needs, whether it’s lunch money or a dream job. That’s all coming to an end.

(Source: irodoricomics)

title.native: 顔が良くて人生イージーモードの女を肉便器にする話
title.romaji: Kao Ga Yokute Jinsei Easy Mode no Onna wo Nikubenki Ni Suru Hanashi

216545.description:
"I want to know the true identity of the horned god who is said to live for all eternity—"

After surviving a merchant shipwreck, researcher Jet finally arrives at the city he's longed for. Although meeting him for the first time, the city's god, Eustella, grows close attached to Jet.

"I want to hear more of your story." Why do I feel like I "know" Eustella, who smiles as if fighting back tears...?

Even if he doesn't understand why, his heart remembers—a tale of pure love in a post-apocalyptic world about rescuing a god bound by duty!!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: にせものの神の愛し子へ
title.romaji: Nisemono no Kami no Itoshigo e

216546.description:
A collection of otherworldly love stories where a strong prince dotes on the protagonist too much!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 異世界の逞しい王子様は、私を溺愛えっちで甘やかす。アンソロジー
title.romaji: Isekai no Takumashii Ouji-sama wa, Watashi wo Dekiai Ecchi de Amayakasu. Anthology

title.native: うさぎな管理人は隣の彼らで忙しい！
title.romaji: Usagi na Kanrinin wa Tonari no Karera de Isogashii!

title.native: ミミック娘は相入れたい！
追放された呪われ令嬢は獣人騎士にほだされるふたりは僻地でもふもふライフ
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Noroware Reijou wa Juujin Kishi ni Hodasareru Futari wa Hekichi de Mofumofu Life

title.native: 空瀬さんと鴨井くんの恋わるあがき
title.romaji: Sorase-san to Kamoi-kun no Koiwaru Agaki

216556.description:
Alto, a vampire who describes himself as "slightly weaker than average," receives a letter addressed to "Lord Alto: Ancient Vampire and One of the Demon King's Four Heavenly Kings." Suspecting a case of mistaken identity, he nonetheless accompanies the beautiful vampire girl who came to fetch him to the Demon King's executive meeting.

...Wait, am I the strongest of the Four Heavenly Kings?

As tales of his legendary exploits, feats he has no memory of, are recounted, the group decides on a new objective: slaying the Hero! The only problem? The Hero is someone he actually knows...?! For some reason, he finds himself feared and respected, getting swept up in a massive crisis. Just then, a legendary dragon awakens, plunging the world into peril!

...I mean, I have no idea what's going on, though.

Thanks to a massive misunderstanding, the curtain rises on a fantasy comedy about an overpowered pacifist vampire!

...No, wait. Aren't you mistaking me for someone else?

(Source: MANGA MILLION)
synonyms: A Pacifist Vampire Who Lives for Eternity, and Before I Knew It, I’d Become the World’s Strongest ~I’m One of the Four Heavenly Kings of the Demon King’s Army and the New Progenitor? Who Do You Think I Am?~

title.native: 万年を生きる平和主義ヴァンパイア、いつの間にか世界最強に ～俺が魔王軍四天王で新たな始祖？ 誰と間違ってんの？～
title.romaji: Man-nen wo Ikiru Heiwashugi Vampire, Itsunomanika Seikai Saikyou ni: Ore ga Maou-gun Shitennou de Aratana Shiso? Dare to Machigatten no?

216561.description:
The official comic anthology of the hugely popular game "Goddess of Victory: NIKKE"!

Enjoy a glimpse into the cute and slightly bittersweet everyday lives of these fighting girls in comic form. Packed with short stories based on "Goddess of Victory: NIKKE" drawn by a stellar lineup of artists!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 勝利の女神:NIKKE 電撃コミックアンソロジー
title.romaji: Shouri no Megami: NIKKE Dengeki Comic Anthology

216562.description:
Webtoon producer Dana lives a secret double life as a famous makeup YouTuber. That secret is threatened when her junior colleague, Seokjin, pitches a new webtoon series based on her very own channel. Terrified of being exposed after a disastrous live stream, Dana tries to probe his intentions over drinks, only to drunkenly confess everything. Seokjin seizes the chance, blackmailing her into co-producing the webtoon to protect her double life. But as they work side by side, their dangerous leverage turns into a subtle, undeniable spark.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: Please Keep My Double Life a Secret!

216563.description:
“Ravi, you can do it, right? I believe in you.”

A world blanketed in snow beneath an eternal winter. Ravi, a girl who makes a living selling drugs in the slums, follows in the footsteps of Heather, the delivery person she admires, and begins making deliveries to the “Northern City,” a place of hope. But in reality, what she was trying to deliver was...

A coming-of-age fantasy about two children navigating a cold and lonely world.

(Source: Naver, translated)

216564.description:
Mok Yeon, the protagonist who became a vampire by chance, resolves to destroy the martial arts world to avenge his sister, who was murdered by a martial artist from a corrupt orthodox sect.

(Source: Naver, translated)

216565.description:
In 20XX, a meteorite that hit Earth emitted a special radiation that caused some individuals to develop "abilities." However, these powers were not equal; they absorbed the vital energy (ex) from men and granted women godlike power...! In a world where men are treated as slaves, forced into hard labor while women continuously drain their vital energy, Itsuki rises up to liberate all men!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 精隷都市のエクスタス
美しすぎるＰ♡生駒七瀬のえちえちＴＶ♡
title.romaji: Utsukushisugiru P♡ Ikoma Nanase no Echi Echi TV♡

title.romaji: Nana Shoukun wa "Sono Saki" wo Shiritai Koisuru DK to Shitsuren OL

7-9. Daegongnimui Sanyangbangbeop (대공님의 사냥방법)
