synonyms: Please Grant Me a Glorious Regret

216577.description:
Born with snow-white hair and pale-colored eyes, Momo Shizuki spends her days persecuted by her family. She lives in confinement, awaiting the day she is to be sacrificed to the ogre as his "priestess." But to the surprise of all in attendance, the solitary ogre that's summoned declares Momo to be his wife, and thus begins his courtship of her!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.english: Courted by an Ogre: The Immaculate Bride's Unlikely Suitor
title.native: 鬼の妻問い ～孤高の鬼は無垢な花嫁を溺愛する～
title.romaji: Oni no Tsumadoi: Kokou no Oni wa Muku na Hanayome wo Dekiai Suru

216578.description:
When this "unsightly" saintess is cast aside and exiled by her fiance, how will her powers flourish in the neighboring kingdom...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Beg All You Like, but This "Unsightly Frog" of a Saintess You Exiled Is Finally Herself Again, and She's Never Coming Back
title.native: 今更戻れと言われても、醜いカエルの追放聖女の私がやっと元の姿になれたので、もう二度と戻りません。
title.romaji: Imasara Modore to Iwarete mo, Minikui Kaeru no Tsuihou Seijo no Watashi ga Yatto Gen no Sugata ni Naretanode, Mou ni Doto Modorimasen.

title.romaji: Kanpeki Ouji no Yotogigakari, Haimei Itashimasu!: Munou to Yobareta Hitsuji Kazoe Hime wa Amai Hibi ni Konwaku Suru

title.romaji: Jimi de Nekura na Watashi desu ga, Naze ka Ikemen Gaka kara Koibito Yaku wo Tanomarete Konwaku Shiteimasu

216581.description:
The cutting edge sisterhood comic of the Reiwa era!

Eri, Yu, Haru, and Aoi are university students preparing for job hunting. On December 26th, the four gathered in Eri's room to record a podcast. Despite their different personalities, they were supposed to be able to laugh together and record as usual—until Eri received an email. She could no longer pretend not to hear. Up-and-coming Naoto vividly updates the current era of increasing division, using podcasts as a starting point! The importance of "connection" becomes clear from the dialogue in a one-room apartment. The cutting edge sisterhood comic of the Reiwa era!

(Source: Leed, translated)

title.native: 100日後に死ぬ悪役令嬢は毎日がとても楽しい。
title.romaji: 100-nichi Go ni Shinu Akuyaku Reijou wa Mainichi ga Totemo Tanoshii.

216583.description:
At first glance, Choko appears to be the perfect Japanese woman, but in reality, she's an extraordinary, die-hard muscle fetishist! She finally marries Taketo, the Prime Minister's bodyguard, who is gentlemanly, kind, and possesses an exquisitely toned body, fulfilling her long-held dream. She's thrilled that she can finally touch his precious muscles to her heart's content...! Her desires are constantly running wild. However, an unexpected newlywed life awaits her, where she can't even touch her strangely shy husband!? Her frustration grows and her fantasies expand, but she can't bring herself to reveal her ulterior motives (perversion) and make a move... "Why won't you attack me...!?" Will the two of them be able to become a couple united in both body and soul?

(Source: Printemps Publishing, translated)

title.native: 新妻は筋肉がお好き 寡黙なSPはお嬢様をわかりにくく溺愛しています
title.romaji: Niizuma wa Kinniku ga wo Suki: Kamoku na SP wa Ojou-sama wo Wakari Nikuku Dekiai Shite Imasu

216584.description:
Momono and her husband have moved in with her brother-in-law, an illustrator of adult art.

After being caught masturbating while looking at one of his drawings, she is forced to agree to a specific condition in exchange for keeping the incident a secret: she must live as her brother-in-law's younger sister. As she endures the humiliation of this role, her body begins to respond in unexpected ways...

(Source: Fanza, translated)

Note: Published in comic Anthurium Vol. 41.
synonyms: Three Rules of a Younger Sister

216585.description:
Nozomi, the ace player of a volleyball team, sprains her ankle during practice.

As Tadashi—the team's medical attendant—treats her, a mischievous impulse stirs within her, leading her to make a bold, seductive move...

Megumi relentlessly torments his shaft with every lewd technique imaginable, until Tadashi, unable to hold back any longer, thrusts his throbbing rod deep inside her!!

(Source: Fanza, translated)

Note: Published in COMIC Anthurium Vol. 50.

216586.description:
A popular, muscular female streamer is attacked one day while broadcasting live.

The culprit was the producer whom she had fired in the past.

A revenge story in which her being defeated by a penis is broadcast to the entire world!!

Note: Published in ANGEL Club 2026-09.

title.native: プッシーキャット 〜絶望配信〜

216587.description:
Yara had reigned as the queen of professional wrestling, but with the change of owner of the gym to which she belonged, her fate gradually became swallowed up by darkness.

A lonely battle in illegal matches begins.

Even her trained body is no match for robust males, and what is left for the loser is thorough humiliation through sex!

Note: Published in ANGEL Club 2026-06.

title.native: バッドエンド～穢された女教師～

216589.description:
They appeared, they were seen, they were heard... A collection of terrifying stories about the Japan Self-Defense Forces, reconstructed from real-life experiences and interviews. From the author of the "Rising Sun" series comes a horror story featuring the Self-Defense Forces!!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: キチこわ～自衛隊基地で本当にあった怖い話～
title.romaji: Kichikowa: Jieitai Kichi de Hontou ni Atta Kowai Hanashi

216590.description:
Is the sex with her "favorite" boss so intense it leaves her "sexually exhausted"!? It's gentle yet passionate, making her melt and orgasm all night long!! Office lady Tsumugi's favorite pastime is her alone time on Friday nights. One day, while enjoying a drink alone at a bar, she witnesses her capable and handsome boss, Department Head Ishigami, breaking up with his girlfriend!! And the reason she was dumped was because "her sex is too intense"!? Somehow, while listening to the department head's troubles, she ends up spending the night with him... "I'll slowly explore what you like about Tsumugi," he says, holding her in his strong arms as he gently bites her nipples, rubs her sensitive insides, and sucks her clitoris, making Tsumugi's mind go blank. When he pushes her all the way in with his huge thing and thrusts deep into her again and again... it feels too good, she can't take it anymore!!

(Source: Mecha Comic, translated)

title.native: 部長の夜テクが凄すぎて腰が浮きます疼きます
title.romaji: Buchou no Yoru teku ga Sugo Sugite Koshi ga Ukimasu Uzukimasu

216593.description:
A 40-something manga artist, a complete homebody, travels around Japan visiting friends and acquaintances while enjoying drinks and food. She wanders through entertainment districts, pops into any place that catches her eye, and sometimes sightsees just to work up an appetite. It's a carefree trip where she goes wherever her heart takes her, with no plans other than drinking! She introduces eight prefectures: Kagoshima, Himeji, Akita, Yokohama, Matsuyama, Mito, Fukui, and Wakayama, plus a little bit of her hometown, Hiroshima.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 女ひとり 日本をゆっくり飲んでみたよ
title.romaji: Onna Hitori Nihon wo Yukkuri nonde Mita yo

title.native: あなたのことが気に入らない
ハイツ南天 ～2名様限定です～
義兄ヴァンパイアは毒の乙女を囲い込む

title.romaji: Watashi wa Akuyaku Reijou Rashii node, Last Boss wo Mederu Kakari ni Naru Koto ni Shimashita

title.native: 魔力ゼロの令嬢は稀代の天才魔術師様に溺愛される
title.romaji: Maryoku Zero no Reijou wa Kitai no Tensai Majutsushi-sama ni Dekiai Sareru

216600.description:
Having failed her high school entrance exams, Yume Morisaki was living a rather unremarkable life. Just as the first semester was about to end, she unexpectedly landed a part-time job at a hamburger chain called E-Burger. Yume was initially discouraged, thinking she couldn't handle customer service, but working alongside her coworkers—who came from diverse backgrounds, ages, and values—she gradually began to become more positive…

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

216601.description: On April 10, 2029, while Motoko Kusanagi and Aramaki are preparing to establish Public Security Section 9 (commonly known as “Ghost in the Shell”), a series of incidents erupt across the United States. As the FBI, AI researchers, and the military investigate, they witness a fateful clash: the battle between Project 2501, the “Puppet Master”—with whom Motoko Kusanagi merges at the end of THE GHOST IN THE SHELL—and a Solomon-class AI holding the fate of humanity in its hands!

216602.description:
Dr. Youichi Onimura, a physician who once investigated a hidden village in Shinshuu at the government’s request and ended up committing murder there. Onimura covered up the incident and changed his appearance. And yet, the village’s relentless pursuit of revenge shows no signs of stopping. A full-scale showdown between Onimura and the village’s assassins. And then the story takes a sudden turn…

The B-side features Jigoku Hizu, a side story about Onimura Youichi from the Togetsu Shobou anthology Yourei 3. Onimura’s journey through the underworld after falling into hell.

Death and karma are always sudden—and cruel.

(Source: Mandarake, translated)

title.native: 幽霊部落 第2部 鬼女と蛇男/地獄秘図
title.romaji: Yuurei Buraku Dai 2-bu: Majo to Hebi Otoko/Jigoku Hizu

216603.description:
Kyoufu no Tsume, widely regarded as Youki Yuuhei’s masterpiece, returns with a fresh new look as part of the "kidan" series—12 years after its limited reissue by Guppy Shorin+ in 2010. Also included is Mushibouden: Akuryou no Tani, which Youki published under the pen name Juutarou Samonji. A dizzying chain of karmic retribution.

(Source: Mandarake, translated)

title.native: 恐怖の爪/虫坊伝 悪霊の谷
title.romaji: Kyoufu no Tsume/Mushibouden: Akuryou no Tani

216604.description:
Yui Yokomizo, an office worker, has had nothing but disastrous experiences with men she met through dating apps. Just when she finally meets her ideal partner, she discovers that he is cheating on her and vows never to use a dating app again. Soon afterward, her company announces a next-generation AI matching app called "Sharela," and all employees are required to register as testers. The app, which boasts a 99% successful matching rate, determines that Yui's best partner is none other than the company president, Hiroto Sakakibara. Refusing to believe in dating apps, Yui challenges President Sakakibara in a battle with the future of the service at stake.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: I Don't Believe In Dating Apps!

title.native: マッチングアプリなんて信じません！

216605.description:
Born from a family where daughters don’t survive until adulthood, frail Frida Harkbourne enters a political marriage with the feared war hero Duke Daniel Richards. Abandoned at the altar and left with a comatose husband, Frida gains unexpected freedom and quietly rebuilds his barren territory. Three years later, Daniel awakens to find a gentle, determined duchess who has transformed his lands through sheer will. As imperial intrigue, hidden enemies, and looming succession conflicts close in, a wary duke and a dying duchess begin a tense partnership that could change their lives… if only Frida can live long enough for it.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Korean.
synonyms: 呪われた公爵夫人と冷酷公爵

title.english: The Duchess Lives Only for This Day

216607.description:
Three victims have already been killed in a series of gruesome murders in which the killer forces birds to eat their internal organs while the victims are still alive. Even in the "crime city" of Tokyo City, this particularly gruesome case will soon develop into a game of deception steeped in "blood," "lies," and "obsession." Detectives, private investigators, victims, the killer, and—who will be deceived in the end?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: ハンドレッドノート-アグリーダック-

216608.description:
Earthbound spirits, guardian spirits, wandering spirits... In a society where the existence of these spirits has been proven, the Tokyo Metropolitan Government has renamed these spirits "Hanako" and established a task force to deal with them. Their duties involve capturing and protecting "Hanako." However, in reality, it is a "hunt" and "disposal" carried out by "materializing" the spirits. "Hanako" is considered an anomaly in society and is eliminated. Hanako's cries are ignored and can no longer be heard by anyone in this world...!? A social suspense drama from Toshiko Machida, author of "Okuru Kotoba"!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

216609.description:
The Habsburgs, the most glorious family at the heart of European history, ruled the Holy Roman Empire. How did this family, once merely poor lords on the outskirts of Switzerland, rise to become emperors? —The setting is the Middle Ages. Rudolf, the head of the family, was seen as "easy to manipulate" and was elected the first member of the family to become Holy Roman Emperor. However, the princes of the empire would soon regret it. "We've chosen a terrible man!" they would exclaim… A grand historical comedy that will make you knowledgeable about history!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: ハプスブルク家の華麗なる受難

216610.description:
In a world where giant fish are increasingly encroaching upon human territory, humans either associate with or exploit one another. The threat posed by the giant fish has not diminished at all, and the people encountered are far from beings to be safe; far from beings to be trusted, they are merely more dangerous than ever before. The human instinct for survival perpetuates this suffering and pain, and the threat posed by the fish, once merely large, begins to evolve into something...

A new threat distinct from anything seen before. In such a world, Ha-Na is surviving all alone, without anyone by her side. As if fleeing from something... or perhaps trying to come to terms with a certain situation. However, the world does not grant the leisure to compose one's mind.

(Source: Naver, translated)

216612.description:
Love may be the most important thing of all.

Another collection of the finest short stories originally published in Aokishi has been compiled into a single volume.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

1. Inyou Koukou Rock Band Doukoukai: Ikari no Death Drum (陰陽高校ロックバンド同好会~怒りのデスドラム~); Aokishi No. 28
2. Chairing Saga (チェアリング・サーガ); Aokishi No. 29
3. Sono Shitai wa Koi wo Desu (その死体は恋をする); Aokishi No. 31
4-5. Princess Maguro Vampire wa Warukunai (プリンセス・マグロ=ヴァンパイアは悪くない); Aokishi No. 26-27
6. Shinateru Drive (しなてるドライブ); Aokishi No. 33
synonyms: 陰陽高校ロックバンド同好会~怒りのデスドラム~
チェアリング・サーガ
プリンセス・マグロ=ヴァンパイアは悪くない

title.native: 鈴木りつ第二短編集 垂直・宇宙・無限
title.romaji: Suzuki Ritsu Dai Ni Tanpenshuu: Suichoku・Uchuu・Mugen

216613.description:
Always soft and gentle, with a smile like an angel. I'm finally confessing my feelings to my classmate, Mikomori-san! I was thinking this'd be where our days together would finally begin... until I heard her shocking response!? A confession isn't the goal, but the beginning!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Result of Confessing to the Class Angel

title.native: クラスの天使に告った結果
title.romaji: Class no Tenshi ni Kokutta Kekka

216614.description:
A four-panel comic about slacking off, dedicated to overworked people and new employees just starting out in the workforce! On her first day at the company, new employee Shimamoto Akari is introduced to her "boss," Kanda Saori, who is five years older than her. Although she is told to learn the ropes from Saori, Senior Saori comes up with all sorts of "slacking off" skills...!? More than just funny, it contains memorable lines that will resonate with you, situations that anyone working in a company will surely relate to... Learn the right way to slack off and have fun from Senior Saori— skip work and read it now! Aim for a seven-day weekend! This is a must-read for working adults that may also be useful as a business book or self-help book.

(Source: Jitsugyou no Nihonsha, translated)

216615.description:
Yu, an ordinary young man who is terribly awkward around women but longs to "love someone with all his heart," is taken home by a handsome man at a matchmaking party one day! But that handsome man turns out to be a woman!? And yet, he ends up crying out in pleasure!? And she demands to take responsibility!? Suddenly, he finds himself being doted on 24 hours a day, 365 days a year by his incredibly handsome girlfriend! The doting romantic comedy between a handsome woman and an ordinary man begins!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)
synonyms: My Girlfriend's So Much Cooler Than I Am

title.native: 女性苦手なアラサーモブ社会人の俺にイケメンすぎる彼女ができました
title.romaji: Josei Nigate na Around 30 Mob Shakaijin no Ore ni Ikemen Sugiru Kanojo ga Dekimashita

216616.description:
High school student Hiroshi Azuma, who was transported to a world similar to the popular VRMMO "Fairy Tail Chronicle" after an unexpected accident, reunites with his classmate Haruna Todo, who was also transported to this world. In Fairy Tail Chronicle, where all in-game items can be crafted, Hiroshi, who possesses advanced crafting skills, oblivious to the atmosphere around him, starts creating rare items one after another. He begins a self-sufficient life with Haruna, a beautiful girl that everyone admires, but Hiroshi has a severe fear of women. This self-proclaimed and universally acknowledged timid boy maintains a certain distance from women at all times, while immersing himself in crafting using the crafting skills he inherited from his transfer to this other world!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title.native: フェアリーテイル・クロニクル ～空気読まない異世界ライフ～
title.romaji: Fairy Tale Chronicle: Kuuki Yomanai Isekai Life

216618.description:
"My mysterious husband—isn't this wedding night... a little too sweet!?" Five short TL stories where you'll drown in sweet courtship♥

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)
synonyms: The Margrave Who Would Not Stop Loving His Bride

title.native: 辺境伯はお飾り妻を淫らに愛し尽くしたい。アンソロジー
title.romaji: Henkyou Haku wa Okazari Tsuma wo Midara ni Aishi Tsukushitai. Anthology

216619.description:
Yoon Seoah is an ordinary city woman whose life is turned upside down when a plane crash leaves her stranded on a deserted island. With her survival hanging by a thread, the only person she can rely on is Pyo Taejeong, the other sole survivor. Blessed with almost unreal handsomeness and a chilling gaze, Taejeong possesses an overwhelming survival instinct that never falters, even in the harshest conditions.

“Take off everything except your underwear.”

Before she knows it, Seoah finds herself being swept along by Taejeong’s bold and uncompromising ways. Stranded together with nowhere to run and no one else to depend on, will the two of them actually make it home alive?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

216621.description:
Yu-Yongng is a girl who has grown up alone in an old apartment since she was fourteen. One day, she discovers Si-An, an eight-year-old boy, sitting alone on the stairs as if he’d been abandoned. Unable to turn away from a child who resembles her, Yu-Young brings Si-An home, and the two become each other’s only family in the world.

“What do I have to do to marry you, big sister?”

“You just have to grow up, get into Harvard as valedictorian, and graduate as valedictorian too.”

It was just a joke she made to a little boy. It was definitely just a joke.

(Source: Naver, translated)

216622.description:
One day, a strange request comes to Jinroku Kii, nicknamed "Lock," a freelance locksmith in Japan. The suspicious-looking customer brings him something that looks like something out of a fantasy: to unlock a treasure chest. With his high skill and extensive knowledge, Lock's name quickly becomes known when he takes on a lock-picking job at the request of the otherworldly thieves' guild, Melodia.

(Source: Takarajimasha, translated)

216626.description:
At first glance, Manda Miyahira looks like the kind of girl no one would fall for. A so-called undateable girl. But that's only true at first glance... There's no hiding her overwhelming presence! The proof? Manda is so insanely popular that she gets an average of 13.7 confessions every morning! What sets her apart, though, is the way she responds. She meets every confession with violence, reducing every pursuer to dust. But Manda herself suffers most from that violence... To stop her tears, her childhood friend Ryuga Todoroki steps up and confesses to Manda! Are you ready for an ultraviolent heroine meets hot-blooded gutsy guy story in this day and age? The curtain rises on a never-before-seen, super-dreadnought-class, high-octane battle romcom!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

216627.description:
“Endless Wings” – an elite party conquering dungeons at the world’s forefront. Among them is Lars, a spirit mage who supports his allies by commanding invisible spirits. But when party leader Kristoff accuses him of being dead weight (since no one else can see his spirits), Lars gets expelled. At his lowest point, he meets the Spirit King in a dream, who warns him of the Demon Lord’s impending resurrection after 1000 years of slumber. Now, this disgraced mage must rise from rock bottom to become the world’s unlikely savior—as a new adventure begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 勇者パーティーを追放された精霊術士 最強級に覚醒した不遇職、真の仲間と五大ダンジョンを制覇する
title.romaji: Yuusha Party wo Tsuihousareta Seireijutsushi: Saikyou-kyuu ni Kakusei shita Fuguu-shoku, Shin no Nakama to Godai Dungeon wo Seiha suru

216628.description:
Hello everyone across the country. Please enjoy the elusive "Pandaful Life." "Mr. Beard and the Panda come and go in your town." Chunky Matsumoto, an old man fairy with the titles of paper-cutting artist and picture book author, is trying his hand at manga for the first time. This work is a manga that sketches wonderful moments of Mr. Beard and the Panda in the morning, afternoon, and evening, so as not to be forgotten.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

216629.description:
In the village where the kindhearted young boy Ryoka lives, a strange phenomenon has kept summer from coming for an entire year. Then, along with a meteor shower that seems to herald the end of the world, a mysterious being named Reta appears. Reta has the power to create food, and the starving villagers all turn to Reta for salvation, but...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

216630.description:
Yuma Mochizuki, a first-year student at Waseda University, plans a trip with his friends from his local cuisine club. He decides to return to his hometown, Momoshijima, which he hasn't visited since moving away 10 years ago. However, the island's atmosphere has completely changed, and beautiful women keep appearing, each targeting Yuma's crotch!? The ultimate survival erotica!

(Source: Shonen Gahosha, translated)

title.native: 百雌繚乱 俺のアソコを狙う百人のメス
title.romaji: Hyaku Mesu Ryouran: Ore no Asoko wo Nerau Hyakunin no Mesu

title.native: 姫騎士学園の下剋上性活 ～最弱スキルで異世界のプライド高め美少女たちを堕としたら、毎晩ご奉仕に来る日々が始まった～
title.romaji: Hime Kishi Gakuen no Gekokujou Seikatsu: Saijaku Skill de Isekai no Pride Takame Bishoujo-tachi wo Otoshitara, Maiban Gohoushi ni Kuru Hibi ga Hajimatta

216633.description:
This collection features 37 exquisite short comics, ranging from nostalgic sci-fi and poignant fantasy to spine-chilling horror! Each story is packed with a sense of wonder and romance in just four pages!

(Source: Komakusa Publishing, translated)

216634.description: Note: Originally self-published on the author's Aladin account. Published by Ridibooks on 2026-09-06.

synonyms: Will You Sign a Contract for Eternity?
Would You Like to Make a Contract for Eternity?

216636.description:
In 1999, seven-year-old Eugene Kim fell in love with his sweet, blonde next-door neighbor Morgan, making a childhood promise to marry before Morgan moved away. Ten years later, Eugene is a popular 17-year-old high school athlete still harboring feelings for his first love. When his long-lost neighbor finally moves back, Eugene rushes to fulfill their old promise… only to uncover a staggering truth: Morgan has always been a boy. Struggling to reconcile his high school persona with his confusing, lingering attraction to a handsome childhood friend, Eugene finds his comfortable world turned upside down in this charming romantic comedy.

(Source: Tappytoon)

216637.description: Note: Part of Playtoon's Play Danpyeonseon (플래이 단편선) Collection.

216639.description:
“Don't want to mate with the Omega you're imprinted on? If we join forces, we both survive.”

Beryl Amber, the bearer of an extreme right-wing Alpha pheromone that no medication can control. Lumian, a pheromone perfumer living on borrowed time, bound by the imprint of a past connection. A passionate drama unfolds as these two, brought together as if by fate, strive for mutual survival.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

216640.description: Tagame Gengoroh's debut work, published in the first issue of Shousetsu June in October 1982, under the pen name of Shunji Oribe.

216641.description:
"When I've been drinking, nothing can stop me."
In a bar district where trouble caused by drunks never ends, one man will teach patrons some respect through sheer insanity!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

216648.description:
Five novels from "Shosetsuka ni Narou" (Let's Become Novelists) have been adapted into manga, featuring young ladies who are destined to find happiness in politically arranged marriages! They might be a surprisingly better option than romance!

(Source: Bushiroad, translated)

title.native: 政略結婚した令嬢ですが案外幸せになりました!アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Seiryaku Kekkon shita Reijou desu ga Angai Shiawase ni Narimashita! Anthology Comic

216649.description:
Sejin, an ordinary college student attempting to retake the entrance exam, falls for his best friend Jinsoo’s mom, Jungah, at first sight. Using the pickup techniques he learned from Jinsoo himself, Sejin sets out to seduce her...

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

216650.description:
This is a small love story unfolding in a corner of a peaceful country somewhere.

A gentlemanly guard loyal to the princess, and a pure and tomboyish princess who is in love with him.

A heartwarming romantic comedy that will make your heart flutter, woven together with sweet and sour exchanges that transcend social status and age differences.

(Source: East Press, translated)

title.native: ある主婦の休日・続報

216653.description:
She thought that once she became an adult, she would be a "grown-up"—. Four months ago, 27-year-old Sana Mochida broke up with her boyfriend, who worked at the same company. The reason was her ex-boyfriend's infidelity, but rumors were spreading at work that Sana was the bad guy. Misunderstood by her colleagues and best friend alike, Sana lost the will to correct the situation and became isolated. The one who came to her rescue was Meguru Natsume, a young elite employee who had transferred from headquarters. This prince charming of the company had, for some reason, taken a liking to Sana. Just as their first date was about to take things to the next level, his "true intentions" were revealed!?

(Source: Mecha Comic, translated)
synonyms: I can't sleep 'cause of Meguru Natsume

title.native: 夏目巡のせいで眠れない
title.romaji: Natsume Meguru no Sei de Nemurenai

216654.description:
System engineer Yu Matsumoto and his pet cat, Orihime, are transported to another world. There, he meets Annemarie, a poor noblewoman, and together they aim to rebuild her territory... Using his programming knowledge and skills, he works to restore the land! What's more, Orihime has also gained incredible power—!? The fantasy of a system engineer who loves development and revolutionizing his territory begins now!

(Source: Earth Star Entertainment, translated)

title.native: 異世界は猫と共に～猫好きSEがプログラム知識×魔法具で最強領地をつくるまで～
title.romaji: Isekai wa Neko to Tomo ni: Nekozuki SE ga Program Chishiki × Mahougu de Saikyou Ryouchi wo Tsukuru made

216655.description:
In a closed kingdom where technology and magic, brought by a guide from another world, merge, only those with magical powers belong to the privileged class, and the threads spun with their magic serve as the power source. Royalty and nobility have hair colors that symbolize the magical attributes of wind, water, fire, and electricity, while commoners without magical powers are born with brown or black hair. In this world of magical privilege, Loretta, a countess's daughter, is born as an illegitimate child with black hair, a symbol of the common people. Raised in secrecy, the unfortunate Loretta faces a new destiny—!!

(Source: Earth Star Entertainment, translated)

title.english: Threads of Destiny: Loretta and the Magic Mechanic
title.native: 不貞の子は父に売られた嫁ぎ先の成り上がり男爵に真価を見いだされる～ロレッタと天才魔道具士の結婚～
title.romaji: Futei no Ko wa Chichi ni Urareta Totsugisaki no Nariagari Danshaku ni Shinka wo Miidasareru: Loretta to Tensai Madougushi no Kekkon

216656.description:
Mitsuru, an office worker, has her engagement suddenly broken off because she's too perfect. In desperation, she gets drunk and promises to marry a man she's just met. That man turns out to be none other than Kyohei Mikage, the heir to her company! Mitsuru turns pale, but Kyohei tells her that the marriage is a contract based on mutual benefit. Mitsuru agrees, thinking it's just a contract, but Kyohei fills her with an overwhelming amount of sweetness and passion... The long-awaited comic adaptation of this super-sweet newlywed love story, where she is loved to the fullest by a perfect heir after hitting rock bottom!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: カラダからはじめる溺愛結婚: 婚約破棄されたら極上スパダリに捕まりました
title.romaji: Karada kara Hajimeru Dekiai Kekkon: Konyaku Hakisaretara Gokujou Supadari ni Tsukamarimashita

title.native: 魔王様の餌付けに成功しました ～魔界の定食屋で悪役令嬢が魔族の胃袋を掴みます～
title.romaji: Maou-sama no Ezuke ni Seikou Shimashita: Makai no Teishoku-ya de Akuyaku Reijou ga Mazoku no Ibukuro wo Tsukamimasu

216658.description:
"Space Agriculture." This isn't science fiction; it's a story of the future that's right before our eyes. Hirota Chizuru, a first-year student in the Space Agriculture Department at Sorano Horticultural High School, harbors a certain dream. Sagara Seisei, a practical training assistant in the Space Agriculture Department, has a past where he gave up on a dream. Towards the high, blue, shining universe, the dreams of these two now begin to move! A story of sowing seeds in space, by Sasano Sai, author of "Misoshiru de Kanpai!", proudly begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

synonyms: แผนวุ่นลุ้นวิวาห์

216661.description: Note: Part of Jaedam Media's Yeonhanam Danpyeonseon (연하남 단편선) Collection.

216662.description:
A promotional one-shot drawn for the release of Aku no Hana live action TV series.

Note: Published in Bessatsu Shounen Magazine 2026 May issue.

title.native: 寡黙な将軍閣下様は魔力ゼロの嫁が好きすぎる～なぜか旦那様の心の声が聞こえます！？～
title.romaji: Kamoku na Shougun Kakka-sama wa Maryoku Zero no Yome ga Suki Sugiru: Naze ka Danna-sama no Kokoro no Koe ga Kikoemasu!?

216664.description: Note: All chapters were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.

title.native: 生贄だった私が邪神竜さまに溺愛されるって本当ですか！？
title.romaji: Ikenie datta Watashi ga Jashin Ryuu-sama ni Dekiai Sareru tte Hontou desu ka!?

216665.description:
In her previous life, Lu Mingwei was betrayed by her stepmother, Lady Lin, and fell from being a noblewoman to a figure of ridicule, dying at the age of forty-eight with a heart full of bitterness. Reborn at the age of fifteen, she returns with forty-eight years of memories. No longer seeking false affection, she is determined only to protect her loved ones, uncover the truth, and avenge past wrongs. She helps her older sister escape her predicament, keeps her younger brother safe, clears her birth mother’s name, and makes her enemies pay the price. On her path to revenge, she and Cui Minglou, the posthumous son of the Prince of Pingjiang, go from testing each other’s intentions to truly understanding one another. As they work side by side to unravel the mystery, their feelings for each other gradually deepen. He admires her resilience, and she recognizes his sincerity; ultimately, they become each other’s strongest support.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: The Glory of the Noble Household
The Honored Husband of Her House

title.native: 東京モダンガール～パノラマ～

216667.description:
1. Rakuen no Housoku (楽園の法則)
2. Hisui-san Chi no Kokoroe (ヒスイさんちの心得)
3. Shitamachi Mitsu Mame Koi Sho (下町みつまめ恋処)
4. Wanwan Enikki Joou (わんわん絵日記帖)

216668.description:
In her past life, Xin An endured her husband Tang Rong’s contempt and betrayal, ultimately dying in tears of blood. After being reborn, Xin An unexpectedly married Tang Mo, her younger brother-in-law from her past life. To defy fate and take revenge on Tang Rong, the two entered into a contractual marriage, and through trial after trial, they gradually grew closer to one another…

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Reborn and Remarried to Little Uncle, the Couple Join Forces to Take Revenge on the Scumbags
Reborn to Marry My Ex's Younger Uncle, We Join Forces to Crush the Scum

title.native: 重生另嫁小叔，夫妻联手虐渣
title.romaji: Chongsheng Ling Jia Xiaoshu, Fuqi Lianshou Nüe Zha

216670.description:
Nan Ye, the owner of a modern restaurant, unexpectedly finds herself transported through time, becoming a lowly slave and kitchen maid in the Dahua Dynasty. Trapped in dire circumstances and facing a humble fate, she uses the exquisite culinary skills honed over two lifetimes to carve out a place for herself in this foreign world and completely rewrite her humble destiny. She prepares a myriad of down-to-earth, everyday dishes, using her exceptional culinary skills to build a reputation and forge a thriving career. Along the way, she befriends kindred spirits, meets a sincere soulmate, and ultimately achieves great success in her career, is surrounded by warm friendships, and enjoys a fulfilling and harmonious love life—culminating in a legendary life of prosperity and fulfillment.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.native: 连载中 霸气小厨娘：想吃就挠墙
title.romaji: Lianzai Zhong Baqi Xiao Chuniang: Xiang Chi Jiu Nao Qiang

title.native: 拾った年下男子に毎晩愛される
title.romaji: Hirotta Toshishita Danshi ni Maiban Aisareru

216672.description:
After his 17-year-old brother died in a car accident, the older brother went to school to collect his brother’s belongings but found himself trapped in a classroom as part of a bizarre urban legend. Forced to follow the rules, he uncovered clues that revealed the school bullying his brother had endured—and the emotional pain he, as the older brother, had caused his family…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

synonyms: Tempted Deliciously by My Younger Boyfriend

title.native: 年下彼氏に美味しく誘惑されて
title.romaji: Toshishita Kareshi ni Oishiku Yuuwaku Sarete

I Can Copy Anything with Healing Magic, So I'm Farming the Abyss

title.native: ナイトシッター　～真夜中は あなた専有です！～
title.romaji: Night Sitter: Mayonaka wa Anata Senyuu desu!

216677.description:
Gokayajin is a wandering manga artist who roams the world. But his true identity is... a heartwarming dog lover! He met his beloved dog, Luca, by chance, and has encountered many unique and wonderful dogs in various countries. The surprising daily lives of famous dogs around the world and the heartwarming everyday life with his adorable family member. A fun-filled comedy about wandering manga artist Gokayajin's dog observations!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: うちのルカなら。 海外のすごい犬とわが家の愛犬どっちもたまらん

title.native: うちのルカなら ～海外のすごい犬とわが家の愛犬どっちもたまらん～
title.romaji: Uchi no Luca nara: Kaigai no Sugoi Inu to Wagaya no Aiken Docchi mo Tamaran

216678.description:
I'm sending you the pass.

These are stories of wavering emotions drawn by a rising star who is steadily attracting attention. This book is filled with the humble wish that these feelings will reach you.

1. Course Rope (コースロープ)
Tsugumi is not good at running or studying, but she is perfect in the water. But she has fallen into a slump at her new school... Winner of the Shogakukan 93rd New Comic Award, Youth Division!
2. 13-sai (13歳)
Haru wants to have a dog when he grows up, but he can't imagine his own future. On his way home from cram school, what does he find at the bus stop where he is waiting all alone...?

3. Keigo no Kao (敬語の顔)
Yoshida-kun, a new employee who can only say safe things, and his tutor, Muramatsu-san. The two are still somewhat awkward with each other as they head off on their business trip...

4. Long Pass (ロング・パス)
Saya, a basketball club member who was connected to everyone through basketball, gets injured. Feeling dejected, she happens to pass by the art club and...?

5. Minna de, Tooku Kara (みんなで、遠くから) Kii, a photography club member who is terrible at taking pictures of people. But she is asked by the student council to photograph "the last month before graduation"...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: ロング・パス かわじろう短編集

216679.description:
I want you to read that letter yourself. I'll teach you how to read.

On the way to school, there's a wall at Mr. Saito's house. One day, elementary school student Yuta witnesses children drawing graffiti on it.
"To Mr. Saito, I'll help you erase the graffiti on the wall" -- Yuta bravely writes a letter, but no reply comes no matter how long he waits. Driven by anxiety, Yuta decides to visit Mr. Saito's house...

This collection includes the title story, which depicts the connection between people in the gentlest and warmest way possible, as well as the one-shot version of "Kappa no Pakichi," which garnered 90,000 likes on X and caused a huge sensation, and a total of five exquisite stories. The author's long-awaited first short story collection that will gently fill the depths of your heart.

1. Ojisan no Hei (おじさんの塀)
2. Inu to Yoneda to Bakemono House (犬と米田と化け物ハウス)
3-4. Summer Day Syndrome (サマーデイ・シンドローム)
5. Sakura ni Tuzuki (さくらにつづき)
6. Kappa no Pakichi: Hajimari no Hanashi (河童のパキチーはじまりの話ー)
7. moon drive

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: "Ojisan no Hei" and Other Stories: The Short Stories of Furuyama Fuu

title.native: おじさんの塀 古山フウ短編集
title.romaji: Oji-san no Hei: Furuyama Fuu Tanpenshuu

216680.description:
"That’s why the story of ‘love’ with you is what fills my ‘loneliness.'"

In a world where human desires manifest as unique magic, the transcendent beings known as〈Adepts〉wield their powers to protect humanity from the malevolent God, granted every privilege in return. After a long journey of training, Konoe, a reincarnated soul, finally earned that exalted title.

――All for the sake of using the love potion. "If I had a love potion, could even someone like me become someone’s one and only?"
Haunted by trauma from his past life, Konoe has lived unable to trust others. Because of this, his unique magic never awakened, leaving him to suffer in solitude even after reincarnation. But then, a golden-haired girl, afflicted by a fatal illness, came to him seeking salvation――.

"...For you, Konoe-sama, I would do anything!"

This is the tale of a white loneliness, devoid of desire, meeting a golden love.
216680.hashtag: #転生程度 #転生程度で胸の穴は埋まらない
synonyms: The Hole in My Heart Cannot Be Filled with Reincarnation

title.native: 転生程度で胸の穴は埋まらない
title.romaji: Tensei Teido de Mune no Ana wa Umaranai
Warui Otoko: Noki no Ame no Yuuwaku

title.native: 暁美ほむらは明日から頑張る!
title.romaji: Akemi Homura wa Ashita kara Ganbaru!

216683.description:
In 202X, a "zombie apocalypse" strikes Tokyo. Faced with a "new lifestyle" where survival is essential, people panic. Amidst the chaos, a strange girl in her underwear appears...? A girl with a secret searches for a lover in a zombie-infested metropolis!? A powerful new work from a talented author!

(Source: Shonen Gahosha, translated)

216684.description:
Collection of early erotic works by Senno Knife published by Shuberu Shuppan.

1. Chizuru no Yume (ちづるの夢)
2. Misemono Juku (見世物塾)
3. Yuurei Shoujo (幽霊少女)

12. Kinsei Ensoukai (金星演奏会)

16. Hako (箱)
17. Fantasy Night (ファンタジーナイト)

216686.description:
"We want you to leave the party." Lime, the errand boy of the hero's party, was suddenly fired.

Lime, who was just a villager, was scouted because of his special skill, "Good Growth," but he was scorned as a burden by his companions who had leveled up to the maximum level, and was abandoned on the island penniless!

However, with nowhere to go, Lime takes shelter from the rain at an abandoned ranch on the island and remembers his past life. Lime was a first-class dairy farmer. Using his knowledge from his past life and his "Good Growth" skill, which can make even plants and animals grow rapidly, Lime decides to rebuild the ranch together with Millie and Ryu, two beast children who have taken up residence there!

(Source: Cosmic Publishing, translated)

title.native: パーティーをクビになったので、「良成長」スキルを駆使して牧場でもふもふスローライフを送ろうと思います！
title.romaji: Party wo Kubi ni Natta node, "Yo Seichou" Skill wo Kushi Shite Bokujou demo Fumofu Slow Life wo Okurou to Omoimasu!

216687.description:
Toyama's beloved sweater, knitted by his late wife, has been stained by his grandchild. Even dry cleaning can't remove the stain, leaving him at a loss. Suddenly, he remembers his subordinate, Morimoto, knitting every weekend at a coffee shop with a calm expression he's never seen at work. Toyama is torn between wearing the stained memento sweater and throwing it away. Seeing this, Morimoto murmurs, "Why don't you just unravel it?" That single sentence sets Toyama's life, which had been stagnant since his wife's death, in motion again. And so begins an unexpected exchange between two people of different ages and values, all through knitting.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

216688.description:
Sou Karaito, a young man with a strong sense of justice, is an ordinary college student by day. However, secretly, he works as a "criminal hunter," wielding a smartphone equipped with a mysterious app that allows him to become either a god or a devil, hunting down heinous criminals one after another. Just who is he? The hunt to expose and judge everyone begins now!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 神アプリ クリミナルハンター

216690.description: Enter the Dagdan Empire, a prosperous land ruled by the gods, where powerful fighters from across the land compete in the Heroic Games for the chance to be granted one wish.

title.native: ファイアーエムブレム 万紫千紅

216691.description:
A collection of exquisite short stories adorned with cats, the supernatural, and romance.

Six exquisite short stories by Akiko Hatsu, a master of fantastical and elegant stories overflowing with excitement!

1. Himitsu no Omoibito (秘密の想い人)
2. Gladstone-ke no Yuurei (グラドストーン家の幽霊)
3. M-fujin no Yuurei (M夫人の幽霊)
4. Yoru no Shouyou (夜の逍遙)
5. Shinrabansou Tsukasadoru Miya no Himegimi (森羅万象を司る宮の姫君)
6. Getsuyoubi no Neko wa (月曜日の猫は)

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

216696.description:
Severely wounded while preventing the king's assassination, Commander Guilford suddenly regains memories of his past life as a Japanese police officer! He awakens from the brink of death to find his childhood friend, Prime Minister Lukash, passionately courting him, declaring, "I won't allow you to die for His Majesty... You belong to me!"

As Guilford becomes increasingly confused, a young lady appears, claiming to be reincarnated like Guilford, and declares, "This is the world of a BL novel—you're the Prime Minister's lover!"

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
216696.hashtag: #転生騎士団長は腹黒宰相の執着愛を全力回避したい

title.native: 転生騎士団長は腹黒宰相の執着愛を全力回避したい

Kyou mo Ashita mo, Kimi to

title.native: はじめくんの泣かせ方

216702.description: In a world where mysterious objects known as "Managed Items"—capable of triggering phenomena beyond human comprehension—have appeared, humanity lives divided between the "Upper World," home to a massive metropolis, and the "Lower World," a vast, desolate wasteland. Tetsuka, a member of a special unit tasked with collecting these items, carries out missions alone in the Lower World while searching for clues regarding his missing younger sister.

216704.hashtag: #他人のフリして同僚に抱かれています #フリ抱か
synonyms: 他人のフリして同僚に抱かれています -Complete ver.-
Embraced in the Guise of a Stranger

title.native: 他人のフリして同僚に抱かれています
title.romaji: Tanin no Furi Shite Douryou ni Dakareteimasu

216705.description:
Defying their instincts, a coup in the omegaverse! This society is full of inequality when it comes to secondary genders.

Mao, a yakuza and Alpha, hates his own and has been pretending to be a Beta, which leads to him being assigned to look after Hiragi, the chairman's grandson and an Omega with an "unusual constitution." One day he stumbles upon Hiragi in heat. Unable to resist Hiragi's powerful pheromones, they end up having sex. But despite his innocent appearance, Hiragi is cunning, and when he realizes Mao is an Alpha, he forces Mao into helping his plans for a coup...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

216706.description:
The scary boss at work was wearing lingerie and sniffing my shirt as he jacked off.

Ohno, a newbie at work, is once again being pushed around by Mr. Himuro. Mr. Himuro is good at work and has strict expectations for both himself and everyone else, and Ohno admires him and works hard to gain his acceptance. However, one day he learns about Mr. Himuro's secret hobby of crossdressing! This is an office romance story that overcomes the pecking order between a very honest, Golden Retriever-type subordinate and a beautiful boss who's actually quite caring!

(Source: Shusuisha)

1-3. Reitetsu Joushi wa Lingerie ni Tsutsumareru (冷徹上司はランジェリーに包まれる)
4-8. Negaigoto Hitotsu (ねがいごとひとつ)
9. Tomo ni Oiru made (共に老いるまで)

Note: Originally serialized under the title "Josou Joushi, Hitori Ecchi wo Nonke Buka ni Nozokarete!? (女装上司、ひとりエッチをノンケ部下に覗かれて!?)".

Josou Joushi, Hitori Ecchi wo Nonke Buka ni Nozokarete!?

216707.description:
Kurase Koryu is a high school boy who spends his days bored. On his way home from high school, he takes a detour and discovers a mysterious QR code on a telephone pole. Curious, he scans it with his smartphone and downloads a certain game app. The name of the app is Dungeon Seekers. Using the camera function, he is able to enter a monster-infested dungeon. ......

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title.native: ダンジョンシーカーズ～スマホアプリからはじまる現代ダンジョン制圧録～

Doma, the chief magician of the royal palace, was demoted after headbutting his unreasonable superior. He's fallen off the elite track and is practically dead as a royal magician—but for Doma, who craves a slow life in the frontier, the demotion is the ultimate reward! Excited to finally be able to live a carefree life of magic research, Doma heads off to his new location. However, as the strongest magician, he can't expect to live such a peaceful life, and he gets caught up in trouble, fighting a gang of thieves and having to investigate a haunted house. Furthermore, a motley crew of unique companions gathers around him, including a naturally strong and beautiful female swordswoman and a spoiled mushroom fairy! His ideal is a slow life, but his second life seems destined to be chaotic...!? The long-awaited comic adaptation of the winner of the 2nd Next Generation Fantasy Cup!!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

The Most Vulnerable Side of You, the “Unattainable Flower”

​Amano Iori’s childhood friend, Yukimura Mizuki, is the school’s “unattainable flower”—the kind of girl everyone envies from afar. But ever since the day Iori was confessed to by another girl, Mizuki has suddenly started closing the distance between them. And now… before he even realized it, why are you sleeping right next to me looking like that?

Rest, a boy born between nobles and commoners, was diagnosed as having “no magical power”, but that was a falsehood; in truth, he possessed infinite magic.

Treated and persecuted like a dog due to being a commoner’s child, he refused to remain a victim forever.

“Someday, all of you will realize… that I am the one with infinite magic!”

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

216730.description:
Taniguchi Hibi, a perfectly ordinary person working at Yano Houki Cleaning Company, goes with her senior colleague, Kijima, to clean a public toilet in a park. Hibi is forced to clean the women's toilet and tries to erase graffiti on the stall door. There, she finds the mysterious words, "Third stall toilet from the entrance → Knock three times..."...

A hunt for an outlier urban legend begins, involving one urban legend = Hanako-san of the toilet and one encounterr = the protagonist!!

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

Note: The new edition has eleven chapters.

216731.description:
The story takes place in the world of "Human-Demon Chronicles," where angels and demons wage an endless war. In an age when the balance of the world was hanging by a thread, Johann was reincarnated as a half-human, half-demon born from a human. He must sometimes suppress his emerging demonic instincts and sometimes make use of them, manipulating the characters of the novel and punishing its villains... as a demon should. The whispers of demons are harbingers of doom. If you heed their words long enough, you may one day find yourself standing on the brink of ruin. However, there's one whisper that's different... Johann’s.

(Source: Naver, translated)

216732.description:
Born into poverty, our protagonist endured endless hardship, becoming a master salesman and being named the "King of Groveling." His dream? It was to retire early and live the good life. But while playing a client company’s game for work, he somehow ends up transported into the game world. And of all characters, he becomes Van Ecclesia, an utterly incompetent, infamous good-for-nothing who is practically useless at everything... but hey, that’s actually perfect! He’s a diamond spoon with good looks, high status, and wealth. And since he's incapable of doing anything, all he has to do is spend the rest of his life eating, playing, and enjoying himself! But then…

“You have awakened the Archmage trait!”

“You have awakened the Myriad Talents trait!”

“You have awakened the Black Flame Dragon’s Charisma…”

Ah, I don’t need any abilities!!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

216733.description:
Yuto doesn't have a bike of his own. One day, he meets Mayu, an older girl whose parents won't buy her one either. The two hit it off and steal Yuto's brother's bike, setting off for somewhere far away. Years later, Yuto, now completely at home on a bike, is suddenly reunited with Mayu...?! A coming-of-age story from a promising new talent!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Owashi Hill is ranked number one in the city rankings for most people wanting to live. There, a corpse with its eyes, nose, mouth, and ears cut off is discovered, along with playground equipment with the cut-off eyes, nose, and mouth attached to it. The case is investigated by Fukami, a woman who can "see" abnormally. As she searches for the truth, a new incident occurs...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

216740.description:
Under an endlessly vast sky, in a tranquil townscape of tiled roofs, lived a close pair of siblings. Their parents ran "Inomoto Transport," and the older brother, Shohei Inomoto, a fourth-grader, was a kind and caring older brother. His younger sister, Mitsuko, a second-grader, had such a vivid imagination that she sometimes troubled her brother. However, they lived the ordinary lives of elementary school children. But then, a certain event leads them to wonder if "the world they live in" is "being controlled by someone's (God's) will." This faint thought eventually leads to…!?

(Source: Mangabu, translated)

216744.description:
"I'll save you right away," he says. Why is this prince sucking on my boobs?! Akira has been reincarnated as the heroine into the 18+ version of the otome game "Snow White and the Seven Lovers," which his sister played in his previous life. He's attacked by a slimy monster with tentacles, and just as he's starting to feel good, he's rescued by a blonde, blue-eyed prince—or so he thinks, but then he suddenly starts sucking on his chest...!? He's resisting, but the prince's hands keep kneading his boobs, what should he do...!? Meanwhile, the prince's tongue and hands start touching his crotch in a lewd way... No way, is a woman's body... this good?! He wants to escape from having sex with the "Seven Lovers"! A slightly extreme, nonstop reincarnation love story, now finally in comic form!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

"Crow, you've been assigned to govern Nest Village, a remote settlement on the outskirts of the domain." Crow Eldorado, the third son of a noble family, is granted the so-called "trash skills" of Appraisal and Alchemy, and is assigned to govern a settlement in the far reaches of the domain. Though the situation would be hopeless for most nobles, Crow actually seems excited. And for good reason. Now that he has regained the memories of his past life, Appraisal and Alchemy are incredibly useful skills to him! As he develops the frontier in pursuit of a comfortable life, he unknowingly begins causing one unbelievable miracle after another...

(Source: Alpha Manga)

Before killing someone, Yeong-Hwan has a secret that must never be revealed to anyone. The only man who witnessed that secret. And the one who hid the evidence inside his own body. That damned first love. Yeong-Hwan keeps Jung-Won under surveillance with a leash around his neck, not allowing him even a moment to escape. However, he eventually wavers in the face of a deal offered by his first love, whom he can neither kill nor let slip away.

"You could enjoy three days what you would enjoy for thirty minutes."

The man who confessed his feelings to him in the past only to be miserably abandoned begins to bite deep into Yeong-Hwan's very core.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

The protagonist, who repeatedly plays the game in search of a happy ending for his favorite heroine, Selvia, but is angered by her treatment as merely a member of the hero's harem, wakes up one day to find himself reincarnated into the game world.

However, he has been reincarnated as Cain, Selvia's fiancé, a villainous nobleman who torments her and is defeated early in the game.

If he does nothing, Selvia will eventually be taken by the hero and Cain will be killed, so he decides to break the game's scenario and seize a future where he can be happy with Selvia.

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

216757.description:
Lido, who served as a priest in the royal capital's church, is suddenly ordered by Archbishop Golbert to be demoted and exiled to the village of Lastor. The reason given is that he "bequeathed a ducal daughter a mysterious skill," and Lido tries to explain the usefulness of the skill, but Golbert won't listen . Lido is banished to the frontier with his beloved cat, Silky, but this is the beginning of a legend. Golbert, who demoted Lido, had no idea that Lido possessed the strength to single-handedly defeat a dragon, the strongest species of creature. And that he had the extraordinary ability to distribute legendary skills at will.

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

"Wow~ Your eyes are creepy, which makes me turned on!"

Even after a few years, I remember it vividly. Dan Hee-on, that woman who made a lustful expression while looking at my scar. Ever since that day, Hyun Hwa has lived chasing after the traces of the disappeared Hee-on, not even knowing if it was anger or love-hate. When they meet again in an unexpected place, Hee-on pretends not to know Hwa at all while enjoying inflicting wounds on his body... Hee-on tries to grab the leash, and Hwa isn't easily caught. In the end, who will be the winner of this game?

For the first time, Saijo begins to doubt "Michael," which he has always believed in.

In the girls' dorm of a boarding school, the senior girl Rin Shishizuki is an extremely serious student who devotes all her time to her studies and club activities. Her roommate and kouhai, Subaru Kumano, tries every trick in the book to loosen Rin up, but…?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

216783.description:
A charity event for the visually impaired, the heart of a glamorous party. Yun Seo-Ha, the adopted daughter of a famous congressman, shines more beautifully than anyone else. But for her, having lost her sight, this glamour is not a shield but a set of shackles. To escape these hellish shackles, Seo-Ha makes a deal, staking everything she has. Her counterpart is Han Jun-Hyeok, her arranged marriage partner, a man rumored to be an uncontrollable "mad dog."

“Please marry me. Then I’ll make sure I don’t become a burden to you by dying.”

How will this precarious arranged marriage, which began with a promise of death end?

(Source: Naver, translated)

216784.description:
Despite possessing exceptional magical talent, the witch Speechy was falsely accused and banished from the royal capital. This manga adaptation meticulously depicts the forbidden love story left to us by the literary giant Natsume Soseki. Note: Some expressions in the work are now considered inappropriate, but in respect of the original work, they have been adopted as is.

216894.description:
Heavenly Demons. Hunters. Giant robots. Demon Kings. Superhumans. The strongest warriors from across the multiverse have gathered in a single arena, each fighting with their entire world on the line. In this battle for survival, defeat means annihilation. Among them are the representatives of the “Ordinary World”—the only world without powers. Just as they are about to be crushed by monsters far beyond anything they have ever known, an unexpected weapon is granted to them. [Game Character Abilities Synchronized.] With the power of video-games at their command, can Shin Jahyeon and the team from the Ordinary World overcome the strongest fighters in the multiverse and save their world from destruction?

(Source: Naver, translated)

216900.description: In a world where humans are Betas and beastmen are divided into Alphas and Omegas, beastmen live among the human majority by taking on human forms. Akihiko is a snow leopard beastman who seems to have everything. He is an Alpha, the heir to a powerful and wealthy family, and handsome features in his human form. Yet the people around him only care about his status. Tired of this shallow way of life, Akihiko transfers from an elite private school to a public one while keeping his beast form, hoping to find someone who will love him for who he is. Without a personal chauffeur for once, Akihiko arrives at school and is greeted by Haruyoshi aka Haru, a boy with beautiful tan skin and sharp teeth. With Haru, Akihiko experiences an ordinary crêpe for the first time, visits an arcade, and makes his very first friend. As their friendship grows, so do Akihiko's feelings for Haru...

First-year high school student Yuu Azuma has imposed four rules on herself in order to "definitely become an idol" and live her high school life accordingly: "No social media," "No boyfriends," "Don't stand out at school," and "Make friends with beautiful girls from all four directions." With these "shining stars" attending different high schools in the east, west, north, and south as her friends, what will be the outcome of the dream that Yu has pursued throughout her high school life?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Commander Brittany is dispatched to reinforce an outpost on the frontier. As the knights there grow increasingly dissatisfied with her rigorous, single-minded training, they suspect that she is being driven by the pursuit of her own personal glory...

216909.description:
Sakuharu Asanaga is a high school boy and light-novel writer. One night, while staying up late to meet a manuscript deadline, he accidentally summons Neruno Somnaphor, who calls herself a “Sleep Demon”…?

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

216910.description:
As Shirabane was bitten by a zombie, he thought, "This is awesome!" His parents had disappeared, he couldn't go to high school, and he was constantly being chased by debt collectors; he was in despair. But somehow, he woke up, still conscious, but in the state of a zombie!? Well then, I'll go to the high school I couldn't go to, make some zombie friends, and enjoy my second life! But that fun time was short-lived, as he once again fell into despair. What will the young man find in this rotten world, and what will he leave behind when he dies again?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: ぶっ壊れ世界で死んだ時

216911.description:
Anne, a widow at the age of 25, receives a shocking request: to "teach the arts of the bedroom" to princes and sons of nobles. She's chosen because she's a young widow with some experience, but despite being married to an old marquis for about 10 years, she's still a virgin! However, Anne is actually a reincarnated person, and she uses the knowledge and experience from her previous life to conduct "classes on sexual techniques"! But, for some reason, her older stepson, Elliot, also attends the class... As the young woman, with a serious expression, brings out dildos and demonstrates positions, the innocent boys, mostly teenagers, blush profusely—and even Elliot (who is also a virgin) starts acting strangely! This unconventional class becomes popular, and unexpected events await Anne one after another—? A hilarious and thrilling erotic comedy, now surprisingly adapted into a comic!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 未亡人アンネの閨の手ほどき
title.romaji: Miboujin Anne no Neya no Tehodoki

216912.description:
The first time she meets a man, she is surprised to find out that he is a man-hater. She is a scandal-happy IT CEO who is constantly in the news. The scandal-ridden CEO of an IT company, who is the talk of the town, calls Hikari every chance he gets and keeps her close because he doesn't see her as a woman. He knows this, but they have been in a barren relationship for eight years. Now, their secret love begins to move.

(Source: J Publishing, translated)

title.native: お前は俺のモノだろ？〜俺様社長の独占溺愛〜
title.romaji: Omae wa Ore no Mono daro? Ore-sama Shachou no Dokusen Dekiai

216918.description:
Radia's quest for revenge against her treacherous friend takes an unexpected turn when she is saved from a near-death experience by Yulius, a mysteriously powerful man. The twist? Yulius is a ghost, visible only to Radia. As he becomes Radia's constant companion, Radia is embroiled in a web of supernatural mishaps that reveal just how potent Yulius really is. And although even Yulius doesn't know his true identity yet, his near-omnipotence might be the key to Radia exacting her revenge. However, this power might also conceal a lurking danger that threatens to reshape their quest in unexpected and perilous ways...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Korean.
synonyms: ラディア〜神殺しの私が神の恋人!?〜

216919.description:
Princess Yuria and Duke Carlisle will kill anyone who crosses their path. But this is supposed to be a romance novel, not a thriller! Now here I am, transmigrated into the novel and married off to nine-year-old Carlisle years before he and Yuria kill me for coming between them. But all I can think about is how…adorable Carlisle is? What if I raised him to be kind? Once he’s a loving adult, I can just pretend to love someone else and run away before Yuria arrives...right?

(Source: Tapas)

216920.description:
The proposal day I had been counting down the days. Han Tae-Min, who was my whole world, chose another woman. And not just any woman, but Ju Hye-Na, the woman who turned my school days into hell… His shameless attitude made me vow revenge. I promised I would do every despicable thing imaginable with his friend, Yun Je-Ha.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

216922.description:
It’s 1999, the end of the century, and Ma Jin is a sleazy private investigator struggling with chronic poverty. One day, his partner Eun-Rak, who had died in an accident while catching someone in the act of an affair, comes back to life. However, the body of the deceased Eun-Rak is now possessed by a mysterious creature that claims to be a “living safe.” It makes an irresistible offer: if Ma-Jin frees it from Eun-Rak’s body, it will hand over the “15.7 billion” in slush funds hidden inside. The problem is that opening this devilish safe requires “intense physical stimulation” that sends a thrilling rush through the entire body...! With money urgently needed, a partner who’s gone strange, and dangerous pursuers hot on their heels after the 15.7 billion, the situation is on the brink of explosion. Will Ma-Jin be able to safely “crack” this loud and mischievous living safe and hit the jackpot that will turn his life around?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

216923.description:
In order for the detective agency Coffin Robin to accept a case, it must be "intriguing." What interests great detective Inori Kosaka, a former criminal psychologist, is not the case itself, but the crime. Not the victim, but the culprit. What series of cause and effect drive him to commit the crime? Looking to answer that question what the sole factor that led the scholar Inori Kosaka to become a detective. ...Dead men tell no tales. Knowing this, the robin asks the coffin "Who killed you?"

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: ハンドレッドノート－コフィンロビン－

216924.description:
"Let me touch you again." At a class reunion, Saki reunites with Kanji, the young owner of an inn with whom she once had a casual relationship. Although they broke up over a trivial misunderstanding, Saki regretted not being able to express her feelings to Kanji during their time apart. "No one but you could make me like this...!" His words make Saki's emotions overflow. They devour each other in the suffocating midsummer heat as they reminisce about those days. A three-day love story of passionate love, melting together in sweat and honey. The long-awaited comic adaptation of Hitsujigumo's romantic drama CD, "Summer Vacation for Adults - Sakamoto Kanji, the Young Innkeeper."

(Source: Moblie Media Research)

title.english: Summer Vacation for Adults - Three Days of Passionate Love with My Classmate who was also My Sex Buddy

216925.description:
"Summoners" call forth otherworldly powers from a different realm using rings. A summoner's abilities are determined by lineage; the protagonist, Minato Minase, hails from an ordinary family and is unable to summon any phantom beasts. In contrast, his childhood friend, Yukimi Tono, is an elite prodigy who commands a powerful phantom beast. As the gap in their talents widens, Minato continues a reckless training regimen using a sword, determined to one day stand beside his childhood friend once more. Then, one day, the two find themselves in a desperate, life-or-death situation during a small-scale subjugation mission. Just as they brace for the end, a mysterious woman named Azami appears! "I shall lend you my power. The price is..." In exchange for overwhelming strength, the "cost of the contract" Azami demands is not the sacrifice of his life or heart, but something truly unprecedented and utterly unexpected...!?

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

216927.description:
Laugh off injustice! A happy ending is something you seize with your own strength!

A popular fantasy romantic comedy novel from Shosetsuka ni Narou is now a manga adaptation! ! Broken engagement? Villainess? Laugh off all that and seize happiness with your own strength in this fantasy romantic comedy with an all-happy ending!

(Source: Bushiroad, translated)

216930.description:
According to all common logic, magic’s strength comes from being precise and specific. Ancient magic has no place in a modern mage’s studies because it’s simply too vague. One particular mage, however, seems to have the ability to make ancient magic work out rather well in his favor. It’s time to show what he can do with it.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Released at Comiket 105, 106.

Yuu lends out his girlfriend Aoi to his best friend for a day so she can help him plan a date. When she least excepts it, Aoi finds out that Yuu's friend has no intention of returning her...

(Source: Irodori Comics)

216932.description:
Sayaka and Yuuki are childhood friends who have finally become lovers. One day, while they’re having sex in a public restroom, a delinquent from the academy they go to barges in and tells Yuuki he’s doing things all wrong. The bad boy, with completely good intentions, then goes on to show them both how you fuck the right way.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Released at Comiket 102.

216933.description:
A game no one has ever managed to conquer: Etius.

[GAME OVER]

The moment every possible strategy had failed…

“Student Frondier?”

I became Frondier, a mere extra in the game! Stores and replicates the image of an object. However, the replica is merely an illusion. All I have is the ability to replicate objects as illusions!

[Main Quest: Change of Fate]

You know the fate that awaits humanity... the day it will meet its end. Save humanity and change its destiny.

“I’m supposed to change fate with this?!”

Replicate everything. Forge a new destiny!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

216934.description:
The touching backstory of Togashi, the unconventional and hugely popular character aiming to become a J-League player! ! Untold stories of the popular characters appearing in the main story of "Aoashi"! ! This time, we feature Togashi Keiji, the teammate and roommate of the protagonist Ashito! ! The only talented player from Ashito's generation that Fukuda scouted for Esperion Youth. A former delinquent with a scary appearance, he is passionate and full of loyalty and compassion. He has helped Ashito , who struggles with defense, many times. Now, a secret story of Togashi before he joined Esperion Youth— a benefactor appears to save Togashi when he was at the depths of despair during his delinquent days…!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: アオアシ 湘南トゥルーライズ

216937.description:
Although he was born into a ducal family, Kaizar is treated as worthless because he lacks talent for magic. Overshadowed by his brilliant younger brother and even scorned by his childhood friend and fiancée, Liliana, he endures one humiliating day after another. But everything changes when his memories return, and he realizes this world is the very VRMMO he once poured countless hours and money into in his past life. And when he opens his status window, he discovers that the save data from back then is still there. With his "Display Character Stats" setting activated, he resolves to get ruthless revenge on everyone who ever looked down on him.

(Source: Coolmic)
