216951.description:
The manga's story begins in high school with Mineko and Sunao, who start a romantic relationship with each other. However, their single parents remarry each other, turning them into brother and sister. Mineko and Sunao mutually agree to suspend their relationship in favor of their new familial connection. But a tragic accident some years later leads to both of their parents' deaths, and now they live under one roof as responsible, independent adults, with the memory of their romance still hidden in their hearts.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: わたしたちのことはなんと呼べば
title.romaji: Watashitachi no Koto wa Nanto Yobeba

216952.description:
A fierce sexual showdown where two insatiable masters of pleasure clash in a battle to see who can make the other cum first!
Will the human emerge victorious, or will the rookie ace succubus win the day?
It has been five years since he arrived in this other world.
Armed with a boundless libido and a repertoire of finely honed sexual techniques, he has explored the sex industry across the land—leaving countless hostesses utterly undone and begging for more.
Driven by unbridled lust, the legendary "King of Stamina," Halberd, summons a partner—only to find a girl who looks completely ordinary, lacking even horns or wings.
Yet, beneath that unassuming exterior lies a promising rookie recruit from a succubus-staffed pleasure house...

(Source: Melonbooks; translated)

Note: Published in Isekai Rakuten Vol. 5

216953.description:
What’s needed for reincarnation? A sweet, intimate moment with a beautiful angel!
Rintaro Watase died after tumbling down a flight of stairs, devastated by a breakup.
When he woke up, he found himself in the Celestial Realm—face-to-face with a beautiful, busty angel.
According to the angel, whose name is Viera, the only way to be reborn is to have sex—!?

(Source: Melonbooks; translated)

Note: Published in Isekai Rakuten Vol. 8

216954.description: Tamura is a forty-six-year-old middle school graduate who works spot-gigs at his own pace. When he returns home, a beautiful wife, a handsome son, and a fluffy doggo are waiting for him. Though his life isn't flashy, Tamura lives a deeply fulfilling daily life—yet he possessed another face: that of a super-skilled assassin. Seizing the opportunity of his son reaching adulthood, Tamura resolves to wash his hands of the assassin business, but the organization's boss hands him a certain harsh condition——. The ultimate assassin papa's final major job.

216955.description:
After a fierce battle with the Hero, the Demon King was cast into a new dimension—Earth. Humans who absorbed the Demon King’s power, which had been shattered into pieces, gained superpowers, while the Demon King dreams of retrieving that power and returning to his former world. Then one day, he encounters a human who displays magical guiding abilities… or rather, his arch-rival, the Hero, who had also fallen to Earth. To the Demon King, who declares, “If we’re going to have a decisive battle anyway, let’s have it right now,” the Hero makes a bold request: “Before that, I want to be your guide!”

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

216956.description:
Yang Ji-Hun and Han Yeong-Jun, who first met at an audition when they were young and became trainees together, had a close bond, even though they bickered from time to time, they were inseparable, like glue. Then one day, after an intense dance practice, a spontaneous kiss sparked an unstoppable flame between them. Everything—from their training to their relationship—was going smoothly for Ji-Hun and Yeong-Jun, and they were even set to make their group debut.

“Oh, by the way, you know idols aren’t allowed to date, right?”

But just as their debut was imminent, the agency dropped a “no-dating policy.” Fearing their relationship would be exposed, Ji-Hun and Yeong-Jun parted ways in tears... But even though he said they should break up, Ji-Hun remains affectionate toward Yeong-Jun and shows signs of possessiveness. With their group activities continuing alongside his “ex-boyfriend”—who seems to be neither fully gone nor fully present—how will things unfold?!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

synonyms: Fallen Leaves Diary: Nae's Training Camp Arc

title.native: 落ち葉日記 苗合宿編

216958.description:
Sohei Mashita, who works in planning and sales at a food manufacturer, is a big fan of Hime Hosoi, a streamer who reviews food from dirty and scary restaurants while playing the role of a refined young lady. So he invites his neighbor and "food buddy," Hinako Ooi, to visit a restaurant that Hime recommended for its "fried rice."

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: Does Mochi-Chuka Count as a Date?

title.native: ところで町中華はデートに入りますか？
title.romaji: Tokoro de Machi Chuuka wa Date ni Irimasu ka?

216959.description:
Lee Jae-ha has lived his entire life avoiding fights. With no particular dreams or talents, Jae-ha suddenly realizes he possesses an incredible natural talent for martial arts. Thinking, 'What's the use of being good at fighting...', he shows no interest despite his friend Lim Myung-in's persistent encouragement to try mixed martial arts. Without Jae-ha knowing, Myung-in secretly applies him to 'Never Back Down', a reality program that searches for hidden rough diamonds in martial arts...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: あらぬ思いのつづけかた
死亡エンドを回避したギャルゲーのヒロインたちが俺の【日記帳】を読んで秘密を知ったらしい
title.romaji: Shibou End wo Kaihi Shita Galge no Heroine-tachi ga Ore no [Nikkichou] wo Yonde Himitsu wo Shittarashii

216965.description:
In the waning age of magic, sorcerers do not simply die. Instead, their remains are crafted into staffs to empower future generations. Tethys, the court sorcerer, has made peace with her fate: when she perishes, she will become the staff for the young prodigy, Enya. Yet the cruelest burden falls to Dima, the craftsman who has known and loved her all his life, for when her tide finally recedes, his hands will be the ones to fashion what is left of her. Will he find the strength to fulfill his duty, at the cost of his own shattered heart?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.native: 私たち離婚しますので 生贄令嬢と冷酷軍人の完璧なる離婚計画
title.romaji: Watashitachi Rikon Shimasu node Ikenie Reijou to Reikoku Gunjin no Kanpeki naru Rikon Keikaku

synonyms: The Shy Girl and Her Ogre Fiancé

title.native: 人見知り乙女と鬼の婚約者 期間限定婚約のはずが、永遠の愛を誓われました⁉
title.romaji: Hitomishiri Otome to Oni no Konyakusha Kikan Gentei Konyaku no Hazu ga, Eien no Ai wo Chikawaremashita⁉

216968.description:
Having both been dumped, Tucker and Hoffen formed the "Friday Night Broken Hearted Alliance" While Hoffen was helping Tucker get used to physical contact, did the two of them unknowingly fall for each other?!

Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.
synonyms: ใครอกหักทักมาหน่อย

title.native: 嫁がされた先は白豚公爵のはずですが？
title.romaji: Yome ga Sareta Saki wa Hakuton Koushaku no Hazu desu ga?

216970.description:
1890, England. Margaret, a middle-class woman living in London, is summoned by the female detective Robin and visits her office. Casual conversation and deduction—a routine stretching back to their childhood—mark the start of another small adventure for the pair.

A bond they believed would last forever... A much-talked-about Holmes homage set in Victorian London!

(Source: East Press, translated)

Note: Originally released at COMITIA 151, 153, and 155, was then licensed by East Press for commercial release.

216971.description:
A complete novelization of SILENT HILL f.

Set in 1960s Japan, the story follows Hinako Shimizu, a student living in the remote mountain town of Ebisugaoka. When a mysterious fog descends upon the town and transforms her familiar surroundings into a nightmare, Hinako must confront terrifying creatures and the hidden truths surrounding her world.

title.native: 悪役令嬢はしゃべりません

216977.hashtag: #セカンドキスからはじまる恋

title.native: セカンドキスからはじまる恋

216978.description:
Filled to the core by an unfathomable love— there is no escape from that love, that curse. Demons, vengeful spirits, gods... Five horror x love stories featuring alluring supernatural beings!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 怖くも愛おしい『ナニカ』に淫らにイカされる…。ホラーラブコミックアンソロジー
title.romaji: Kowaku mo Itooshii "Nanika" ni Midara ni Ika sareru.... Horror Love Comic Anthology

title.native: 周防さんの秘密の恋人

216981.hashtag: #高嶺先輩は完璧でスキだらけ

title.native: 高嶺先輩は完璧でスキだらけ
ぬくもりに密めく甘い毒

216986.description:
Alexander Holzman (Alex), the governor of California and the only son of the Holzman family, a symbol of immense power, is, ironically, a notorious troublemaker in the area. Alex had a mental and physical relationship with Jesse, his father’s mistress. Unable to forget Jesse, who disappeared one day, Alex engaged in all sorts of deviant behavior and eventually ran away from home. In the run-down apartment where he ended up living after running away, he met Jay, his roommate who worked as a male prostitute. Alex, who had always been heterosexual, naturally despised Jay. Yet, strangely, he sensed a strong resemblance in Jay to Jesse, the love he could not forget, and found himself unwittingly drawn to him. As their relationship deepens, secrets are revealed, and the situation takes an unpredictable turn.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

216987.description:
From Mami Tsumura, author of "Kotaro Lives Alone," comes her latest work! This time the protagonist is... a tanuki?! Tanosuke, a shape-shifting tanuki who has come down from the mountains plotting to take over the human world, encounters a 6-year-old human girl named Mei. Mei's reaction to seeing Tanosuke is unexpected...? A heartwarming, new kind of family drama unfolds between a tanuki and a girl!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

216988.description:
I was transmigrated into an R-rated fantasy romance novel. And not just any body, but that of Judith Harrington, who is forced into a marriage sold off to pay off gambling debts. 

Her husband died on the wedding day, and the family was in debt, but… well, that was fine. At least the mansion she inherited wouldn't sell because rumors circulated that it was cursed… but she could understand that, too. 

'I'm not the type to be intimidated by something like this. I've been through everything from land battles to air battles and even transmigrations. She resolved to start a business and live a life that others would envy. 

But… what kind of situation is this—her dead husband came back to life?!
synonyms: I Accidentally Resurrected My Dead Husband

216989.description:
Rosehip has lived through the story of the same novel many times in multiple roles, starting from the female lead to the villainess to even a farmer. Now, she’s a duke’s daughter who is hardly mentioned in the original novel. Determined to spend this extra life in lazy comfort, Rosehip stays out of the main story’s plotline. That is, until the male lead, Ashton, comes knocking on her door. Between her father’s scheming to kick her out and Ashton’s need for a politically convenient fiancee, Rosehip is forced to take a leading role to recover her life outside the spotlight.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese.

title.english: Let Me Enjoy the Extra Life
title.native: 一人で生きたいお姫様 ※ヒーロー拒絶中
女王陛下（実は女装男子）の可愛い金糸雀
title.romaji: Joou Heika (Jitsuwa Josou Danshi) no Kawaii Canary

synonyms: Kokoro Has Her Reasons for Not Getting Married.

title.native: こころには結婚しない理由がある
title.romaji: Kokoro ni wa Kekkon Shinai Riyuu ga Aru

216992.description: Ha-Jeong, an unhappy high school girl, is obsessed with a popular influencer known as "Daldalrun" — obsessed enough to have hacked into her home's smart video intercom to spy on her private life. One day, while watching, Ha-Jeong witnesses Daldalrun collapse and die on screen. The next day, she wakes up to find she has possessed Daldalrun's dead body.
synonyms: City Where the Moon Does Not Rise

title.native: 孤高の軍神と余命半年の花嫁
title.romaji: Kokou no Gunshin to Yomei Hantoshi no Hanayome

216994.description:
Seon-Yul, the pianist who won the Van Cliburn Competition at the youngest age ever. That night, while returning home after a successful concert, he lost his family and both hands in a car accident. After spending more than a decade as a recluse, Seon-Yul awakens in the body of a 17-year-old boy following a certain incident. The protagonist finds himself possessed by the body of Jeong Seon-Yul, a troubled teenager who is looked down upon by everyone. He begins his second musical journey at his alma mater.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Da Capo for a Musical Genius
The Return of the Musical Genius

216995.description:
Three years after the revolution toppled the monarchy, Princess Lien, who had been confined underground, enters into a political marriage with Duke Lishian of Roche-Noire by order of the Emperor. Lien, who had always retreated into the abyss of her own making whenever others’ judgments were directed at her, finally comes face to face with her true self through her love and solidarity with him, and realizes for the first time that promises and trust are stronger than fate, and that they were each other’s most radiant homecoming—having walked side by side while gazing at the same star.

(Source: Naver, translated)

216996.hashtag: #恋してダメなら推してみろ

title.native: 恋してダメなら推してみろ!!

216997.description:
Esika endured life with her in-laws, trusting only in love. However, when her husband cheats on her with his friend and she is involved in a serious accident, she begins to recall memories from her past life. She realized she was none other than the villainess Cheon Young-Ryeong, and that this was the world of a book. Recalling her past life and the bitter ties with those who had tormented her, Esika ultimately vows to take revenge on the members of the Duke’s household.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: A Wicked Woman's Life With Her In-Laws Is Fun

title.native: 生産性のないニゴリカワ

216999.description:
Those who commit sins are bound to be punished someday. If not in this life, then in the afterlife. This is the story of Lee Hyeon, the grim reaper who judges sinners and leads them to hell.

(Source: Naver, translated)
